lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 24
lessons.subtitle: Yesterday Was Amazing!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yesterday was the most amazing day. I want to tell my friend back home about it. So, I am writing her a letter!
dialogue.zh: 昨天是最棒的一天。我想告诉老家的朋友。所以，我正在给她写信！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Dear Penelope, Life in Washington, D.C. is interesting. I see something new every day -- like yesterday. Yesterday started like a usual work day.
dialogue.zh: 亲爱的佩内洛普：华盛顿特区的生活很有意思。我每天都会看到新东西——比如昨天。昨天开始时像平常的工作日。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I said, "Yesterday started like a usual work day."
dialogue.zh: 我说：“昨天开始时像平常的工作日。”

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: I was at work. And I wanted a break. So, I walked and walked … and walked. Then, I saw something! It was a festival -- a big festival!
dialogue.zh: 我在上班。我想休息一下。所以我走啊走……又走。然后，我看到了什么！那是一个节日——一个很大的节日！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It is the Smithsonian Folklife Festival.
dialogue.zh: 这是史密森民俗生活节。

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: Yes. It was the Smithsonian Folklife Festival. Every year the festival shows different cultures. This year one of the cultures was the Basque culture. There was dancing and food and games!
dialogue.zh: 对。那是史密森民俗生活节。每年这个节日都会展示不同的文化。今年其中一种是巴斯克文化。有舞蹈、食物和游戏！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am dancing a traditional Basque dance.
dialogue.zh: 我在跳传统的巴斯克舞。

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: At the festival, I danced a traditional Basque dance!
dialogue.zh: 在节日上，我跳了传统的巴斯克舞！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They are cooking traditional Basque food.
dialogue.zh: 他们在做传统的巴斯克食物。

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: They cooked a lot of traditional Basque food.
dialogue.zh: 他们做了很多传统的巴斯克食物。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They are playing a game. It's a kind of handball. What do they call it? They call it pilota!
dialogue.zh: 他们在玩游戏。那是一种手球。他们叫它什么？他们叫它皮洛塔！

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: They played a game with their hands and a small ball. It's a kind of handball. But this game is called pilota.
dialogue.zh: 他们用手和一个小球玩游戏。那是一种手球。不过这个游戏叫皮洛塔。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is beautiful! This is traditional Basque art.
dialogue.zh: 这真美！这是传统的巴斯克艺术。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They are making a traditional Basque ship. This festival is a lot of fun!
dialogue.zh: 他们在做一艘传统的巴斯克船。这个节日很好玩！

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: The whole day was a lot of fun!
dialogue.zh: 一整天都很好玩！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Who said that? I want to write my friends and tell them about my day!
dialogue.zh: 谁说的？我想写信给朋友们，告诉他们我的一天！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: … So, I wanted to tell you about my day! Please, my friend, come visit Washington, D.C. soon. There is a lot to do! Until next time … Anna.
dialogue.zh: ……所以，我想告诉你我的一天！朋友，请尽快来华盛顿特区玩。这里有很多事可以做！下次见……安娜。

quiz.prompt: What festival did Anna see yesterday?
Which culture did the festival show?
What is the handball game called?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 25
lessons.subtitle: Watch Out!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello from Washington, DC! This city has many monuments and memorials.
dialogue.zh: 你好，这里是华盛顿特区！这座城市有很多纪念碑和纪念堂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today I am visiting the ones built in memory of our Presidents: Washington, Jefferson, Lincoln and Roosevelt.
dialogue.zh: 今天我去看为总统建造的那些：华盛顿、杰斐逊、林肯和罗斯福。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to learn more about them.
dialogue.zh: 我想多了解他们。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey! Watch out!
dialogue.zh: 嘿！小心！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Sorry! I didn't see you.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！我没看见你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You were not looking. You should be more careful.
dialogue.zh: 你没有看路。你应该更小心。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: I know I should be more careful. But this game is really fun.
dialogue.zh: 我知道我应该更小心。可这个游戏真的很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What kind of game?
dialogue.zh: 什么样的游戏？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: You have to find things that aren't really there.
dialogue.zh: 你得找到其实不在那儿的东西。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How can you find things that aren't really there?
dialogue.zh: 不在那儿的东西怎么找？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: They're in your phone. See?
dialogue.zh: 它们在你的手机里。看见了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I see. It's like a scavenger hunt.
dialogue.zh: 我明白了。就像寻宝游戏。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: That's right!
dialogue.zh: 对！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't have time for games. I want to learn about U.S. presidents.
dialogue.zh: 我没时间玩游戏。我想了解美国总统。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Then you should play this game! When you find an American symbol, you win points and a Fun Fact about a U.S. President.
dialogue.zh: 那你更应该玩这个游戏！找到一个美国象征，你就能得分，还能得到一条美国总统趣闻。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have time for this game!
dialogue.zh: 这个游戏我有时间！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Here are the symbols that I caught: the Statue of Liberty for 20 points, Uncle Sam for 40 points and the American flag for 60 points.
dialogue.zh: 这些是我抓到的象征：自由女神像 20 分，山姆大叔 40 分，美国国旗 60 分。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What symbol are you looking for now?
dialogue.zh: 你现在在找哪个象征？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: I am looking for the bald eagle. That is 100 points! It should be near the Washington Monument.
dialogue.zh: 我在找白头海雕。那是 100 分！它应该在华盛顿纪念碑附近。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This game is awesome.
dialogue.zh: 这个游戏太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: You ought to buy the app right now. It's called "Catch Americana."
dialogue.zh: 你现在就该买这个应用。它叫“Catch Americana”。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Got it. Catch Americana.
dialogue.zh: 知道了。Catch Americana。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks! Good luck!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！祝你好运！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Good luck to you too!
dialogue.zh: 也祝你好运！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is the Jefferson Memorial. I know that Thomas Jefferson signed the Declaration of Independence! Now, where is that symbol?
dialogue.zh: 这是杰斐逊纪念堂。我知道托马斯·杰斐逊签署了《独立宣言》！现在，那个象征在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here it is! My first one. It's an American flag! I won 60 points!
dialogue.zh: 在这儿！我的第一个。是一面美国国旗！我得了 60 分！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: An American flag works well for Thomas Jefferson. I see lots of American flags on Independence Day!
dialogue.zh: 美国国旗很适合托马斯·杰斐逊。独立日那天我会看到很多美国国旗！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Where is my Jefferson Fun Fact?
dialogue.zh: 我的杰斐逊趣闻呢？

dialogue.speaker: Voice
dialogue.en: In his lifetime, Thomas Jefferson wrote about 19,000 letters!
dialogue.zh: 托马斯·杰斐逊一生大约写了 19,000 封信！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I did not know that. Where is the next symbol?
dialogue.zh: 我以前不知道。下一个象征在哪里？

quiz.prompt: What does Anna tell Dan he should do?
What is the app called?
What symbol does Anna catch first?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 26
lessons.subtitle: This Game Is Fun!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is the Roosevelt Memorial. Where is the symbol?
dialogue.zh: 这是罗斯福纪念堂。那个象征在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yay! I found Uncle Sam and I won another 40 points! What is the Fun Fact?
dialogue.zh: 耶！我找到了山姆大叔，又得了 40 分！趣闻是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Voice
dialogue.en: Franklin Roosevelt was the first to fly in a plane as president!
dialogue.zh: 富兰克林·罗斯福是第一位以总统身份坐飞机的人！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I didn't know that. This is a really beautiful memorial.
dialogue.zh: 我以前不知道。这座纪念堂真漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is the Lincoln Memorial! Where is the symbol?
dialogue.zh: 这是林肯纪念堂！那个象征在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I found it! The Statue of Liberty! Please give me my Fun Fact.
dialogue.zh: 找到了！自由女神像！请给我趣闻。

dialogue.speaker: Voice
dialogue.en: Abraham Lincoln was a great wrestler!
dialogue.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯是个很棒的摔跤手！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I didn't know that. Lincoln wanted freedom for all people. So, the Statue of Liberty works well.
dialogue.zh: 我以前不知道。林肯希望所有人都自由。所以自由女神像很合适。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: And I won 20 points! Time to find the next symbol.
dialogue.zh: 我还得了 20 分！该找下一个象征了。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Hey! Look out!
dialogue.zh: 嘿！小心！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry. Hey, it's you! Now, I should be more careful.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。嘿，是你！现在我该更小心了。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: That's okay.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This game is a lot of fun. Hey, what's your name?
dialogue.zh: 这个游戏很好玩。嘿，你叫什么名字？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Dan. What's yours?
dialogue.zh: 丹。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Anna.
dialogue.zh: 安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Like Americana!
dialogue.zh: 就像 Americana！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah, I guess so.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，算是吧。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Did you find any symbols?
dialogue.zh: 你找到象征了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I found three and won 120 points!
dialogue.zh: 找到了，我找到三个，得了 120 分！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Me too. But, did you find the bald eagle?
dialogue.zh: 我也是。不过，你找到白头海雕了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. Did you?
dialogue.zh: 没有。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: First one to find it wins?
dialogue.zh: 谁先找到谁赢？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Anna, look out for that tree!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，小心那棵树！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I learned a lot about presidents with this game. But I ought to be more careful. Until next time …!
dialogue.zh: 这个游戏让我学到很多总统的事。不过我应该更小心。下次见……！

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 27
lessons.subtitle: I Can't Come In

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! I am sure that today, in Washington, D.C., there are a lot of great things to do. But I am not doing any of them. I am sick. Right now, I'm going to call my boss and tell her I cannot come in to work.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我肯定今天华盛顿特区有很多好事可以做。可我一件都不做。我生病了。现在我要给老板打电话，告诉她我不能去上班。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Hello?
dialogue.zh: 喂？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver, Hi. I can't come to work today.
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士，嗨。我今天不能来上班。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Why not? What is wrong?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, yesterday I felt fine.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，昨天我感觉还好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In the morning, I painted for hours. In the afternoon, I cut wood. Then, I built a fire.
dialogue.zh: 早上，我刷了好几个小时的漆。下午，我劈了木头。然后，我生了火。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Anna, what do you mean? Why can't you come to work today?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你是什么意思？你今天为什么不能来上班？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I do not feel well. I think I'm sick.
dialogue.zh: 我感觉不舒服。我想我生病了。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: I'm sorry to hear that. I was sick last week, too. I had the flu.
dialogue.zh: 听到这个我很难过。我上周也病了。我得了流感。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What did you do?
dialogue.zh: 那你怎么做的？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: I slept a lot and I drank a lot of water. Do you have a doctor?
dialogue.zh: 我睡了很多，也喝了很多水。你有医生吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I do.
dialogue.zh: 有的。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: You should call your doctor. And get lots of rest!
dialogue.zh: 你该给你的医生打电话。还要好好休息！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Ms. Weaver. I'll call right now. I'm calling my doctor.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，韦弗女士。我现在就打。我在给医生打电话。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: Hello. This is Dr. Bennett. How can I help you?
dialogue.zh: 你好。我是贝内特医生。有什么可以帮你？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Dr. Bennett. This is Anna.
dialogue.zh: 你好，贝内特医生。我是安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: Oh, Hi, Anna. How can I help you?
dialogue.zh: 哦，嗨，安娜。有什么可以帮你？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I think I'm sick.
dialogue.zh: 我想我生病了。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: Let me ask you a couple of questions. Do you have a sore throat?
dialogue.zh: 让我问你几个问题。你嗓子疼吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. I have a sore throat.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我嗓子疼。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: Do you have a cough?
dialogue.zh: 你咳嗽吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. I have a cough.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我咳嗽。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: When did you start feeling sick?
dialogue.zh: 你什么时候开始觉得不舒服的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This morning. Yesterday I felt great. In the morning I painted, for hours - in the afternoon I cut wood -
dialogue.zh: 今天早上。昨天我感觉很好。早上我刷了好几个小时的漆——下午我劈了木头——

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: Excuse me, Anna. But I don't need to know all that. Do you have a fever?
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，安娜。那些我都不需要知道。你发烧吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. My thermometer says 125 degrees?! What??
dialogue.zh: 哦。我的体温计显示 125 度？！什么？？

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: Yeah, that's not right.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那不对。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Wait. The thermometer was in my hot cup of coffee.
dialogue.zh: 哦。等等。体温计在我那杯热咖啡里。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: Please take it again, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 请再量一次，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, the thermometer says 100.5 degrees.
dialogue.zh: 好，体温计显示 100.5 度。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: 100.5 degrees is not too high. I want you to drink lots of water. Rest in bed and get lots of sleep.
dialogue.zh: 100.5 度不算太高。我要你多喝水。躺在床上休息，多睡觉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is what my boss said to do. Um, Dr. Bennett, when can I go to work?
dialogue.zh: 我老板也是这么说的。嗯，贝内特医生，我什么时候可以去上班？

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: Don't go to work for a couple of days.
dialogue.zh: 这几天先不要去上班。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! I mean, I don't want to make my co-workers sick.
dialogue.zh: 好！我是说，我不想让同事生病。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Bennett
dialogue.en: That's right. Call me back in a couple of days.
dialogue.zh: 对。过两天再给我打电话。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I will, Dr. Bennett. And thanks.
dialogue.zh: 好的，贝内特医生。谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, you heard the doctor – no work for a couple of days. I need water, sleep and um … lots of movies! Well, the doctor didn't say anything about movies. But it can't hurt! Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 好，你听到医生说了——这几天不用上班。我需要水、睡眠，还有嗯……很多电影！好吧，医生没提电影。不过也没什么坏处！下次见！

Why does the thermometer first say 125 degrees?
choices: Anna has a very high fever
It was in her hot cup of coffee

choices: Don't go to work for a couple of days

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 28
lessons.subtitle: I Passed It!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Guess what this is? This is my driver's license! I passed my driving test!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！猜猜这是什么？这是我的驾照！我通过了驾驶考试！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, I rented a car so I can drive around Washington, D.C. You can see more of the city this way. Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 今天我租了一辆车，这样就能开车逛华盛顿特区。这样可以看到更多这座城市。玛莎！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, did you get your driver's license?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你拿到驾照了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I did! But it was not easy.
dialogue.zh: 拿到了！可并不容易。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Why? What happened?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？发生了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, you know, I can drive farm equipment really well. But I was really nervous driving in Washington, D.C. traffic!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你知道，我开农用机械很在行。可在华盛顿特区开车我真的很紧张！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Did you pass the test the first time?
dialogue.zh: 你第一次就通过考试了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well…no. But I did pass the second time.
dialogue.zh: 嗯……没有。不过第二次我通过了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What happened during the first test?
dialogue.zh: 第一次考试发生了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It started fine.
dialogue.zh: 开始还不错。

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Okay … Anna. Is your seatbelt buckled?
dialogue.zh: 好……安娜。安全带系好了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, sir!
dialogue.zh: 系好了，先生！

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Great. Please start the car.
dialogue.zh: 很好。请发动汽车。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, Anna, start the car. Started the car. Good job, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 好，安娜，发动汽车。发动了。干得好，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Why are you talking to yourself?
dialogue.zh: 你为什么在自言自语？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am a little nervous. When I'm nervous, I talk to myself.
dialogue.zh: 我有点紧张。紧张的时候，我会自言自语。

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: You don't need to be nervous.
dialogue.zh: 你不必紧张。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Listen to that engine!
dialogue.zh: 听听这引擎！

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Please, stop pushing the gas pedal!
dialogue.zh: 请停止踩油门！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Okay, when you are ready, turn.
dialogue.zh: 好，准备好了就转弯。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Not now! You almost hit that car!
dialogue.zh: 现在不行！你差点撞到那辆车！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You said "turn!"
dialogue.zh: 你说“转弯！”

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Look first! There were cars in the street.
dialogue.zh: 先看！街上有车。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Please don't yell at me!
dialogue.zh: 请不要对我大喊！

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: I'm sorry! I was afraid.
dialogue.zh: 对不起！我害怕了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You were yelling.
dialogue.zh: 你在大喊。

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Look out for that car! Brake! Brake!!
dialogue.zh: 小心那辆车！刹车！刹车！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna and John
dialogue.en: Ahhh!
dialogue.zh: 啊！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Why is everyone honking at us?
dialogue.zh: 为什么大家都在对我们按喇叭？

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: You were driving too slow! Anna, stay on the street!
dialogue.zh: 你开得太慢了！安娜，留在路上！

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Hands on the wheel, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 手握方向盘，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What's that sound?
dialogue.zh: 那是什么声音？

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: That, Anna, is the police.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，那是警察。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That sounds awful.
dialogue.zh: 听起来糟透了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, it did not go well. But, I practiced and passed the second time!
dialogue.zh: 是的，第一次很不顺利。不过我练习了，第二次通过了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do you know where you want to take your first drive in Washington, D.C.?
dialogue.zh: 你知道第一次在华盛顿特区想开去哪里吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! Let's go!
dialogue.zh: 知道！走吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There it is … the White House!
dialogue.zh: 到了……白宫！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, you do know you can't drive up to the White House, don't you?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你知道不能开车一直开到白宫门口，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. No. I didn't know. I guess we walk from here!
dialogue.zh: 知道。不知道。我不知道。我想我们从这儿走过去！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sometimes you can see more of Washington, D.C. in a car. If you want to see the White House, you need to walk. Until next time … !
dialogue.zh: 有时候开车能看到更多华盛顿特区。不过要想看白宫，你得走路。下次见……！

quiz.prompt: What did Anna pass?
When did Anna pass the driving test?
Why do Anna and Marsha walk at the end?
choices: The car ran out of gas
They cannot drive up to the White House

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 29
lessons.subtitle: A Long Time Ago

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! In Washington, D.C., there are many places that bring history to life. But people who live here often do not have time to see them. They are too busy with work -- like me. Hi, Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！在华盛顿特区，有很多地方能让历史活起来。可住在这儿的人常常没时间去看。他们工作太忙——比如我。嗨，玛莎！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna! Have a seat.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！坐吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks. This was a good idea. Working outdoors is nice.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。这主意不错。在户外工作真好。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Um-hum, it is.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，是的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am tired. Today was a busy day at work. And I still have work to do!
dialogue.zh: 我累了。今天上班很忙。我还有工作要做！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hmm, that's too bad.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，真可惜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How are you these days?
dialogue.zh: 你最近怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I'm really busy too, Anna. Let's get to work.
dialogue.zh: 我也很忙，安娜。我们开始干活吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, look! That bus has a photo of Abraham Lincoln!
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，看！那辆公交车有亚伯拉罕·林肯的照片！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That's an advertisement for Ford's Theatre. They have a new show.
dialogue.zh: 那是福特剧院的广告。他们有一场新演出。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They have shows where Abraham Lincoln died?
dialogue.zh: 他们在亚伯拉罕·林肯去世的地方演戏？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Yeah, it's a working theater and a museum.
dialogue.zh: 对，它既是还在演出的剧院，也是博物馆。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love Lincoln. You know, Marsha, that advertisement reminds me of something.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢林肯。你知道吗，玛莎，那个广告让我想起一件事。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Um-hum. What's that?
dialogue.zh: 嗯。是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: When I was a little girl … When I was a little girl … I was not like other children.
dialogue.zh: 我小时候……我小时候……我不像别的孩子。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Um-hum, I can believe that.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我能相信。

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: I was a tall, serious child. At the playground the other children played silly games. They played with dart guns. They played on the swings, the slide and the teeter-totter. They also played ball. But not me. I loved to read serious books about U.S. presidents.
dialogue.zh: 我是个又高又严肃的孩子。在操场上，别的孩子玩傻游戏。他们玩玩具枪。他们玩秋千、滑梯和跷跷板。他们也打球。可我不。我喜欢读关于美国总统的严肃书。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In fact, I wanted to be … don't laugh … President of the United States.
dialogue.zh: 其实，我想当……别笑……美国总统。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: (laughs)

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Stop! I know it's a silly childhood dream.
dialogue.zh: 别笑！我知道这是个傻傻的童年梦想。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I'm sorry. It's not silly. Guess what I wanted to be?
dialogue.zh: 对不起。这不傻。猜猜我想当什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What?
dialogue.zh: 什么？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I wanted to be... an astronaut.
dialogue.zh: 我想当……宇航员。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Really?
dialogue.zh: 真的？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha's voice
dialogue.en: When I was a kid, I studied the stars and planets. I wanted to fly into outer space!
dialogue.zh: 我小时候研究星星和行星。我想飞到外太空！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, Marsha, childhood dreams are really important.
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，玛莎，童年梦想真的很重要。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: They are. And it's good to remember them.
dialogue.zh: 是的。而且记得它们很好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey! I have an idea. Let's go.
dialogue.zh: 嘿！我有个主意。走吧。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Go where?
dialogue.zh: 去哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's go make our childhood dreams come true.
dialogue.zh: 我们去让童年梦想成真。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: We're going to the Air & Space Museum! Yes!
dialogue.zh: 我们要去航空航天博物馆！太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. We're going to see a show at Ford's Theatre just like Abraham Lincoln did when he died! It's not far from here.
dialogue.zh: 不。我们要去福特剧院看演出，就像亚伯拉罕·林肯去世那天那样！离这儿不远。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Uh huh. That is your childhood dream.
dialogue.zh: 嗯哼。那是你的童年梦想。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good point. Okay, next week, we'll come here and be astronauts.
dialogue.zh: 说得对。好，下周我们来这儿当宇航员。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Honestly?
dialogue.zh: 真的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Honestly.
dialogue.zh: 真的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Tonight we are seeing a show at Ford's Theatre, where a man shot President Abraham Lincoln. This is history come to life … and a childhood dream come true! Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: 今晚我们在福特剧院看演出，就是有人开枪打死亚伯拉罕·林肯总统的地方。这是活过来的历史……也是童年梦想成真！下次见……

choices: To be President of the United States

quiz.prompt: What did Marsha want to be?
Where do they go tonight?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 30
lessons.subtitle: Rolling on the River

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Washington, D.C. sits on the Potomac River. This river is important to the history and culture of the city. Today, I am at an outdoor seafood market near the Potomac River. Some say it is the oldest outdoor seafood market in the United States! I am here to buy seafood. Let's see what they have!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区坐落在波托马克河上。这条河对这座城市的历史和文化很重要。今天我在波托马克河附近的一个露天海鲜市场。有人说这是美国最古老的露天海鲜市场！我来买海鲜。我们看看他们有什么！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me. Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下。你能帮我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sure! What do you need?
dialogue.zh: 当然！你需要什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete!
dialogue.zh: 皮特！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna!
dialogue.zh: 安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What are you doing here?
dialogue.zh: 你在这儿干什么？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I work here. You know, it's not easy to be a writer.
dialogue.zh: 我在这儿工作。你知道，当作家不容易。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah, I heard that. Sorry.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我听说了。抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: But this job is great. I work outside by the river. And I can eat all the free seafood I want!
dialogue.zh: 不过这份工作很棒。我在河边户外工作。还能想吃多少免费海鲜就吃多少！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is great, Pete. In fact, I am here to buy some seafood for my dinner party.
dialogue.zh: 那很好，皮特。其实，我是来为晚宴买海鲜的。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You came to the right place. They have the freshest seafood in town. How much money can you spend?
dialogue.zh: 你来对地方了。他们有全城最新鲜的海鲜。你能花多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I can only spend $50.
dialogue.zh: 我只能花 50 美元。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Okay. What do you want?
dialogue.zh: 好。你想要什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: First, I want to buy some shrimp.
dialogue.zh: 首先，我想买一些虾。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sure thing. Follow me. How much shrimp do you want?
dialogue.zh: 没问题。跟我来。你要多少虾？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How much do I need for five people?
dialogue.zh: 五个人需要多少？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Give her a pound of shrimp!
dialogue.zh: 给她一磅虾！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ok, now I want to buy some crabs.
dialogue.zh: 好，现在我想买一些螃蟹。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: The crabs here are delicious! They are the best because they come from the nearby Chesapeake Bay! Walk this way.
dialogue.zh: 这儿的螃蟹很好吃！它们最好，因为来自附近的切萨皮克湾！这边走。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: How many crabs do you want?
dialogue.zh: 你要多少只螃蟹？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want a dozen crabs.
dialogue.zh: 我要一打螃蟹。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You should get the larger crabs. They have the most meat.
dialogue.zh: 你该买大一点的螃蟹。它们肉最多。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Then I want a dozen large crabs, please!
dialogue.zh: 那我要一打大螃蟹，谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Is that everything you need?
dialogue.zh: 这些就是你需要的全部吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's see … I have shrimp and crabs. And a friend is bringing a salad and many ears of corn-on-the-cob.
dialogue.zh: 我看看……我有虾和螃蟹。还有个朋友会带沙拉和很多玉米棒。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Is that all the seafood that you need?
dialogue.zh: 海鲜就这些了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 是的。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: That'll be $49.95. Cash or credit?
dialogue.zh: 一共 49.95 美元。现金还是信用卡？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Credit, please.
dialogue.zh: 信用卡，谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, you love to eat seafood. Did you grow up on the water?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你很爱吃海鲜。你是在水边长大的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I didn't. But I love the water. And I love being on the water.
dialogue.zh: 不是。不过我喜欢水。也喜欢待在水上。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You know how to sail?
dialogue.zh: 你会驾驶帆船？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well … this afternoon I am going on a boat.
dialogue.zh: 嗯……今天下午我要上船。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You are full of surprises. What kind of boat? Is it a motorboat or a sailboat?
dialogue.zh: 你真让人意外。什么样的船？是摩托艇还是帆船？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's a special boat, Pete. Well, thanks for your help. See you later!
dialogue.zh: 是一艘特别的船，皮特。好，谢谢你的帮助。再见！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: See you, Anna! Wow, Anna's a sailor! Who knew?
dialogue.zh: 再见，安娜！哇，安娜是水手！谁能想到？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, rivers are important to the history and culture of Washington, D.C. And now I am part of this city's interesting waterfront culture. Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 是的，河流对华盛顿特区的历史和文化很重要。现在我也成了这座城市有趣的滨水文化的一部分。下次见！

How much shrimp does Pete tell them to give Anna?
How many crabs does Anna buy?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 31
lessons.subtitle: Take Me Out to the Ball Game

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, there, sports fans! Baseball is America's sport. Today, I am going to Nationals Park. It is home to Washington, D.C.'s baseball team -- the Washington Nationals!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，体育迷们！棒球是美国的运动。今天我要去国民球场。那是华盛顿特区棒球队——华盛顿国民队——的主场！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Jonathan!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，乔纳森！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna! Where are you going?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！你去哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am taking a bus to a Nationals baseball game!
dialogue.zh: 我要坐公交去看国民队的棒球赛！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Don't take the bus. A taxi is faster than a bus.
dialogue.zh: 别坐公交。出租车比公交快。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, good idea. You know I love baseball.
dialogue.zh: 哦，好主意。你知道我爱棒球。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: That's great. Have fun.
dialogue.zh: 那很好。玩得开心。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In fact, I wanted to be a baseball player.
dialogue.zh: 其实，我以前想当棒球运动员。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Is this one of your memories? I'm really busy.
dialogue.zh: 这又是你的回忆吗？我真的很忙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This won't take long. I can see it now... I am at home plate. I wait for the pitch. The ball comes. I swing. It's a hit! I run to first base, second base, third base, then home plate. It's a home run! The crowd cheers! Woo hoo!
dialogue.zh: 不会太久。我现在就能看见……我站在本垒。我等着投球。球来了。我挥棒。打中了！我跑向一垒、二垒、三垒，然后回到本垒。是全垒打！观众欢呼！呜呼！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: You really love baseball. Have fun at the game, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 你真的很爱棒球。看比赛开心点，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Jonathan. Taxi!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，乔纳森。出租车！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. Where are you going?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。你去哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Ashley. I am going to see a Nationals baseball game!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉。我要去看国民队的棒球赛！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: What time is the game?
dialogue.zh: 比赛几点开始？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 7 o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Do you have a ticket?
dialogue.zh: 你有票吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, not yet.
dialogue.zh: 还没有。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, you should go a lot earlier than 7 o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你应该比 7 点早很多到。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is why I'm taking a taxi. Taxi!
dialogue.zh: 所以我才打车。出租车！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, Anna, that's not a good idea. A bicycle is faster than a taxi.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，安娜，那不是好主意。自行车比出租车快。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, Ashley. Ashley, Ashley, Ashley. A car is faster than your bicycle.
dialogue.zh: 哦，阿什莉。阿什莉，阿什莉，阿什莉。汽车比你的自行车快。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: In D.C. traffic sometimes a bicycle is faster than a car. And right now, there is a lot of traffic.
dialogue.zh: 在华盛顿特区的拥堵里，有时自行车比汽车快。现在路上很堵。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good point. But I don't have a bicycle.
dialogue.zh: 说得对。可我没有自行车。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Okay, Anna, you can use my bicycle.
dialogue.zh: 好，安娜，你可以用我的自行车。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks! I really want to learn how to ride one.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！我真的很想学骑自行车。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: What do you mean, learn how to ride a bike? Oh, Anna! Anna, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 什么意思，学骑自行车？哦，安娜！安娜，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: You know, Anna, the Metro is faster than a taxi and a bicycle. You ought to take the Metro. It's that way.
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，安娜，地铁比出租车和自行车都快。你该坐地铁。那边走。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good idea.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: OK.
dialogue.zh: 好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: See you later!
dialogue.zh: 再见！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Bye, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 再见，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Bye!
dialogue.zh: 再见！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The Metro was a lot faster than a bus, taxi or bike. And now I'm at Nationals Park! Look at all these fans! So many people like to watch baseball. There's the ticket window. What? The tickets are sold out? Nooooooo! Nooooooo! But I really want to watch a baseball game. Does anyone have an extra ticket?
dialogue.zh: 地铁比公交、出租车或自行车快多了。现在我到国民球场了！看看这些球迷！这么多人喜欢看棒球。售票窗口在那儿。什么？票卖完了？不——！不——！可我真的很想看棒球赛。有谁有多余的票吗？

dialogue.speaker: Fan
dialogue.en: Next time, you should buy your ticket online.
dialogue.zh: 下次，你应该上网买票。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks. Thanks a lot. It is good advice. Being early is better than being late. Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。非常感谢。这是好建议。早到比迟到好。下次见……

quiz.prompt: Where is Anna going?
What does Ashley say is faster than a taxi and a bicycle?
Why can't Anna watch the game?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 32
lessons.subtitle: Welcome to the Treehouse!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Today is a big day. My first children's show is on television! Woo-hoo! I'm excited and nervous.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！今天是重要的一天。我的第一个儿童节目要上电视了！呜呼！我又兴奋又紧张。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Hello, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 你好，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Ms. Weaver!
dialogue.zh: 你好，韦弗女士！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Some people are going to watch your children's show. After they watch it, they'll tell me what they liked, and what they didn't like.
dialogue.zh: 有人要看你的儿童节目。看完后，他们会告诉我喜欢什么，不喜欢什么。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, dear.
dialogue.zh: 哦，天哪。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: They're in the conference room. They're in the conference room.
dialogue.zh: 他们在会议室。他们在会议室。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, everyone. I'm Anna, and thanks for coming!
dialogue.zh: 大家好。我是安娜，谢谢你们来！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today you are going to watch my new show. I hope you like it.
dialogue.zh: 今天你们要看我的新节目。希望你们喜欢。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 2
dialogue.en: What is the show about?
dialogue.zh: 这个节目讲什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's a children's show.
dialogue.zh: 这是一个儿童节目。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 1
dialogue.en: But we are not children!
dialogue.zh: 可我们不是孩子！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This children's show is different. I hope.
dialogue.zh: 这个儿童节目不一样。我希望是。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 3
dialogue.en: I don't really like children's shows.
dialogue.zh: 我其实不太喜欢儿童节目。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Shhh, please. The show is starting!
dialogue.zh: 嘘，拜托。节目开始了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, hi! Just give me one minute ….oops! Oh well. I can fix that later.
dialogue.zh: 哦，嗨！给我一分钟……哎呀！算了。我以后再修。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, I'm Anna! Welcome to "The Time Traveling Treehouse!" This is not a usual treehouse. It can time travel! That is why it's called "The Time Traveling Treehouse."
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是安娜！欢迎来到“时光旅行树屋”！这不是普通的树屋。它可以时光旅行！所以才叫“时光旅行树屋”。

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Anna, do not forget me.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，别忘了我。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Of course not! This is my partner, MINDY!
dialogue.zh: 当然不会！这是我的搭档，MINDY！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: My name means Massive Information Navigation Device, for You!
dialogue.zh: 我的名字是 Massive Information Navigation Device, for You！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That means we can travel to many places and learn many things. Kids from all over the world ask us questions. We find them answers!
dialogue.zh: 意思是我们可以去很多地方，学很多东西。世界各地的孩子问我们问题。我们帮他们找答案！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Woo-hoo! That is right, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 呜呼！没错，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY, what is our first question?
dialogue.zh: MINDY，我们的第一个问题是什么？

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Layla asks us this question.
dialogue.zh: 莱拉问我们这个问题。

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.en: Hello, Anna! Hello, MINDY! I'd like to know -- how do you play baseball?
dialogue.zh: 你好，安娜！你好，MINDY！我想知道——棒球怎么打？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is a great question! MINDY, we need to find her an answer!
dialogue.zh: 这是个好问题！MINDY，我们得给她找个答案！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: I know that we can find it, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 我知道我们能找到，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Where am I now? MINDY, now I am on a snowy mountain!
dialogue.zh: 我现在在哪里？MINDY，我现在在一座雪山！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: That is a good place to learn how to ski.
dialogue.zh: 那是学滑雪的好地方。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, MINDY, but it cannot teach us about baseball! And I don't know how to ski!
dialogue.zh: 是的，MINDY，可它教不了棒球！而且我不会滑雪！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Sorry, Anna. Let's try again.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，安娜。我们再试一次。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Where am I now!? MINDY, I am in the ocean! An ocean cannot teach us about baseball!
dialogue.zh: 我现在在哪里！？MINDY，我在海里！海教不了棒球！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Please don't yell, Anna. The ocean can teach us about surfing.
dialogue.zh: 请别喊，安娜。海可以教冲浪。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, MINDY, it can teach us about surfing … and sharks! Ahhh!
dialogue.zh: 是的，MINDY，它可以教冲浪……还有鲨鱼！啊——！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Anna, please wait. I need to fix my navigation device.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，请等一下。我得修一下导航装置。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY, please fix it faster. And get me out of here … now!
dialogue.zh: MINDY，请修快一点。还有，现在就带我离开这儿……立刻！

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: Whoa! Is Anna going to be lost forever? Next week, you can watch part two of "The Time Traveling Treehouse!"
dialogue.zh: 哇！安娜会永远迷路吗？下周，你可以看“时光旅行树屋”第二集！

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 1
dialogue.en: Aw, man! Will the shark eat her?
dialogue.zh: 哎呀！鲨鱼会吃掉她吗？

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 2
dialogue.en: Will Anna find the answer?
dialogue.zh: 安娜会找到答案吗？

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 3
dialogue.en: Please tell me the ending!
dialogue.zh: 请告诉我结局！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, you liked it?
dialogue.zh: 所以，你们喜欢吗？

dialogue.speaker: Coworkers
dialogue.en: Yes!
dialogue.zh: 喜欢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, you can watch the ending next week!
dialogue.zh: 好，你们下周可以看结局！

dialogue.speaker: Coworkers
dialogue.en: Noooooo!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Don't forget to watch next week!
dialogue.zh: 别忘了下周看！

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 33
lessons.subtitle: Learning America's Sport

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 2
dialogue.en: It is time for part two of the children's show!
dialogue.zh: 儿童节目第二集的时间到了！

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 1
dialogue.en: It's time! It's time! I can't wait!
dialogue.zh: 到时间了！到时间了！我等不及了！

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 3
dialogue.en: Shh! I can't hear it!
dialogue.zh: 嘘！我听不见了！

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: Last time on "The Time Traveling Treehouse," Anna was lost, really lost. She wants to learn about baseball. But her computer, MINDY, sent her to many wrong places.
dialogue.zh: 上次在“时光旅行树屋”里，安娜迷路了，真的迷路了。她想了解棒球。可她的电脑 MINDY 把她送到了很多错误的地方。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY! Help me! I am in the ocean with a shark!
dialogue.zh: MINDY！帮帮我！我和一条鲨鱼在海里！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: I will try one more time, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 我再试一次，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Please try harder, MINDY!
dialogue.zh: 请再努力一点，MINDY！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now, where am I? I am at a playground with a baseball field! Yes! I can teach children about baseball here! MINDY, MINDY, it took you a long time. But you did it!
dialogue.zh: 现在，我在哪里？我在一个有棒球场的操场！太好了！我可以在这儿教孩子们棒球！MINDY，MINDY，你花了很长时间。但你做到了！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Thanks, Anna. Give me a call when you find the answer.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，安娜。找到答案就给我打电话。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. Come with me. Let's learn how to play baseball! This is a baseball field. This is a pitcher's mound. This is first base! This is second base! This is third base! This is home plate!
dialogue.zh: 好。跟我来。我们来学怎么打棒球！这是棒球场。这是投手丘。这是一垒！这是二垒！这是三垒！这是本垒！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: To play baseball, you really only need a bat, a ball and a glove. Each team has many players.
dialogue.zh: 打棒球其实只需要球棒、球和手套。每支队伍有很多球员。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pitchers pitch the ball.
dialogue.zh: 投手投球。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Catchers catch the ball.
dialogue.zh: 捕手接球。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Batters bat the ball.
dialogue.zh: 击球员击球。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Runners run the bases.
dialogue.zh: 跑垒员跑垒。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Fielders field the ball.
dialogue.zh: 外野手接球。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: First, the pitcher pitches the ball to the batter. The batter bats the ball. Then, the runner runs to first base.
dialogue.zh: 首先，投手把球投给击球员。击球员击球。然后，跑垒员跑向一垒。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Each time a batter bats, the runners run around the bases. Each time a runner runs across home plate, they score a run! There are nine innings in a game. The team with the most runs at the end of nine innings wins the game!
dialogue.zh: 每次击球员击球，跑垒员就绕着垒跑。每次跑垒员跑过本垒，他们就得一分！一场比赛有九局。九局结束时得分最多的队赢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY, MINDY, we found the answer! It's time to return to the treehouse.
dialogue.zh: MINDY，MINDY，我们找到答案了！该回树屋了。

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Good job! That was fast.
dialogue.zh: 干得好！真快。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 3
dialogue.en: Good job Anna. You know, I still don't like children's shows, but I like this children's show.
dialogue.zh: 干得好，安娜。你知道吗，我还是不喜欢儿童节目，可我喜欢这个儿童节目。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 2
dialogue.en: I liked the time travel.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢时光旅行。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 1
dialogue.en: But time travel is not real. You're so silly, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 可时光旅行不是真的。你真傻，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah, time travel is so silly. Thanks, goodbye. Bye, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 对，时光旅行很傻。谢谢，再见。再见，谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, MINDY? Are you there?
dialogue.zh: 喂，MINDY？你在吗？

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Hello, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 你好，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY, I want to go to China! Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: MINDY，我想去中国！下次见……

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 34
lessons.subtitle: What Will I Do?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Halloween is very popular in the United States.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！万圣节在美国很流行。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Children trick-or-treat. They ask people for candy. Children and adults wear costumes and go to parties!
dialogue.zh: 孩子们不给糖就捣蛋。他们向人要糖果。孩子和大人穿上服装去参加派对！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In fact, there is a Halloween party tonight. I need my friend, Genie. Genie!
dialogue.zh: 其实，今晚有一场万圣节派对。我需要我的朋友吉妮。吉妮！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna! What do you need?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！你需要什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Tonight, there is a Halloween party.
dialogue.zh: 今晚有一场万圣节派对。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: I love Halloween! Are you going?
dialogue.zh: 我爱万圣节！你去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I might go. I might not go. I don't have a costume. Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 我可能去。我也可能不去。我没有服装。你能帮我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Dress as a genie!
dialogue.zh: 打扮成精灵！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great idea! I can do a genie trick like read minds!
dialogue.zh: 好主意！我可以玩精灵把戏，比如读心！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Anna, be careful. Things might go wrong.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，小心。事情可能会出错。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What can go wrong?
dialogue.zh: 能出什么错？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey, look! I'm a genie! This is going to be fun!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，看！我是精灵！这会很好玩！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Remember, Anna. Be careful!
dialogue.zh: 记住，安娜。小心！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Don't worry, Genie! I will!
dialogue.zh: 别担心，吉妮！我会的！

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: Excuse me, are you really a mind reader?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，你真的会读心吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I might be.
dialogue.zh: 我可能是。

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: Okay, tell me what I am thinking.
dialogue.zh: 好，告诉我我在想什么。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure! First, what do you do?
dialogue.zh: 当然！首先，你是做什么的？

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I study. I'm a junior in college.
dialogue.zh: 我在上学。我是大学三年级。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you study?
dialogue.zh: 你学什么？

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I study journalism.
dialogue.zh: 我学新闻。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. Wait. You are thinking … you will graduate from college in about one year.
dialogue.zh: 好。等一下。你在想……你大约一年后会大学毕业。

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: Well, yeah. That's the plan. I told you, I'm a junior in college.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，对。那就是计划。我告诉过你，我是大三。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right, um, wait. There's more. You are thinking … you might get a job writing the news.
dialogue.zh: 对，嗯，等一下。还有。你在想……你可能会得到一份写新闻的工作。

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I MIGHT get a job writing the news? I MIGHT! That means I might not. And I'm studying really hard.
dialogue.zh: 我可能得到一份写新闻的工作？可能！那意思是我也可能得不到。而且我学习很努力。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, no, no, no. Uh, no, you will! You WILL get a job writing the news.
dialogue.zh: 不，不，不，不。呃，不，你会的！你一定会得到一份写新闻的工作。

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I will?
dialogue.zh: 我会吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You will.
dialogue.zh: 你会的。

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I will. I think.
dialogue.zh: 我会的。我想。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 'Bye. Happy to help!
dialogue.zh: 再见。乐意帮忙！

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Can you really read minds?
dialogue.zh: 你真的会读心吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I might.
dialogue.zh: 也许会。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Well, today, I will ask my girlfriend to marry me. What am I thinking?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，今天，我会向女朋友求婚。我在想什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wait. Wait, you are thinking ... you might have a wedding very soon!
dialogue.zh: 等一下。等一下，你在想……你可能很快就会办婚礼！

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Might? MIGHT? She won't say "no," will she?
dialogue.zh: 可能？可能？她不会说“不”，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, no! She WILL say "yes"!
dialogue.zh: 不，不！她一定会说“愿意”！

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: I will have a wedding, won't I?
dialogue.zh: 我会办婚礼的，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You will. You will!
dialogue.zh: 会的。会的！

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Thanks. I think.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我想。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good luck!
dialogue.zh: 祝你好运！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is hard. Genie! Genie!
dialogue.zh: 这很难。吉妮！吉妮！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Anna, what's wrong?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't want to be a genie for Halloween. I might not go to the party.
dialogue.zh: 万圣节我不想当精灵了。我可能不去派对。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Of course you will go. I have another costume for you!
dialogue.zh: 你当然会去。我还有另一套服装给你！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm a rock star! You read my mind!
dialogue.zh: 我是摇滚明星！你读到我的心思了！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: No. You told me you like rock music.
dialogue.zh: 没有。你告诉过我你喜欢摇滚乐。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, right. Well, I love it!
dialogue.zh: 哦，对。嗯，我很爱它！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Have fun, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 玩得开心，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Genie!!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，吉妮！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am ready for the Halloween party! But I am not going to read minds. I might play some rock music! Or I might not. Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: 我准备好去万圣节派对了！不过我不会读心。我可能会弹点摇滚乐！也可能不弹。下次见……

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 35
lessons.subtitle: Let's Make Dinner!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! Washington, D.C. has many fun places to eat. But, sometimes it's more fun to cook. In fact, tonight Marsha and I are cooking for friends. Well, she is cooking. I am doing the shopping.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区有很多好玩的吃饭地方。不过，有时做饭更有趣。其实，今晚玛莎和我要给朋友做饭。嗯，她做饭。我负责买菜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's Marsha. Hi, Marsha.
dialogue.zh: 是玛莎。嗨，玛莎。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. Do you have the shopping list?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。你有购物清单吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I told you: I have the shopping list. Can you hear it?
dialogue.zh: 有，我告诉过你：我有购物清单。你能听见吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Okay, good. I hear the list. Anna, please buy all the ingredients on the list.
dialogue.zh: 好，很好。我听见清单了。安娜，请把清单上的材料都买齐。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, Marsha, I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，玛莎，我会的。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: And do not spend too much time shopping.
dialogue.zh: 还有，买东西别花太长时间。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, Marsha, I won't. See you later.
dialogue.zh: 不会的，玛莎。再见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sometimes, Marsha worries too much. I love shopping! And, I did not spend too much money. Oh, no! But I did spend too much time! I have to return home now!
dialogue.zh: 有时候，玛莎担心太多。我爱购物！而且，我没有花太多钱。哦，不！可我花了太多时间！我现在得回家了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, what took you so long? Our guests will be here soon!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你怎么去了这么久？客人马上就到！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Don't worry, Marsha. I bought everything on the list.
dialogue.zh: 别担心，玛莎。清单上的东西我都买了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Let me see. You bought a bunch of bananas, a box of pancake mix, a bag of coffee … Anna, this is all wrong!
dialogue.zh: 我看看。你买了一串香蕉、一盒煎饼粉、一袋咖啡……安娜，这些全错了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you mean wrong? I bought a jar of peanut butter and a loaf of bread … no, wait … two loaves of bread.
dialogue.zh: 什么叫错了？我买了一罐花生酱和一条面包……不，等一下……两条面包。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, these are the wrong ingredients!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，这些材料是错的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: These ingredients are all on the list! I took this list from the counter.
dialogue.zh: 这些材料都在清单上！我是从台面上拿的这张清单。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, this is the shopping list for breakfast. I said, take the shopping list - on the refrigerator - for dinner!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，这是早餐购物清单。我说的是，拿冰箱上那张——晚餐的——购物清单！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, there was no shopping list - on the refrigerator - for dinner!
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，冰箱上没有晚餐购物清单！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Oh no! It's on the floor!!
dialogue.zh: 哦不！它在地板上！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna and Marsha
dialogue.en: Ahh!!! Ahh!!!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What are we going to do?
dialogue.zh: 我们怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: When do our guests arrive?
dialogue.zh: 客人什么时候到？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: They arrive in 30 minutes!
dialogue.zh: 他们 30 分钟后到！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I can fix this. Do you trust me?
dialogue.zh: 我能搞定。你相信我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do I have to?
dialogue.zh: 必须信吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 是的。

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 36
lessons.subtitle: I Can Fix This!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Last time on Let's Learn English, Marsha and I invited friends to a dinner party but I shopped with the wrong list. Guests are coming soon. Marsha is worried but I have a plan. Let's see what it is.
dialogue.zh: 上次在 Let's Learn English 里，玛莎和我请了朋友来吃晚餐，可我按错清单买了东西。客人马上就到。玛莎很担心，但我有计划。我们看看是什么。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I just need a couple of ingredients. Marsha, please hand me the flour.
dialogue.zh: 我只需要几样材料。玛莎，请把面粉递给我。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, where is the flour? It's not in the cabinets.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，面粉在哪里？不在柜子里。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I put the flour inside the refrigerator.
dialogue.zh: 我把面粉放进冰箱了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's cold and dry in the refrigerator. See, it says: "Put in a cold, dry place." Okay, now, Marsha, please hand me the eggs.
dialogue.zh: 冰箱里又冷又干。看，上面写着：“放在阴凉干燥处。”好，现在，玛莎，请把鸡蛋递给我。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, where are the eggs?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，鸡蛋在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The eggs are inside the cabinet under the sink.
dialogue.zh: 鸡蛋在水槽下面的柜子里。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, why are the eggs in here?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，鸡蛋怎么会在这儿？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: On the farm, we always put the eggs there. How else can the chickens see them? Okay. You clean the living room. I will make dinner.
dialogue.zh: 在农场，我们总是把鸡蛋放那儿。不然鸡怎么看见它们？好。你去打扫客厅。我来做晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What are you going to make with these ingredients?
dialogue.zh: 你要用这些材料做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a plan.
dialogue.zh: 我有计划。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Okay, the apartment is clean. The kitchen is not. What are you cooking?
dialogue.zh: 好，公寓干净了。厨房没有。你在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I made my favorite recipe: peanut-butter-banana pancakes!
dialogue.zh: 我做了我最喜欢的食谱：花生酱香蕉煎饼！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: You made breakfast.
dialogue.zh: 你做了早餐。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! I call it let's-eat-breakfast-for-dinner dinner!
dialogue.zh: 是的！我叫它“晚餐吃早餐”晚餐！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna! Mmm! Hey, this tastes good! Anna, you made it work!
dialogue.zh: 安娜！嗯！嘿，这味道不错！安娜，你搞定了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That's our guests!
dialogue.zh: 客人到了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I'll answer the door.
dialogue.zh: 我去开门。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'll finish here.
dialogue.zh: 我在这儿收尾。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Like I said, sometimes Marsha worries too much. When something goes wrong with your plan, just change the plan! Till next time!
dialogue.zh: 就像我说的，有时候玛莎担心太多。计划出问题时，就换个计划！下次见！

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 37
lessons.subtitle: Let's Agree to Disagree

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, I am from the country and sometimes I miss it. But I really like life in the city! I love the city. Oh, look. Someone lost a bag. Maybe it's theirs. Excuse me. Is this bag yours?
dialogue.zh: 你知道，我来自乡下，有时会想念它。可我真的喜欢城市生活！我爱这座城市。哦，看。有人丢了一个包。也许是他们的。打扰一下。这是你的包吗？

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Jill
dialogue.en: No. It's not mine. It might be hers.
dialogue.zh: 不是。不是我的。也许是她的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me. Is this bag yours?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下。这是你的包吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: No. It's not mine. It might be his.
dialogue.zh: 不是。不是我的。也许是他的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you. Hello. Is this bag yours?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。你好。这是你的包吗？

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: Yes, that's mine. These are all my travel things. Thank you, thank you!
dialogue.zh: 是的，那是我的。这些都是我的旅行用品。谢谢，谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Are you okay? You seem ... nervous.
dialogue.zh: 你还好吗？你看起来……有点紧张。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: Well, this is my first visit to Washington, D.C. I'm from a small town in the country. I feel a little lost.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，这是我第一次来华盛顿特区。我来自乡下的一个小镇。我有点迷路。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am from the country too! And I understand. When I first came here, I felt lost ... all the time.
dialogue.zh: 我也来自乡下！我理解。我刚来这儿时，也总是觉得迷路……一直都是。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: So, do you like living in the country or in the city?
dialogue.zh: 那么，你喜欢住在乡下还是城市？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I like to live in the city.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢住在城市。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The city is exciting! It has more culture than the country. There are many museums and restaurants. Every night, there is theater and music. And, there are more jobs. That is why I'm here.
dialogue.zh: 城市很精彩！它比乡下更有文化。有很多博物馆和餐厅。每天晚上都有戏剧和音乐。而且，工作也更多。所以我才来这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: Well, I agree. There is more culture in the city and there might be more jobs. But the country has more nature! It's peaceful and beautiful. There are more trees and mountains. The air is clean. You can go hiking and camping. The city is not beautiful. It's noisy and dirty.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我同意。城市更有文化，工作也许也更多。可乡下有更多自然！它安静又美丽。树和山更多。空气干净。你可以去徒步和露营。城市不美。它又吵又脏。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I disagree. I think all the different buildings are beautiful. And I like to watch all the different people.
dialogue.zh: 我不同意。我觉得各种不同的建筑都很美。而且我喜欢看各种各样的人。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: That's another thing that is different. People in the country are friendly. They always say "hello!" Here, no one says "hello." I think city people are rude.
dialogue.zh: 还有一点不一样。乡下的人很友好。他们总是说“你好！”在这儿，没人说“你好”。我觉得城里人很没礼貌。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I agree. Country people are friendly. But I don't think city people are rude. I think they're just busy.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我同意。乡下人很友好。可我不觉得城里人没礼貌。我觉得他们只是很忙。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: That's a good point.
dialogue.zh: 说得好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Look at me. I live in the city and I said "hello" to you.
dialogue.zh: 看看我。我住在城市，还跟你说了“你好”。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: But you are from the country.
dialogue.zh: 可你来自乡下。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have an idea. Let's say "hello!" to people -- to many people!
dialogue.zh: 我有个主意。我们跟人们说“你好！”——跟很多人说！

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: What? Why?
dialogue.zh: 什么？为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, if we say "hello," maybe they will say "hello" to other people ... Hello!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，如果我们说“你好”，也许他们也会对别人说“你好”……你好！

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: ... and they will say "hello" to more people! That's a great idea! I'm glad you found my bag.
dialogue.zh: ……然后他们会对更多人说“你好”！这主意太好了！很高兴你找到了我的包。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Come on. Let's go say "hello" to people.
dialogue.zh: 来吧。我们去跟人们说“你好”。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We don't have to agree with people. They have their opinions. We have ours. And as we like to say, you can always agree to disagree! Until next time...! Hello!
dialogue.zh: 我们不必同意别人。他们有他们的看法。我们有我们的。就像我们常说的，你可以求同存异！下次见……！你好！

What does Phil like about the country?
What do Anna and Phil decide to say to people?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 38
lessons.subtitle: She's My Best Friend!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! I have great news. My best friend from my hometown is coming here -- to Washington, D.C.! I can't wait to catch up with her! Oh! I gotta go. Her train arrives in 10 minutes!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我有好消息。我家乡最好的朋友要来这儿——华盛顿特区！我等不及要跟她叙旧了！哦！我得走了。她的火车 10 分钟后到！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope!
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna! I am really happy to see you!
dialogue.zh: 安娜！见到你真开心！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me too! How was your trip?
dialogue.zh: 我也是！旅途怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: It was fine.
dialogue.zh: 还不错。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let me help you with your bags.
dialogue.zh: 我来帮你拿行李。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I'm really excited to be in Washington, D.C.! I can't wait to hear about ... everything!
dialogue.zh: 来到华盛顿特区我真的很兴奋！我等不及想听……所有的事！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have so much to tell you. Let's go to my apartment. We can talk over a hot cup of tea.
dialogue.zh: 我有好多话要跟你说。我们去我的公寓。可以边喝茶边聊。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I love your apartment building, Anna. Is your rent expensive?
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢你的公寓楼，安娜。房租贵吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I have a roommate. So, we split the rent.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我有室友。所以我们平分房租。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Oh, that's right. Is your roommate nice?
dialogue.zh: 哦，对。你的室友人好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha is the nicest person I know in this city. Sometimes she worries too much. And she says I'm the messiest cook she knows. But we are great roommates.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎是我在这座城市认识的最好的人。有时她担心太多。她还说我是她认识的最乱的厨师。不过我们是很好的室友。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: So, Anna, is it hard to make friends in D.C.?
dialogue.zh: 那么，安娜，在华盛顿特区交朋友难吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: At first it was hard. But now, Marsha is a good friend. And there's Pete. Of all the people I know in D.C., Pete is the most serious and also the silliest.
dialogue.zh: 一开始很难。但现在，玛莎是好朋友。还有皮特。在我认识的华盛顿特区的人里，皮特最认真，也最傻。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: He sounds ... interesting.
dialogue.zh: 他听起来……挺有意思。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Jonathan and Ashley are two other good friends of mine. In the city, they are the friendliest people I know. They always help me when I need it.
dialogue.zh: 乔纳森和阿什莉是我另外两个好朋友。在这座城市，他们是我认识的最友好的人。我需要时他们总是帮我。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Your friends sound great! So, tell me about your job.
dialogue.zh: 你的朋友听起来很棒！那么，跟我说说你的工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love my work! I make a children's show called the "Time Traveling Treehouse."
dialogue.zh: 我爱我的工作！我做了一个儿童节目，叫“时光旅行树屋”。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, that is the best job for you! Do you remember when we were little? We played in that old treehouse behind my family's house for hours!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，那最适合你！你还记得我们小时候吗？我们在我家后面那座旧树屋里玩好几个小时！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I forgot about that! We thought it really time traveled! It is really good to talk to you. New friends are good. But old friends are the best.
dialogue.zh: 我都忘了！我们以为它真的会时光旅行！跟你聊天真好。新朋友很好。但老朋友最好。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I know. Our hometown isn't the same now. You are not there.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。我们的家乡现在不一样了。你不在那儿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No crying. No crying. Penelope, why don't you move here and live with me and Marsha?
dialogue.zh: 别哭。别哭。佩内洛普，你为什么不搬来这儿，跟我和玛莎一起住？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, I can't leave our hometown. You forget -- I love my job, too.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我不能离开家乡。你忘了——我也爱我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I didn't forget. You are the most famous turkey farmer I know!
dialogue.zh: 我没忘。你是我认识的最有名的火鸡农场主！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Thanks, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Come on. Let's go eat dinner at one of D.C.'s most famous restaurants.
dialogue.zh: 来吧。我们去华盛顿特区最有名的餐厅之一吃晚饭。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a great apartment. I love my work. And I have awesome friends. I am the luckiest woman in Washington, D.C.
dialogue.zh: 我有很棒的公寓。我爱我的工作。我还有很棒的朋友。我是华盛顿特区最幸运的女人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time?
dialogue.zh: 下次见？

What children's show does Anna make?
What is Penelope's job?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 39
lessons.subtitle: It's Unbelievable!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Winter weather in Washington, D.C. can be really windy. And wind messes up my hair. It is really windy today. Look at my hair. Will it be windy this weekend? I'll listen to the news. I am tired of my untidy hair.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区的冬天可能很刮风。风还会弄乱我的头发。今天风真大。看看我的头发。这个周末会刮风吗？我要听新闻。我厌倦了乱糟糟的头发。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Are you tired of your untidy hair?
dialogue.zh: 你厌倦乱糟糟的头发了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, I am. And it's ... uncomfortable.
dialogue.zh: 是的。是的，我厌倦了。而且……不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Is it ... uncomfortable?
dialogue.zh: 它……不舒服吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, it is! Hey, is that ... Pete?
dialogue.zh: 是的。是的，不舒服！嘿，那是……皮特吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi. I'm Pete. And I have the perfect product for you -- Hair Be Good!
dialogue.zh: 嗨。我是皮特。我有最适合你的产品——Hair Be Good！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Just spray Hair Be Good on your hair ... wrap in a towel ... and you are done! Hair Be Good works and it's inexpensive. One can costs only $10! So, go online and order your Hair Be Good today!
dialogue.zh: 只要把 Hair Be Good 喷在头发上……用毛巾包起来……就完成了！Hair Be Good 有效，而且不贵。一罐只要 10 美元！所以，今天就上网订购你的 Hair Be Good 吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hair Be Good sounds perfect! And I can trust Pete! I am buying some right now. Okay, I will order one can of Hair Be Good for $10. I'll pay with a credit card. My delivery will arrive in 2 days. Awesome!
dialogue.zh: Hair Be Good 听起来很完美！而且我可以信任皮特！我现在就买。好，我要订一罐 10 美元的 Hair Be Good。我用信用卡付款。货会在 2 天内到。太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It arrived! I'll use it before I go to work. Okay, Hair Be Good, make my untidy hair tidy! No, make it ... fabulous!
dialogue.zh: 到了！我上班前先用。好，Hair Be Good，让我乱糟糟的头发变整齐！不，让它……美极了！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Amelia!
dialogue.zh: 你好，阿梅莉亚！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Anna, you look ... different.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你看起来……不一样。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks! I used a new product called Hair Be Good.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！我用了一种新产品，叫 Hair Be Good。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Well, it's not.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，它并不。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's not what?
dialogue.zh: 并不什么？

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Good. Your hair does not look good.
dialogue.zh: 好。你的头发看起来不好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, no! This is not good.
dialogue.zh: 哦，不！这可不好。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Why don't you go home and take care of ... this.
dialogue.zh: 你为什么不回家处理一下……这个。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good idea.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Pete.
dialogue.zh: 你好，皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Is something wrong?
dialogue.zh: 出什么事了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is wrong!
dialogue.zh: 这就有问题！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: What did you do to your hair?
dialogue.zh: 你对头发做了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hair Be Good did this to my hair.
dialogue.zh: 是 Hair Be Good 把我的头发弄成这样的。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Ah, you bought it!
dialogue.zh: 啊，你买了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I bought it. You said in your ad it was a perfect product. This is not perfect. This is imperfect!
dialogue.zh: 是的，我买了。你在广告里说它是完美产品。这不完美。这是不完美的！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It's unbelievable!
dialogue.zh: 这难以置信！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I believed your ad, Pete. It was dishonest!
dialogue.zh: 我相信了你的广告，皮特。它不诚实！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, you don't believe everything you see in ads, do you?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你不会相信广告里看到的一切，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, Pete. Just the ones with my friends.
dialogue.zh: 不会，皮特。只相信有我朋友的那些。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Your hair will be okay. Just wash it ... a couple of times.
dialogue.zh: 你的头发会没事的。只要洗一洗……洗几次。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks. Thanks a lot, Pete! Here, here's your product! You should call it "Hair Be Really, Really Bad!" Until next time, Pete! Till next time.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。非常感谢，皮特！给，这是你的产品！你该叫它“头发真的、真的很糟”！下次见，皮特！下次见。

How much does one can cost?
What does Anna say about Pete's ad?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 40
lessons.subtitle: The Woods Are Alive

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Happy New Year! Some people, at the start of a new year, make a resolution -- a promise to yourself to be better. I thought about my resolution carefully. I want to be an actor on the stage! Today I will audition for a show called "The Woods Are Alive!" Wish me luck!
dialogue.zh: 新年快乐！有些人在新年开始时会立下决心——对自己承诺要做得更好。我认真想过我的决心。我想当舞台演员！今天我要去试镜一部叫“树林活了！”的戏。祝我好运！

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Next! What is your name?
dialogue.zh: 下一位！你叫什么名字？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My name is Anna Matteo.
dialogue.zh: 我叫安娜·马泰奥。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Are you ready to audition?
dialogue.zh: 你准备好试镜了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 准备好了。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Great. Let's begin on page 1. Here is the story. You are lost in the woods. You are searching desperately for a way out. Suddenly, you hear something.
dialogue.zh: 很好。我们从第 1 页开始。故事是这样的。你在树林里迷路了。你拼命找出路。突然，你听到了什么。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Now, say your line.
dialogue.zh: 现在，说你的台词。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 'What was that? Hello. Is someone there?'
dialogue.zh: “那是什么？你好。有人在吗？”

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Anna, you are speaking too softly. Can you speak more loudly and a little more, um, seriously?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你说得太轻了。你能说大声一点，再稍微……嗯，严肃一点吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, of course I can. 'What was that? Hello. Is someone there?' Is that loud enough?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。‘那是什么？你好。有人在吗？’这样够大声吗？

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Yes, that is loud enough. Let's turn to page 25. In this scene, you are moving slowly and quietly through the woods.
dialogue.zh: 够了。我们翻到第 25 页。这场戏里，你慢慢地、悄悄地穿过树林。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Anna. Anna! You are walking quickly and loudly. Walk slowly and quietly.
dialogue.zh: 安娜。安娜！你走得又快又响。慢慢走，悄悄走。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm walking slowly and quietly. I am walking…
dialogue.zh: 我在慢慢地、悄悄地走。我在走……

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Anna. Anna. You don't need to say "slowly" and "quietly." Alright, let's try the last scene. Turn to page 48. I say my line first, then you say your line.
dialogue.zh: 安娜。安娜。你不用把“慢慢地”和“悄悄地”说出来。好，我们试最后一场。翻到第 48 页。我先说台词，然后你再说。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: 'You will never get out of these woods alive! Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha!'
dialogue.zh: “你永远走不出这片树林！哇哈哈哈哈 哇哈哈哈哈！”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 'Yes, I will.'
dialogue.zh: “不，我会的。”

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Okay, Anna, you said that line -- you said that line really late. You need to say it earlier.
dialogue.zh: 好，安娜，你那句台词——你说得太晚了。你得说早一点。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry. Sorry. Let me try again.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。抱歉。让我再试一次。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: 'You will never …'
dialogue.zh: “你永远……”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 'Yes, I will.'
dialogue.zh: “不，我会的。”

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: '… get out of the woods alive.'
dialogue.zh: “……走不出这片树林。”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I was too early, wasn't I?
dialogue.zh: 我太早了，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, you were.
dialogue.zh: 对。对，太早了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Director, how am I doing?
dialogue.zh: 导演，我表现得怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: You know, Anna. I think that I have the perfect part for you.
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，安娜。我想我有一个最适合你的角色。

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: The costume is in the back. Please go try it on.
dialogue.zh: 服装在后面。请去试穿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Director
dialogue.en: Oh, Anna, that fits you perfectly!
dialogue.zh: 哦，安娜，这套太适合你了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm a tree. I'm a tree in … "The Woods Are Alive!" Yes!
dialogue.zh: 我是一棵树。我是“树林活了！”里的一棵树！太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My new year is starting awesomely! Excuse me, Director! I have a great idea for my tree. Oh, wait! Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 我的新年开始得真棒！打扰一下，导演！我对我的树有个好主意。哦，等一下！下次见！

choices: To be an actor on the stage

What part does Anna get?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 41
lessons.subtitle: Teamwork Works Best With a Team

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi. I am walking to work. Today my boss will tell me what she thinks of my work. Is it good? Or is it bad? Okay, time for work. I am going right now. Okay, okay, I'm going!
dialogue.zh: 嗨。我正走去上班。今天老板会告诉我她对我工作的看法。是好？还是不好？好，该上班了。我现在就去。好，好，我走了！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna, hello.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello.
dialogue.zh: 你好。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Sit down. As you know, at the start of a new year we have a work review.
dialogue.zh: 坐下。你知道，新年开始时我们会做工作评估。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. It's time for mine.
dialogue.zh: 是的。该轮到我了。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yes. Anna, this chart shows the audience of The Time Traveling Treehouse. If you look at it, you will see something bad. Your audience is going down, down, DOWN!
dialogue.zh: 对。安娜，这张图显示“时光旅行树屋”的观众。如果你看它，你会看到不好的东西。你的观众在往下、往下、往下！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver, I think the chart is upside down.
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士，我觉得这张图是倒的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here, let's flip that around. Now, it's right-side up.
dialogue.zh: 来，我们把它翻过来。现在是正的了。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Oh. If you look at this chart, you will see something good. Your audience is big.
dialogue.zh: 哦。如果你看这张图，你会看到好的东西。你的观众很多。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: But not big enough.
dialogue.zh: 可还不够多。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Not good.
dialogue.zh: 不好。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: I want to see these numbers go up, and up, and UP!
dialogue.zh: 我希望这些数字往上、往上、往上！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How?
dialogue.zh: 怎么做？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: I have something -- idea posters!
dialogue.zh: 我有东西——点子海报！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Idea posters.
dialogue.zh: 点子海报。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: You really ought to think seriously about them. I like this one. Please read it.
dialogue.zh: 你真的应该认真想想它们。我喜欢这一张。请读一下。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: "If at first you SUCCEED; you will be a success." Well, it's a cute cat.
dialogue.zh: “如果一开始你就成功，你就会成功。”嗯，是只可爱的猫。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Here's another one. I like it.
dialogue.zh: 还有一张。我喜欢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: "WORKING HARD looks hard because it really is hard." I see. It's another cute cat.
dialogue.zh: “努力看起来很难，因为它真的很难。”我明白了。又是一只可爱的猫。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: This is my favorite.
dialogue.zh: 这是我最喜欢的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: "TEAMWORK works best with a team." A team of cats. Look at all those cats!
dialogue.zh: “团队合作最好要有一个团队。”一队猫。看看那些猫！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: So, Anna, do you understand what I want?
dialogue.zh: 那么，安娜，你明白我想要什么了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, Ms. Weaver. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 明白，韦弗女士。我明白了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, team. There is a problem in the Treehouse.
dialogue.zh: 好，团队。树屋有个问题。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Problem? What's the problem?
dialogue.zh: 问题？什么问题？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Our audience is big.
dialogue.zh: 我们的观众很多。

dialogue.speaker: Bryan
dialogue.en: But that's a good thing.
dialogue.zh: 可那是好事啊。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, it is not big enough.
dialogue.zh: 不，还不够多。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Please don't worry. I know what Ms. Weaver wants. Here's the plan.
dialogue.zh: 请别担心。我知道韦弗女士想要什么。计划是这样的。

dialogue.speaker: Bryan
dialogue.en: Is that what she wants?
dialogue.zh: 她想要的是这个吗？

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Are you sure?
dialogue.zh: 你确定吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Let's get to work!
dialogue.zh: 确定。我们开始干活吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good job, team. This is exactly what Ms. Weaver wants!
dialogue.zh: 干得好，团队。这正是韦弗女士想要的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Welcome to The Time Traveling Treehouse! Today you will learn about a very popular pet … cats!
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来到时光旅行树屋！今天你们会了解一种很受欢迎的宠物……猫！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Anna. Did I give you enough cats?
dialogue.zh: 安娜。我给你的猫够多吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't know, MINDY. I think we need more cats!
dialogue.zh: 我不知道，MINDY。我觉得我们还需要更多猫！

quiz.prompt: What does the chart show after Anna flips it?
What is Ms. Weaver's favorite poster about?
What does Anna put in The Time Traveling Treehouse?
