lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 6
lessons.subtitle: Will It Float?

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, thanks for taking me on a tour of D.C. today.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，谢谢你今天带我游览华盛顿特区。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure thing, Penelope. You are new to town. And a tour is the best way to see more of the city!
dialogue.zh: 没问题，佩内洛普。你刚到这座城市。游览是多看这座城市最好的办法！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: So, which tour are we taking – the one that goes through the city on a bus? Or the one that goes along the river in a boat?
dialogue.zh: 那我们参加哪个游览——坐巴士穿过城市的那个？还是坐船沿河走的那个？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Both!
dialogue.zh: 两个都要！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: What? Anna, this isn’t going to be one of those trips, is it?
dialogue.zh: 什么？安娜，这不会又是那种行程吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. Follow me.
dialogue.zh: 不是。跟我来。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: In this lesson, you are going to hear lots of prepositions! What’s a preposition, you ask? It’s a word that shows relationships between things. Anna says they are going on a tour through the city and along the river. Through and along are both prepositions. Watch for more!
dialogue.zh: 这一课你会听到很多介词！介词是什么？它是表示事物之间关系的词。安娜说她们要参加穿过城市、沿着河边的游览。through 和 along 都是介词。继续找更多！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, Penelope, there’s our ride!
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，那就是我们的车！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: What is it?
dialogue.zh: 那是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s the famous DC Ducks -- the boat with wheels! We will ride on the road and then sail on the water!
dialogue.zh: 是著名的 DC Ducks——带轮子的船！我们先在路上开，再在水上航行！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Who thinks of these things?
dialogue.zh: 谁会想出这种东西来？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't know. But I’m glad they do! Let’s get aboard, Sailor!
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。不过我很高兴有人想出来！上船吧，水手！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: (looking at a brochure about the boat) Hey, did you know that this bus … um, boat was created during World War II to carry people and supplies?
dialogue.zh: （看着关于这艘船的手册）嘿，你知道这辆巴士……呃，这艘船是二战时造来运人和物资的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow. You know, a tour is so much more interesting with Fun Facts, like that one.
dialogue.zh: 哇。有这样的趣闻，游览就有趣多了。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I agree. I love Fun Facts!
dialogue.zh: 我同意。我超爱趣闻！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Did I hear you say you love Fun Facts?
dialogue.zh: 我是不是听到你们说喜欢趣闻？

dialogue.speaker: Anna & Penelope
dialogue.en: Yeah.
dialogue.zh: 对啊。

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Well, I have tons of Fun Facts for this tour!
dialogue.zh: 这次游览我有超多趣闻！

dialogue.speaker: Anna & Penelope
dialogue.en: Great!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, where are his parents?
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，他父母在哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Maybe - maybe he’s the Captain’s son and he helps his dad on tours!
dialogue.zh: 也许——也许他是船长的儿子，帮爸爸做游览！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh yeah! It would be so awesome to ride around the city in a boat all day with your dad!
dialogue.zh: 对哦！整天和爸爸坐船在城里转，也太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: This is amazing, Anna. There are so many beautiful buildings along this road!
dialogue.zh: 太美了，安娜。这条路两边有好多漂亮的建筑！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey, the Washington Monument is on the left!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，华盛顿纪念碑在左边！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I have a Fun Fact too! Did you know that the Washington Monument was damaged in an earthquake? Whoa. Did you feel that?! I heard: "around the city in a boat," "along this road" and "on the left." All of these are prepositions showing place. Let's watch for more places and prepositions!
dialogue.zh: 我也有一条趣闻！你知道华盛顿纪念碑在地震中受损过吗？哇。你感觉到了吗？！我听到了：around the city in a boat、along this road 和 on the left。这些都是表示地点的介词。再找更多地点和介词！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Look, Anna, we’re across from the White House!
dialogue.zh: 看，安娜，我们在白宫对面！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, the only thing between us and the President is the street … and a park … and a security gate .... and police officers … with guns.
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，我们和总统之间只隔着这条街……还有一座公园……还有安检门……还有警察……带着枪。

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Excuse me, do you want to know a Fun Fact about the White House?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，想听一条关于白宫的趣闻吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna & Penelope
dialogue.en: Yes!
dialogue.zh: 想！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Inside the White House there is a swimming pool, a movie theater and 32 bathrooms!
dialogue.zh: 白宫里面有一个游泳池、一个电影院，还有 32 间浴室！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Thirty-two bathrooms! That’s a lot of bathrooms!
dialogue.zh: 三十二间浴室！也太多了！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: I’d be happy with two. I live in a house with my mom, four sisters, two aunts and only one bathroom!
dialogue.zh: 有两间我就满足了。我和妈妈、四个姐姐、两个阿姨住在一起，却只有一间浴室！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Oh my! You know, Anna, we should give him a tip!
dialogue.zh: 天哪！安娜，我们应该给他小费！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Of course! It is polite to tip your tour guide! Luckily, I have lots of dollar bills!
dialogue.zh: 当然！给导游小费是礼貌！幸好我带了很多美元钞票！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: That was a great Fun Fact! Here you go!
dialogue.zh: 这条趣闻太棒了！给你！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Thank you! I can tell you Fun Facts all day!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！我可以给你们讲一整天趣闻！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you hear any more prepositions of place? I heard "between us and the president," "inside the White House" and "in a house." And did you hear that the Duck Boat can go on the river? I don't believe it. Join us next time to find out which preposition we will use: The boat went ON the river or The boat went INTO the river?
dialogue.zh: 你还听到更多地点介词了吗？我听到了 between us and the president、inside the White House 和 in a house。你听到鸭子船能开到河上吗？我不信。下次再看我们用哪个介词：The boat went ON the river，还是 The boat went INTO the river？

quiz.prompt: What kind of tour do Anna and Penelope take?
choices: The DC Ducks — a boat with wheels
A walking tour of the White House

quiz.prompt: What Fun Fact does the boy give about the White House?
choices: It is across from Union Station

quiz.prompt: Why do Anna and Penelope give the boy money?
choices: He is the captain of the boat
It is polite to tip your tour guide

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 7
lessons.subtitle: Tip Your Tour Guide

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Welcome back! Anna and Penelope are taking a tour with DC Ducks. In this lesson, we are looking for prepositions. Listen for in, on, at, under and over - some important prepositions of place.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎回来！安娜和佩内洛普正在坐 DC Ducks 游览。这一课我们找介词。注意听 in、on、at、under 和 over——这些重要的地点介词。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, the Lincoln Memorial is coming up on your left!
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，林肯纪念堂马上出现在你左边！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: You’re going to love my Lincoln Memorial Fun Fact!
dialogue.zh: 你们一定会喜欢我这条林肯纪念堂趣闻！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, please tell us!
dialogue.zh: 哦，快告诉我们！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: On a wall inside the memorial, the word “FUTURE” was carved wrong! They carved “EUTURE”!
dialogue.zh: 纪念堂里面的墙上，“FUTURE”这个词刻错了！他们刻成了“EUTURE”！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, we all make mistakes.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，谁都会犯错。

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Yeah, but this mistake was carved in stone!
dialogue.zh: 对，可这个错误是刻在石头上的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You’re right. That is pretty bad. Here’s another dollar!
dialogue.zh: 你说得对。那确实挺糟。再给你一美元！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: More fun facts, please! (Crossing the river) I love riding over bridges! The water looks so pretty from here!
dialogue.zh: 再来点趣闻！（过河）我喜欢从桥上过去！从这儿看水面好漂亮！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, this is amazing! A minute ago, we were riding along the river, and now we’re riding in the river! Awesome.
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，太神奇了！一分钟前我们还沿着河边走，现在我们在河里开！太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Hey, we’re passing by the Pentagon on our right!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，我们右边正经过五角大楼！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, you love riding over the water on a bridge. But I love riding under a bridge in a boat!
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，你喜欢从桥上过水面。可我喜欢坐船从桥下过！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, look! An airplane is flying right over our heads!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，看！一架飞机正好从我们头顶飞过！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow! This is the closest I’ve ever been to an airplane in flight. Well, I’ve been inside a flying airplane. But not outside of an airplane as it flies over my head!
dialogue.zh: 哇！这是我离飞行中的飞机最近的一次。嗯，我坐过飞行中的飞机里面。但从来没在飞机外面，看它从我头顶飞过！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: And now we’re driving out of the water. I still can’t believe this thing drives and sails!
dialogue.zh: 现在我们正从水里开出来。我还是不敢相信这东西既能开又能航行！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know. It’s amazing.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。太神奇了。

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: After we ride along these railroad tracks, you’ll see my favorite part of the tour! The U.S. Treasury where they make money!
dialogue.zh: 沿这些铁轨走过后，你们会看到我最喜欢的一段！美国财政部，他们在那儿印钱！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: That young man is making a lot of money, too. Did you hear these prepositions? On your left, on our right, in the river, over bridges, over our heads, over my head, on a bridge. As you watch more, look for 'inside' and 'outside.'
dialogue.zh: 那个小伙子也赚了不少钱。你听到这些介词了吗？on your left、on our right、in the river、over bridges、over our heads、over my head、on a bridge。接着看时，找找 inside 和 outside。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Look, the U.S. Capitol is coming up!
dialogue.zh: 看，美国国会大厦出现了！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: I have a great Fun Fact about the U.S. Capitol.
dialogue.zh: 我有一条关于国会大厦的超棒趣闻。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: What is it?
dialogue.zh: 是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: There are tunnels under the Capitol. They connect the Capitol and office buildings of lawmakers.
dialogue.zh: 国会大厦下面有隧道。它们连接国会大厦和议员的办公楼。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I bet they built them years ago for secret reasons!
dialogue.zh: 我敢说他们多年前是为了秘密原因才建的！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: No. The lawmakers did not want to walk around outside in bad weather.
dialogue.zh: 不是。议员们不想在坏天气里在外面走。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh.
dialogue.zh: 哦。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: We’re back at Union Station!
dialogue.zh: 我们回到联合车站了！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Do you want to know a creepy Fun Fact about Union Station? (he points to Union Station)
dialogue.zh: 想听一条关于联合车站的诡异趣闻吗？（他指着联合车站）

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: The creepier the better!
dialogue.zh: 越诡异越好！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Many years ago, inside Union Station, there was a funeral home!
dialogue.zh: 很多年前，联合车站里面有一家殡仪馆！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A funeral home?! You mean, for dead people?!
dialogue.zh: 殡仪馆？！你是说，给死人用的？！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Do you know another kind of funeral home?
dialogue.zh: 你还知道别的那种殡仪馆吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No!
dialogue.zh: 不知道！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Well, I’ve gotta run!
dialogue.zh: 好了，我得走了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks for giving us the great tour!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你给我们做了这么棒的讲解！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Captain, that was awesome! And your son is a great tour guide!
dialogue.zh: 船长，太棒了！你儿子是个很棒的导游！

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.en: What son?
dialogue.zh: 什么儿子？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Him.
dialogue.zh: 他啊。

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.en: I’ve never seen that boy in my life! See ya, ladies!
dialogue.zh: 我这辈子从没见过那个男孩！再见，女士们！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I learned many new Fun Facts in this lesson. Did you learn about prepositions? Here’s a list of all the prepositions used in this lesson. Wow! That’s a lot! I know, let’s not read them. Let’s sing them!
dialogue.zh: 这一课我学到很多新趣闻。你学到介词了吗？这里列出了本课用到的所有介词。哇！真多！我知道，咱们别念了。唱出来吧！

quiz.prompt: What was carved wrong inside the Lincoln Memorial?
choices: The word FUTURE was carved as EUTURE

quiz.prompt: Why were tunnels built under the U.S. Capitol?
choices: So lawmakers would not walk outside in bad weather

quiz.prompt: Who is the boy who told the Fun Facts?
choices: A boy the captain has never seen

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 8
lessons.subtitle: The Best Barbecue

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks for meeting me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你来见我。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Sure.
dialogue.zh: 当然。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’d like to get your advice on my latest project.
dialogue.zh: 我想听听你对我最新项目的建议。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Of course. I heard you were sent to cover a big food festival that has all kinds of barbecue. So, how did it go?
dialogue.zh: 当然。我听说你被派去报道一个有各种烧烤的大型美食节。怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, things started out great! But then, well, maybe you should watch it yourself.
dialogue.zh: 一开始挺顺利！可后来……也许你自己看吧。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Hi English learners! Your lesson today is about my favorite food -- barbecue! Your assignment is to find passive sentences. What are those, you might ask? In passive sentences the subject receives the action! For example, “Anna was sent to cover a food festival.” Passive sentences have a form of the BE verb + the past participle of the main verb. This lesson is LOADED with passive sentences. Hey! That’s a passive sentence, too! Okay, now, it’s Barbecue Time!
dialogue.zh: 英语学习者你们好！今天这一课是我最爱的食物——烧烤！你的任务是找出被动句。被动句里，主语是动作的承受者！例如：“Anna was sent to cover a food festival.” 被动句用 be 动词加上主要动词的过去分词。这一课装满了被动句。嘿！这也是被动句！好，现在是烧烤时间！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, a Barbecue Battle is being held in Washington, D.C. This festival, which is known as one of the biggest food festivals in the United States, brings together barbecue lovers from all over the country! Barbecue is meat that is cooked over an open fire or on a grill.
dialogue.zh: 今天，华盛顿特区正在举办烧烤大战。这个节日被称为美国最大的美食节之一，把全国的烧烤爱好者聚在一起！烧烤是在明火上或烤架上烹制的肉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Chicken, pork and beef are all common meats to grill on a barbecue! No matter which meat you like to barbecue, the sauce is very important. Sauces are taken very seriously by chefs. Most ingredients are kept secret!
dialogue.zh: 鸡肉、猪肉和牛肉都是常见的烧烤肉！不管你爱烤哪种肉，酱汁都非常重要。厨师对待酱汁非常认真。大多数配料都是保密的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, can you tell us what is in your barbecue sauce?
dialogue.zh: 那你能告诉我们你的烧烤酱里有什么吗？

dialogue.speaker: Chef 1
dialogue.en: No, I can’t tell you.
dialogue.zh: 不，我不能告诉你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, tell us, what is the secret ingredient in your barbecue sauce?
dialogue.zh: 那告诉我们，你烧烤酱里的秘密配料是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Chef 2
dialogue.en: (says nothing.)
dialogue.zh: （什么也不说。）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sauces are made by the barbecue chefs themselves. Most sauces are made with a tomato sauce, vinegar, and spices.
dialogue.zh: 酱汁是烧烤厨师自己做的。大多数酱汁用番茄酱、醋和香料做成。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: How many passive sentences did you find? Here is one I found: Today, a Barbecue Battle is being held on the National Mall in Washington, D.C. Now you try. Turn this sentence from active to passive. Professor Bot loves Barbecue! Barbecue is loved by Prof. Bot. Good job! And yes, I do.
dialogue.zh: 你找到多少被动句了？我找到一句：Today, a Barbecue Battle is being held on the National Mall in Washington, D.C. 现在你来试试。把这句从主动变成被动。Professor Bot loves Barbecue! Barbecue is loved by Prof. Bot. 干得好！没错，我就是爱烧烤。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are some areas of the U.S. that are known for their tasty barbecue. The states of Texas, North and South Carolina and the cities of Memphis and Kansas City are known as the Barbecue Belt.
dialogue.zh: 美国有些地方以美味烧烤闻名。得克萨斯州、北卡和南卡，以及孟菲斯和堪萨斯城，被称为烧烤带。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: People who are loyal to barbecue are really loyal to their favorite barbecue. That is why this festival is called a battle! Let’s ask a couple of people which barbecue is best.
dialogue.zh: 对烧烤忠实的人，对自己最爱的烧烤也特别忠实。所以这个节日才叫大战！我们问问几个人哪种烧烤最好。

dialogue.speaker: Person 1
dialogue.en: Texas, of course!
dialogue.zh: 当然是得州！

dialogue.speaker: Person 2
dialogue.en: Carolina barbecue is the very best.
dialogue.zh: 卡罗来纳烧烤才是最好的。

dialogue.speaker: Person 3
dialogue.en: Kansas City!
dialogue.zh: 堪萨斯城！

dialogue.speaker: Person 4
dialogue.en: Memphis style!
dialogue.zh: 孟菲斯风味！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is Anna Matteo reporting.
dialogue.zh: 这里是安娜·马特奥报道。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Kelly, people feel so strongly about barbecue. Unbelievable! So, what do you think of my project?
dialogue.zh: 凯莉，人们对烧烤的感情也太强烈了。难以置信！那你觉得我的项目怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: This is what I think. There is no way that Texas has the best barbecue. I am from Kansas City and we have THE best barbecue in the whole country. My mother and father owned a barbecue restaurant, which was really famous! So, I know barbecue! Anna, I know barbecue! I know barbecue! I know barbecue!
dialogue.zh: 我是这么想的。得州绝不可能有最好的烧烤。我来自堪萨斯城，我们才有全国最好的烧烤。我爸妈开过一家烧烤店，非常有名！所以我懂烧烤！安娜，我懂烧烤！我懂烧烤！我懂烧烤！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Oh my. Kelly knows a lot about barbecue! And you know more about passive sentences! Be sure you go to the website to learn even more! Ah! Now, if you'll excuse me .. I'm hungry.
dialogue.zh: 天哪。凯莉对烧烤很懂！你对被动句也更懂了！一定要去网站再学更多！啊！失陪一下……我饿了。

quiz.prompt: What story is Anna sent to cover?
choices: A pet contest at the state fair
A tour of the Lincoln Memorial

quiz.prompt: What do the chefs keep secret?
choices: The ingredients in their barbecue sauce

quiz.prompt: Which barbecue does Kelly say is the best?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 9
lessons.subtitle: Pets Are Family, Too!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Hey, Anna! How was your weekend?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜！周末过得怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It was great! I went to the D.C. State Fair.
dialogue.zh: 很棒！我去了华盛顿特区集市。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I would have gone, but I was busy. How was it?
dialogue.zh: 我本来想去，可是太忙了。怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It was awesome! I won first place in a pet contest!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我在宠物比赛里得了第一名！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: But, you don’t have a pet, do you?
dialogue.zh: 可是，你没有宠物，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes and no. What do you mean by “pet”?
dialogue.zh: 又有又没有。你说的“宠物”是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: A pet is an animal that lives with you. People love their pets. Ashley said, "You don’t have a pet, do you?" She used a tag question, a small question at the end of a sentence. Let's look for more of them!
dialogue.zh: 宠物是和你住在一起的动物。人们很爱自己的宠物。阿什莉说：“You don’t have a pet, do you?” 她用了反意疑问句，就是句子末尾的小问句。我们再找更多！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Look, a pet! Who’s this cute little dog?
dialogue.zh: 看，一只宠物！这只可爱的小狗是谁？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Oh, right. You haven’t met my dog, have you? This is Dublin.
dialogue.zh: 对哦。你还没见过我的狗，对吧？这是都柏林。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Dublin! Nice to meet you. He’s so cute!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，都柏林！很高兴认识你。它好可爱！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Thanks! So, tell me about the state fair.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！那跟我说说集市吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, there were the usual things -- fair food, cute babies, music. But there must have been a dozen different contests! And some were pretty strange.
dialogue.zh: 哦，都是些常见的东西——集市小吃、可爱的宝宝、音乐。可比赛大概有十来种！有的还挺奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There was a contest to see who could spit a watermelon seed the farthest. You should have seen all the people who wanted to spit a watermelon seed! And, it was pretty fun to watch. But Ashley, the pet contests were the best. There was a pet parade. Lots of people walked with their dogs.
dialogue.zh: 有一项比赛看谁能把西瓜籽吐得最远。你真该看看那么多人想吐西瓜籽！看起来也挺好玩。可阿什莉，宠物比赛才是最棒的。有宠物游行。很多人牵着狗走。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: That sounds so fun. But Anna, tell me, how did you win a pet contest without a pet?
dialogue.zh: 听起来好好玩。可安娜，告诉我，你没有宠物怎么赢了宠物比赛？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, the closest thing I have is my pet rock.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我最接近宠物的东西是我的宠物石头。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know it’s silly, but I’ve had it since I was a little girl. So, for a joke, I brought it to the fair. But then I was invited to enter the “One-of-Kind Pet” contest. And I won! (holds up first place ribbon)
dialogue.zh: 我知道这很傻，可我从小就有它。所以我开玩笑把它带到集市。后来我被邀请参加“独一无二宠物”比赛。然后我赢了！（举起第一名缎带）

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, only you could have won a pet contest with a pet rock. I should have brought Dublin. He would’ve won a contest!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，也就只有你能用宠物石头赢宠物比赛。我该带都柏林去。它一定会赢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s not very easy to win one of these. (shows her the blue ribbon) Does he have a costume?
dialogue.zh: 要赢这种可不容易。（给她看蓝绶带）它有服装吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They had a costume contest. You should have seen this little girl. She and her dog wore matching princess costumes!
dialogue.zh: 他们有服装比赛。你真该看看那个小女孩。她和她的狗穿了配套的公主装！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Dublin doesn’t wear costumes.
dialogue.zh: 都柏林不穿衣服。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Does he know any tricks?
dialogue.zh: 它会什么把戏吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Come this way. Now, watch this. (Dublin chases a toy)
dialogue.zh: 这边来。看好了。（都柏林去追玩具）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You caught it, Dublin! And you killed it! Good dog! Ashley, he could have won the Best Catch contest! Aw, good boy! Ashley, pets are fun, aren’t they?
dialogue.zh: 你抓住了，都柏林！还把它咬扁了！好狗！阿什莉，它本来可以赢“最佳接球”比赛！啊，好孩子！阿什莉，宠物很有趣，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Yes. And they become part of your family. (she drinks from her Dublin mug)
dialogue.zh: 对。它们会成为家人的一部分。（她用都柏林杯子喝水）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley, I think I want a dog. No. I know I want a dog!
dialogue.zh: 阿什莉，我觉得我想要一只狗。不。我确定我想要一只狗！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: It’s a big responsibility. You may want to spend time with a dog first.
dialogue.zh: 这是很大的责任。你也许该先花时间和狗待在一起。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is a great idea. But where can I find a dog?
dialogue.zh: 这主意太好了。可我上哪儿找狗呢？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: You know, Anna, I have some shopping to do. Do you want to watch Dublin for a couple of hours?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我有点东西要买。你愿意帮我看几个小时都柏林吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! I would! I will take very good care of him!
dialogue.zh: 愿意！我会好好照顾它！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I know you will. Here’s his leash.
dialogue.zh: 我知道你会的。这是它的绳子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: (to Dublin) Okay, I'll miss you!
dialogue.zh: （对都柏林）好，我会想你的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Aw. I don’t want you to be lonely. Here, Rocky can stay with you. (puts pet rock on wall)
dialogue.zh: 啊。我不想让你孤单。来，洛基可以陪你。（把宠物石头放在墙上）

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, I really don’t need … Okay. Thanks, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我其实不需要……好吧。谢谢，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure. Bye, Ashley. (to Dublin) Come on, Dublin! Bye, Rocky!
dialogue.zh: 当然。再见，阿什莉。（对都柏林）走吧，都柏林！再见，洛基！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Bye!
dialogue.zh: 再见！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna’s rock is cute, isn’t it? Oh, there is another tag question! You found some more, didn’t you? "You haven’t met my dog, have you?" Go to the VOA Learning English website to learn more.
dialogue.zh: 安娜的石头很可爱，对吧？哦，又一个反意疑问句！你又找到一些了，对吧？“You haven’t met my dog, have you?” 去美国之音英语学习网站了解更多。

quiz.prompt: Where did Anna go over the weekend?
How did Anna win a pet contest?
What does Ashley ask Anna to do?
choices: Watch Dublin for a couple of hours

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 10
lessons.subtitle: Visit to Peru

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Bruna! What’s up?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，布鲁娜！怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: I thought we could meet for lunch today.
dialogue.zh: 我本来想今天一起吃午饭。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I wish I could, but I can’t. I have to research Peru for a story.
dialogue.zh: 我也希望可以，可是不行。我得为一篇报道研究秘鲁。

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: How’s it going?
dialogue.zh: 进展怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Not so good. I’ve been reading about Peru and listening to Peruvian music. I really want to understand Peru. I hope it's enough.
dialogue.zh: 不太好。我一直在读关于秘鲁的资料，听秘鲁音乐。我真的想了解秘鲁。希望这些够了。

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: You should visit Peru.
dialogue.zh: 你应该去秘鲁看看。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I wish!
dialogue.zh: 我也想啊！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: You can!
dialogue.zh: 你可以！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Bruna, I don’t have the money or time to go to Peru. My deadline is tomorrow!
dialogue.zh: 布鲁娜，我没钱也没时间去秘鲁。截稿日期是明天！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: No, I don’t mean to really go there. The museum where I work is having a Peruvian festival today! …. Anna? Anna? Anna, are you there?
dialogue.zh: 不，我不是说真的去那儿。我工作的博物馆今天有秘鲁节！……安娜？安娜？安娜，你还在吗？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Hello again! Professor Bot here. Today we will hear about wishes and hopes. Bruna asked Anna to go to lunch, but she answered, "I wish I could, but I can’t." Listen for more hope and wish sentences.
dialogue.zh: 又见面了！我是机器人教授。今天我们会听到愿望和希望。布鲁娜约安娜吃午饭，可她回答：“I wish I could, but I can’t.” 再听听更多 hope 和 wish 的句子。

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Bruna! Thanks for telling me about this event.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，布鲁娜！谢谢你告诉我这个活动。

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Sure! It's much better than staring at your computer. I hope it helps with your story.
dialogue.zh: 当然！这比盯着电脑好多了。希望对你的报道有帮助。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m sure it will. So, what should we see first?
dialogue.zh: 肯定会的。那我们先看什么？

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Dance and music are very important to Peruvian culture, so let’s watch the dancers.
dialogue.zh: 舞蹈和音乐对秘鲁文化很重要，所以我们去看舞者吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great! Let’s go!
dialogue.zh: 好！走吧！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: There's this very special Peruvian dance called Marinera Norteña.
dialogue.zh: 有一种非常特别的秘鲁舞蹈，叫 Marinera Norteña。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love the Marinera Nortina… !
dialogue.zh: 我爱 Marinera Nortina……！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Marinera Norteña.
dialogue.zh: 是 Marinera Norteña。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marinera Norten… ?
dialogue.zh: Marinera Norten……？

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: No. Marinera Norteña.
dialogue.zh: 不对。是 Marinera Norteña。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love the … marriage dance!
dialogue.zh: 我爱……结婚舞！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Bruna, I read about this dance. But it is much more romantic in person!
dialogue.zh: 布鲁娜，我读过这种舞。可现场看浪漫多了！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: The dancers are giving lessons after their performance. You should try it!
dialogue.zh: 舞者表演后会教课。你应该试试！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’d love to. But I’m not ready to get married. I mean, one day I hope to meet the right guy. We’ll buy matching motorcycles and ride into the sunset -- the wind blowing through our hair!
dialogue.zh: 我很想。可我还没准备好结婚。我是说，有一天我希望遇到对的人。我们会买配套的摩托车，骑向夕阳——风吹过我们的头发！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Anna, the dance just shows the courtship tradition. It doesn’t mean you will get married.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，这支舞只是表现求爱传统。并不表示你会结婚。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Well, I’ll try anyway.
dialogue.zh: 哦。那我还是试试吧。

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Don’t forget. This festival also shows Peruvian art!
dialogue.zh: 别忘了。这个节也有秘鲁艺术！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I hope I have time to see everything!
dialogue.zh: 希望我有时间看完所有东西！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Anna, I wish I could join you. But I have some work to do.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我也希望能陪你。可我还有工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Of course, of course. You go back to work. I’ll check out the art.
dialogue.zh: 当然，当然。你回去工作。我去看看艺术。

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Okay, I’m hoping to finish in about an hour. Let’s meet then.
dialogue.zh: 好，我希望大约一小时后做完。到时候见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great. See you then!
dialogue.zh: 好。到时候见！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: See ya!
dialogue.zh: 再见！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you notice any sentences with hope or wish? Anna says, “One day I hope to meet the right guy.” That’s an example of using “hope” with an infinitive to talk about doing something in the future. Keep watching!
dialogue.zh: 你注意到带 hope 或 wish 的句子了吗？安娜说：“One day I hope to meet the right guy.” 这是用 hope 加不定式谈论将来要做的事。继续看！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, wow! I can make my own Peruvian art!
dialogue.zh: 哇！我可以做自己的秘鲁艺术！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Anna, how’s it going?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Bruna!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，布鲁娜！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: You know you're in the kid's section, right?
dialogue.zh: 你知道你在儿童区，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm in the art making section.
dialogue.zh: 我在做艺术的区域。

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: I see that. Your art is very nice. I wish I could do art like that.
dialogue.zh: 我看出来了。你的作品很不错。我也希望能做出那样的艺术。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, this one’s not mine. This is mine.
dialogue.zh: 哦，这个不是我的。这个才是我的。

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Wow! Really? That's really nice!
dialogue.zh: 哇！真的吗？真的很好看！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks! And thanks for telling me about this festival. I learned so much about Peru. Ooh, we still have time!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！也谢谢你告诉我这个节。我学到好多关于秘鲁的东西。哦，我们还有时间！

dialogue.speaker: Bruna
dialogue.en: Time for what?
dialogue.zh: 做什么的时间？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Time for Marinera Norteña!
dialogue.zh: 跳 Marinera Norteña 的时间！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Do you remember what Anna said? “I really want to understand Peru.” I hope you understand Peru a little better now, too. And I wish I could talk with you more about grammar, but that’s all the time we have today! Go to the website to learn more!
dialogue.zh: 你还记得安娜说什么吗？“I really want to understand Peru.” 我希望你现在也对秘鲁多了解一点。我也希望能再跟你多聊聊语法，可今天时间到了！去网站学更多吧！

quiz.prompt: Why can't Anna meet Bruna for lunch at first?
choices: She has to research Peru for a story
She is taking a DC Ducks tour
She is covering a barbecue battle

quiz.prompt: What special Peruvian dance do they watch?
Where does Bruna take Anna instead of Peru?
choices: A Peruvian festival at the museum

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 11
lessons.subtitle: The Big Snow

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. Why do you have all this weather stuff?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。你怎么有这么多气象用品？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love weather.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢天气。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Me too! Weather is so important.
dialogue.zh: 我也是！天气非常重要。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It is. It affects people’s lives!
dialogue.zh: 是的。它会影响人们的生活！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Have you ever reported on a big weather event?
dialogue.zh: 你报道过大型天气事件吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have. I’ve reported on a blizzard.
dialogue.zh: 报道过。我报道过一场暴风雪。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Do mean the one last weekend?
dialogue.zh: 你是说上周末那场吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! I had been waiting for that blizzard for years. When it came, I was ready.
dialogue.zh: 对！那场暴风雪我等了很多年。它来的时候，我准备好了。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Welcome to our most perfect lesson! Why is it perfect? Today we are reviewing the present perfect and past perfect verb tenses. These show that an action is completed. Kelly uses the present perfect when she says, “Have you ever reported on a big weather event?” Anna uses the past perfect when she says, “I had been waiting for that blizzard for years.” Listen for “have” or “had” and the past participle to find more sentences with the perfect tense.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来到我们最“完成时”的一课！为什么完美？今天我们复习现在完成时和过去完成时。它们表示一个动作已经完成。凯莉用现在完成时说：“Have you ever reported on a big weather event?” 安娜用过去完成时说：“I had been waiting for that blizzard for years.” 注意听 have 或 had 加上过去分词，找出更多完成时的句子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have wanted to report on a big weather event my whole life.
dialogue.zh: 我一辈子都想报道大型天气事件。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Who hasn’t? Did you report all weekend ... by yourself?
dialogue.zh: 谁不想呢？你整个周末都自己报道吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, no. I volunteered Pete to help me.
dialogue.zh: 没有，没有。我拉皮特来帮我。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Why am I here on a Saturday? Why are you carrying things? Why? Why?
dialogue.zh: 我星期六怎么在这儿？你为什么拿这么多东西？为什么？为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, these are my supplies – food, a blanket; warm clothing. Where are your supplies?
dialogue.zh: 皮特，这些是我的补给——食物、毯子、保暖衣服。你的补给呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, Pete, Pete. This could be the “blizzard of the century.”
dialogue.zh: 皮特，皮特，皮特。这可能是“世纪暴风雪”。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It’ll be fine.
dialogue.zh: 不会有事的。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: How else had you prepared?
dialogue.zh: 你还做了什么准备？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I had just bought the latest weather forecasting software. So, I brought it!
dialogue.zh: 我刚买了最新的天气预报软件。所以我带来了！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Do you mean The Weather Genie Pro?
dialogue.zh: 你是说天气精灵专业版？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know it. Pete thought it was pretty great too.
dialogue.zh: 就是它。皮特也觉得很棒。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Do you have any games on that thing?
dialogue.zh: 那东西上有游戏吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! I have the best weather survival game. Boom!
dialogue.zh: 有！我有最好的天气生存游戏。砰！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sounds fun.
dialogue.zh: 听起来好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It is. But right now, Pete, this computer is a work tool. It will give us the temperature, wind speed, wind direction and amount of snowfall … in real time! Boom, boom!
dialogue.zh: 是很好玩。可现在，皮特，这台电脑是工作工具。它会给我们温度、风速、风向和降雪量……实时的！砰，砰！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I can’t wait.
dialogue.zh: 我等不及了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, we need a name for this blizzard.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，这场暴风雪得有个名字。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, we don’t.
dialogue.zh: 不需要。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: All the great storms have names.
dialogue.zh: 所有大风暴都有名字。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, they don’t.
dialogue.zh: 才没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know -- “The Big Snow!”
dialogue.zh: 我知道了——“大雪！”

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I am not saying “The Big Snow.”
dialogue.zh: 我才不说“大雪”。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Welcome to “The Big Snow.”
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来到“大雪”。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: The Big Snow broke all kinds of records, didn’t it?
dialogue.zh: 这场大雪打破了各种纪录，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes it did. And every time a record was broken, we celebrated!
dialogue.zh: 是的。每次破纪录，我们都庆祝！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So far, in Washington, D.C. 29 inches of snow has fallen. That, my dear listeners, is a record! (Honks horn)
dialogue.zh: 到目前为止，华盛顿特区已经下了 29 英寸的雪。亲爱的听众，这是纪录！（按喇叭）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We just broke the wind speed record! (Honks horn)
dialogue.zh: 我们刚打破风速纪录！（按喇叭）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Snow has been falling for 30 hours straight! That’s another record! (Honks horn. Pete comes into room and breaks the horn.)
dialogue.zh: 雪已经连续下了 30 个小时！又是一个纪录！（按喇叭。皮特进来把喇叭弄坏了。）

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: By Saturday night, stores and restaurants had closed. Did you bring enough food?
dialogue.zh: 到周六晚上，商店和餐馆都关了。你们带的食物够吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I thought I had brought enough food. But I ran out.
dialogue.zh: 我以为带够了。可是吃完了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey, Pete, where is my bag of popcorn?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，皮特，我那袋爆米花呢？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Maybe you ate it already.
dialogue.zh: 也许你已经吃了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I didn’t.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I haven't seen it. (Pete has popcorn in his beard. Anna tries to hit him.)
dialogue.zh: 我没看见。（皮特胡子里有爆米花。安娜想打他。）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We had reported together for 48 hours straight!
dialogue.zh: 我们连续一起报道了 48 个小时！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Wow. That must have been a great team-building exercise for you and Pete.
dialogue.zh: 哇。对你和皮特来说，那一定是很好的团队建设。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah. You - you could say that.
dialogue.zh: 嗯。可以……可以这么说。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I hope you found all the sentences with perfect tenses. Learn more on our website!
dialogue.zh: 希望你找到了所有完成时的句子。去我们的网站学更多吧！

quiz.prompt: What weather event does Anna report on?
What name does Anna give the storm?
How long do Anna and Pete report together?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 12
lessons.subtitle: Run! Bees!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow. Did you know that bees are dying?
dialogue.zh: 哇。你知道蜜蜂正在消失吗？

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: That is bad news. If all the bees died, there would be no food. Bees are very important.
dialogue.zh: 那是坏消息。如果所有蜜蜂都死了，就不会有食物。蜜蜂非常重要。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, they are. Speaking of bees, one of our little friends is here now.
dialogue.zh: 是的。说到蜜蜂，我们的一位小朋友现在就在这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: You know, Anna, if you ignore it, it will fly away. But if you swat it, it might sting you.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，如果你不理它，它就会飞走。可如果你拍它，它可能会蛰你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’ll ignore it. I can ignore it. See, I’m ignoring it. (she is swatting at the bee)
dialogue.zh: 我会不理它。我能不理它。看，我在不理它。（她其实在拍打蜜蜂）

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Anna, are you afraid of bees?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你怕蜜蜂吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What makes you say that?
dialogue.zh: 你怎么会这么说？

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Anna, you should call my friend, Caroline. She is a beekeeper and a bee educator. If you talk to her, she’ll probably help you get over your fear of bees.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你应该给我的朋友卡洛琳打电话。她是养蜂人，也是蜜蜂教育者。如果你跟她谈谈，她大概能帮你克服对蜜蜂的害怕。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am not afraid of bees.
dialogue.zh: 我不怕蜜蜂。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Here’s her card.
dialogue.zh: 这是她的名片。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ahhh!

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: In this lesson, you can learn about conditionals. They have “if” and “will” or “would.” There are two kinds of conditional sentences in this lesson. Type 1 conditionals have a real event, and a result that probably will happen. The pattern is: If + present tense verb … will + future tense verb. Kaveh uses this when he says: “If you ignore it, it will fly away.” Type 2 conditionals have a possible event and a result that may or may not happen. The pattern is: If + past tense verb … would + infinitive verb. Kaveh uses this when he says, “If all the bees died, there would be no food.” Look for the “if” in a sentence to find more conditionals.
dialogue.zh: 这一课可以学条件句。它们有 if，再加上 will 或 would。本课有两种条件句。第一种是真实事件，结果很可能发生。句式是：If + 现在时 … will + 将来时。卡维说：“If you ignore it, it will fly away.” 第二种是可能的事件，结果不一定发生。句式是：If + 过去时 … would + 动词原形。卡维说：“If all the bees died, there would be no food.” 找句子里的 if，就能找到更多条件句。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I think I'm at the wrong address. This does not look like a place where bees are kept. (knocks on door)
dialogue.zh: 我好像走错地址了。这儿看起来不像养蜜蜂的地方。（敲门）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, sorry to bother you. I’m looking for beekeeper Caroline. I’m here to take her “Learn to Love Bees!” class.
dialogue.zh: 哦，抱歉打扰。我在找养蜂人卡洛琳。我来上她的“学会爱蜜蜂！”课。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: You’re in the right place! I’m Caroline!
dialogue.zh: 你来对了！我就是卡洛琳！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, nice to meet you! Um, Caroline, I thought this class used real bees and real hives.
dialogue.zh: 哦，很高兴认识你！嗯，卡洛琳，我以为这门课用真蜜蜂和真蜂箱。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: It does! If you look in my backyard, you will see my bees! I’m a home beekeeper!
dialogue.zh: 就是用真的！如果你看我的后院，就会看到我的蜜蜂！我是家庭养蜂人！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What? You live with bees? That is really amazing! And at the same time really scary.
dialogue.zh: 什么？你跟蜜蜂住一起？太神奇了！同时也好吓人。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: It’s not scary. If you come, I’ll show you.
dialogue.zh: 不可怕。如果你过来，我就给你看。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Caroline, how many bees are in that hive?
dialogue.zh: 卡洛琳，那个蜂箱里有多少蜜蜂？

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: About thirty thousand (30,000) in each.
dialogue.zh: 每个大约三万只。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What? That's amazing! But, aren’t you afraid that they are gonna come out and kill you?
dialogue.zh: 什么？太惊人了！可你不怕它们出来把你蛰死吗？

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: No, not at all, Anna. Even my children help me. Tell me, why are you afraid of bees?
dialogue.zh: 一点也不怕，安娜。连我的孩子都帮我。告诉我，你为什么怕蜜蜂？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't know. Well, when I was a little girl my mom ran out of honey. And I really wanted honey for my pancakes. So, I climbed high into a tree and hit a beehive with a stick … several times. Then I reached inside with my bare hands to pull the honey out. That’s when I got stung … a lot.
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。嗯，我小时候妈妈的蜂蜜用完了。我很想在煎饼上放蜂蜜。所以我爬到很高的树上，用棍子打蜂巢……打了好几次。然后我光着手伸进去掏蜂蜜。那时我就被蛰了……很多次。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Caroline, if you hit a beehive with a stick and reach inside, you might get stung.
dialogue.zh: 卡洛琳，如果你用棍子打蜂巢再伸进去，你可能会被蛰。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: No, Anna. If you do those things, you will get stung.
dialogue.zh: 不对，安娜。如果你做那些事，你一定会被蛰。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. I did.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我被蛰了。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: And you know that it was your fault you got stung, don’t you?
dialogue.zh: 而且你知道被蛰是你自己的错，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. I did.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我知道。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Bees know your feelings. And if you stay calm, the bees will be calm. If you're nervous, the bees will be nervous. And if bees are nervous, they may sting. So, please be calm.
dialogue.zh: 蜜蜂能感觉到你的情绪。如果你保持冷静，蜜蜂也会冷静。如果你紧张，蜜蜂也会紧张。蜜蜂紧张时可能会蛰人。所以，请冷静。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I will be calm. I am calm. Okay, I'm ready. I'm ready
dialogue.zh: 我会冷静。我很冷静。好，我准备好了。我准备好了。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Great. Let’s get our equipment on.
dialogue.zh: 很好。我们穿上装备吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wait! Wait! I’m not ready! I'm nervous! Give me a minute to be calm.
dialogue.zh: 等等！等等！我还没准备好！我好紧张！给我一分钟冷静一下。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Are you ready for one more conditional sentence? If you are not afraid, you will join us next time to learn more about bees!
dialogue.zh: 准备好听再一句条件句了吗？如果你不怕，下次就会跟我们一起继续了解蜜蜂！

quiz.prompt: What does Kaveh say would happen if all the bees died?
Who does Kaveh tell Anna to call?
Why did Anna get stung as a little girl?
choices: She ignored a bee at work
She hit a beehive with a stick and reached inside

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 13
lessons.subtitle: Save the Bees!

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: We are back with Anna and Caroline and the bees. Last time, Anna was afraid. (Anna: I'm not afraid of bees!) But Caroline is helping her to stay safe. Look at sentences that start with “If” to find more conditional sentences. Remember, Type 1 conditionals use the present tense and “will,” and Type 2 use the past tense and “would.” Now, let's find out what happens with Anna and the bees.
dialogue.zh: 我们又和安娜、卡洛琳还有蜜蜂在一起了。上次安娜很害怕。（安娜：我不怕蜜蜂！）但卡洛琳在帮她保持安全。找以 If 开头的句子，就能找到更多条件句。记住，第一种条件句用现在时和 will，第二种用过去时和 would。现在看看安娜和蜜蜂会怎样。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: I have a feeling that your fear of bees will be gone soon. There are things beekeepers do to protect ourselves. For example, we wear protective clothing. This is a beekeeper’s veil, suit and gloves. There are other things we can do, too. If I use a smoker, the bees will stay calm.
dialogue.zh: 我有预感，你对蜜蜂的害怕很快就会消失。养蜂人会做一些事来保护自己。比如我们穿防护服。这是养蜂面罩、套装和手套。还有别的办法。如果我用喷烟器，蜜蜂就会保持冷静。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let’s use smoke … lots of smoke.
dialogue.zh: 我们用烟吧……很多很多烟。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Okay, Anna, that’s enough smoke. Another thing you can do is stay calm. Okay. When I lift the frame, you will see the bees.
dialogue.zh: 好了，安娜，烟够了。另一件事是保持冷静。好。我提起蜂框时，你就会看到蜜蜂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m ready. Let's do this thing!
dialogue.zh: 我准备好了。开始吧！

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Okay, let's put on our protective clothing.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们穿上防护服。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: I will carefully take out a frame. This is where the bees live. There are worker bees, drone bees and the queen bee. The bees have different jobs. The queen bee lays the eggs. The worker bees collect nectar and pollen from flowers and bring it back to the hive. Then they make honey! Now, you hold the frame. There are the bees.
dialogue.zh: 我会小心地拿出一个蜂框。这就是蜜蜂住的地方。有工蜂、雄蜂和蜂后。蜜蜂有不同的工作。蜂后产卵。工蜂从花上采集花蜜和花粉，带回蜂箱。然后它们酿蜜！现在你拿着这个框。蜜蜂在这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are so many! And they are so busy! Now I know why we say, “busy as a bee!”
dialogue.zh: 好多啊！它们好忙！现在我知道为什么说“忙得像蜜蜂”了！

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Good job, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 做得好，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Caroline, bees are beautiful and important. If I wanted to help the bees, what would I do?
dialogue.zh: 卡洛琳，蜜蜂又美丽又重要。如果我想帮助蜜蜂，我该做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Great question. You can plant native flowers that bees like. Here’s a book to help you know which ones to plant.
dialogue.zh: 好问题。你可以种蜜蜂喜欢的本地花。这本书能帮你知道该种哪些。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s a beautiful book. And look, it tells you which bees like which types of flowers.
dialogue.zh: 这本书很漂亮。看，它还告诉你哪种蜜蜂喜欢哪种花。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: It also tells you how the flowers affect the flavor of the honey.
dialogue.zh: 它还告诉你这些花怎样影响蜂蜜的味道。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Flowers make a big difference to bees. If they don’t eat, they won’t live.
dialogue.zh: 花对蜜蜂很重要。如果它们不吃东西，就活不下去。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Buying local honey also helps the bees. If you want to help bees, do those two things.
dialogue.zh: 买本地蜂蜜也有帮助。如果你想帮助蜜蜂，就做这两件事。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I learned a lot about bees. Hey, if I worked with bees, I would not need protective clothing! Guess what? That was a Type 2 conditional. And I heard a Type 1 conditional, too. (Anna: If they don’t eat, they won’t live.)
dialogue.zh: 我学到了很多关于蜜蜂的知识。嘿，如果我和蜜蜂一起工作，就不需要防护服！猜怎么着？那是第二种条件句。我还听到了第一种条件句。（安娜：If they don’t eat, they won’t live.）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks for the book, Caroline, and the bee puppet and for teaching me about bees. Look … I’m not scared.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你的书，卡洛琳，还有蜜蜂玩偶，也谢谢你教我认识蜜蜂。看……我不害怕了。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Good job, Anna. If you ever want to see the bees again, I’ll be here! You have my business card. I'll let you see yourself out.
dialogue.zh: 做得好，安娜。如果你以后还想看蜜蜂，我会在这儿！你有我的名片。你自己出去就行。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks! Bye! I will plant tons of flowers!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！再见！我会种好多花！

dialogue.speaker: Bees
dialogue.en: Thanks, Anna. (bees spell out the words)
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，安娜。（蜜蜂拼出这些字）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure thing, bees! Oh, and I'm sorry about hitting that hive when I was a little girl.
dialogue.zh: 应该的，蜜蜂们！哦，还有，对不起我小时候打过那个蜂巢。

dialogue.speaker: Bees
dialogue.en: We love you, Anna. (bees make a heart sign.)
dialogue.zh: 我们爱你，安娜。（蜜蜂摆出爱心）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Take care, bees! (to herself) Which way is the Metro?
dialogue.zh: 保重，蜜蜂们！（自言自语）地铁往哪边走？

dialogue.speaker: Bees
dialogue.en: That way. (they draw an arrow)
dialogue.zh: 那边。（它们画出一个箭头）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: So, if you want to learn more about bees, visit your local beekeeper like Anna did. Maybe you can try some local honey, too. Now it’s your turn. Practice making conditional sentences. If you practice, you will become better at them. That's type 1!
dialogue.zh: 所以，如果你想多了解蜜蜂，就像安娜一样去拜访本地养蜂人。也许你还可以尝尝本地蜂蜜。现在轮到你了。练习造条件句。如果你练习，你就会更擅长。这就是第一种条件句！

quiz.prompt: What does Caroline use to keep the bees calm?
What two things does Caroline say help the bees?
choices: Plant native flowers and buy local honey

quiz.prompt: What does Anna say she will do at the end?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 14
lessons.subtitle: Made for Each Other

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! What are you guys looking at?
dialogue.zh: 你们好！你们在看什么？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I’m showing Ashley pictures of my girlfriend. We have so much in common -- even small things. She can’t whistle and I can’t either.
dialogue.zh: 我在给阿什莉看我女朋友的照片。我们有好多共同点——连小事也一样。她不会吹口哨，我也不会。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: (to Pete) And here’s a picture of my boyfriend. (sighs)
dialogue.zh: （对皮特）这是我男朋友的照片。（叹气）

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: My family is big and so is his. I don’t like ball sports and he doesn’t either! (sighs) We are made for each other ...
dialogue.zh: 我家人口很多，他家也是。我不喜欢球类运动，他也不喜欢！（叹气）我们真是天生一对……

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: … and so are we. (sighs)
dialogue.zh: ……我们也是。（叹气）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Uh… you have found perfect partners … and so have I!
dialogue.zh: 呃……你们找到了完美伴侣……我也找到了！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Pete and Ashley are talking about people they love. They are putting two ideas together with connectors. Let’s start with these two sentences: She can’t whistle. Pete can’t whistle. How do you put them together? Pete says, “She can’t whistle and I can’t either.” You can see we just add the conjunction “either” and take away the verb “whistle.” And Ashley says: “I don’t like ball sports and he doesn’t either!” Keep looking for connectors!
dialogue.zh: 皮特和阿什莉在谈论他们爱的人。他们用连接词把两个意思合在一起。先看这两句：She can’t whistle. Pete can’t whistle. 怎么合在一起？皮特说：“She can’t whistle and I can’t either.” 我们加上连接词 either，并去掉动词 whistle。阿什莉说：“I don’t like ball sports and he doesn’t either!” 继续找连接词！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: You met someone, Anna? That’s great! What’s his name?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你认识人了？太好了！他叫什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: His name? His name is uh… (stalling, looks around, sees a bus) Bus … ter. (stalling, looks around, sees a car) Car … ter.
dialogue.zh: 他的名字？他的名字是呃……（拖延，四处看，看见一辆公交车）Bus……ter。（拖延，看见一辆汽车）Car……ter。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: (says it like Anna did) Bus...ter Car...ter?
dialogue.zh: （学安娜的样子）Bus...ter Car...ter？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s just Buster Carter, Ashley. I like him and he likes me. We’re a great couple.
dialogue.zh: 就是 Buster Carter，阿什莉。我喜欢他，他也喜欢我。我们是很棒的一对。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Hey, let’s all get dinner tonight, together. You can bring Buster.
dialogue.zh: 嘿，今晚我们一起吃饭吧。你可以带上巴斯特。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: (laughing) Yeah, I can’t wait to meet him.
dialogue.zh: （笑）对，我等不及见他了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Ashley, but he’s really busy tonight with his uh, (looks around, sees squirrel) squirrel collection. Bye, guys! Gotta go!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，阿什莉，可他今晚真的很忙，忙他的呃，（四处看，看见松鼠）松鼠收藏。再见，伙计们！我得走了！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Squirrel collection?
dialogue.zh: 松鼠收藏？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You know, she made all that up.
dialogue.zh: 你知道的，那全是她编的。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: That’s so sad. She needs to meet someone. Hey, do you know anyone who she might...
dialogue.zh: 好难过。她需要认识个人。嘿，你认识谁也许可以……

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 不。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: (to herself) Anna, Anna, you lied! You lied! Now, they think you have a boyfriend - with a squirrel collection. Here, squirrel. (throws food) Well, you need to tell them the truth. You don’t have a boyfriend.
dialogue.zh: （自言自语）安娜，安娜，你撒谎了！你撒谎了！现在他们以为你有男朋友——还收藏松鼠。来，松鼠。（扔食物）你得告诉他们实话。你没有男朋友。

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，这个位子有人吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley, Pete, I need to talk to you. This morning, I lied.
dialogue.zh: 阿什莉，皮特，我得跟你们谈谈。今天早上，我撒谎了。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Let me guess. There’s no Buster Carter. What a surprise!
dialogue.zh: 让我猜。根本没有巴斯特·卡特。真是惊喜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m sorry. But later I really did meet someone and we have a lot in common! He’s good at flying kites and so am I. He likes to read comics and so do I. I can play the ukulele and so can he.
dialogue.zh: 对不起。可后来我真的遇到了一个人，我们有很多共同点！他很会放风筝，我也是。他喜欢看漫画，我也是。我会弹尤克里里，他也会。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: He sounds perfect for you, Anna. Can he come tonight?
dialogue.zh: 听起来他很适合你，安娜。他今晚能来吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s the sad part. You see, he just got a job as a spy, and tonight he leaves on assignment.
dialogue.zh: 这就是让人难过的地方。你看，他刚找到一份间谍的工作，今晚就要出发执行任务。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Of course he does.
dialogue.zh: 当然了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: But that's okay, because now I know that there is someone out there made for me. (looks at the time) Oh, it’s late! I have to see him off at the train station. Bye, you guys!
dialogue.zh: 不过没关系，因为我现在知道外面有一个为我而生的人。（看时间）哦，晚了！我得去火车站送他。再见！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Bye Anna! Oh dear, she’s worse than we thought.
dialogue.zh: 再见，安娜！天哪，她比我们想的还严重。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: She’s lost her mind.
dialogue.zh: 她疯了。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: What should we do?
dialogue.zh: 我们该怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: (happy, excited) Let’s tell her!
dialogue.zh: （高兴、兴奋）我们告诉她吧！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: No, Pete. Mr. Right may not be real but he makes her really happy.
dialogue.zh: 不行，皮特。真命天子也许不是真的，可他让她很开心。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you find any other connectors? Notice how the words are in a different order in the part after “so.” “I am” becomes “am I” and “he can” becomes “can he.” “He’s good at flying kites and so am I. I can play the ukulele and so can he.”
dialogue.zh: 你还找到别的连接词了吗？注意 so 后面的词序变了。“I am” 变成 “am I”，“he can” 变成 “can he”。“He’s good at flying kites and so am I. I can play the ukulele and so can he.”

quiz.prompt: What fake name does Anna invent for her boyfriend?
What excuse does Anna give for why he cannot come to dinner?
choices: He is busy with his squirrel collection

quiz.prompt: What job does Anna later say her new friend just got?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 15
lessons.subtitle: Before and After

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, even though we both love speed walking, could we slow down a bit?
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，虽然我们都爱竞走，能不能慢一点？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: No way! I think because I’m walking with you, I’m walking faster.
dialogue.zh: 不行！我觉得因为跟你一起走，我走得更快了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Come on, Penelope. Let's take a break. We've been speed walking since 8 a.m.! You're so competitive! You even wore your medals!
dialogue.zh: 拜托，佩内洛普。休息一下吧。我们从早上 8 点就在竞走了！你好好胜！你还戴着奖牌！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: You brought your trophies! You’re out of shape. When we were little girls, we could speed walk all day! (pulls ahead)
dialogue.zh: 你还带了奖杯！你身体不行了。我们还是小女孩的时候，可以竞走一整天！（抢先走）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: (chases her) Hey, wait for me! Hey, you know the speed walking rules! If both feet leave the ground, it’s running! You ran!
dialogue.zh: （追她）嘿，等等我！嘿，你知道竞走规则！如果双脚都离地，那就是跑步！你跑了！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna and Penelope are doing something they both love - speed walking! They are also using adverb clauses. Adverb clauses tell us when, why, how, where and under what conditions. For example, “since 8 a.m.” tells us when. Adverb clauses are dependent clauses and need an independent clause to make a complete sentence. Words like before, after, when, because, since, if and even though can signal an adverb clause. Keep watching for more adverb clauses!
dialogue.zh: 安娜和佩内洛普在做她们都喜欢的事——竞走！她们也在用状语从句。状语从句告诉我们何时、为何、怎样、何处以及在什么条件下。比如 “since 8 a.m.” 告诉我们时间。状语从句是从属从句，需要一个独立从句才能构成完整句子。before、after、when、because、since、if 和 even though 这类词可以提示状语从句。继续看，找更多状语从句！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Whew! That was great!
dialogue.zh: 呼！太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: (Anna catches up) Wow, Penelope, you’re still really fast! Since I’ve been working in an office, my speed walking has been much slower.
dialogue.zh: （安娜追上）哇，佩内洛普，你还是很快！自从我在办公室工作以来，我的竞走慢多了。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: You are slower, Anna. Maybe you should hire a personal trainer.
dialogue.zh: 你是慢了，安娜。也许你该请个私人教练。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That will be great. As long as the trainer understands speed walking.
dialogue.zh: 那很好。只要教练懂竞走就行。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: (hands her a business card) Try this company. After you fill out an online application, they will match you to the perfect trainer.
dialogue.zh: （递给她一张名片）试试这家公司。你填完网上申请后，他们会给你匹配最合适的教练。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: As soon as I get home tonight, I’ll do it! Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我一到家就填！谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Are you my trainer?
dialogue.zh: 你是我的教练吗？

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: If you’re Anna, then I’m your trainer -- Alaskan Albert. Because I’m from Alaskan wilderness, I’m skilled in all outdoor activities of the wild.
dialogue.zh: 如果你是安娜，那我就是你的教练——阿拉斯加的艾伯特。因为我来自阿拉斯加荒野，我擅长所有野外户外活动。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s great but what about speed walking?
dialogue.zh: 那很好，可竞走呢？

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Speed walking? That's funny! Since I’ve been living in the city, I’ve combined wilderness training with a city workout. I call it “Call of the Wild Parkour!” (He howls like a wolf.)
dialogue.zh: 竞走？真好笑！自从我住在城里，我就把荒野训练和城市锻炼结合起来。我叫它“野性的呼唤跑酷！”（他像狼一样嚎叫。）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay … but seriously, when do we speed walk?
dialogue.zh: 好吧……可说真的，我们什么时候竞走？

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Your application did not say how funny you are!
dialogue.zh: 你的申请没说你这么幽默！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. But it did say that I'm a speed walker! Did you read it? Forget it. We'll have to cancel.
dialogue.zh: 没有。可它写了我是竞走者！你读了吗？算了。我们得取消。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We can't train today because it's too cold and too windy.
dialogue.zh: 今天不能训练，因为太冷也太刮风。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: No way! No pain, no gain! When you exercise in really cold weather, you feel alive!
dialogue.zh: 不行！没有痛苦就没有收获！在很冷的天气里锻炼，你会觉得自己活着！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Really? Because right now I just feel cold.
dialogue.zh: 真的吗？因为我现在只觉得冷。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: You're so funny. But seriously, after our training, you will be ready for any extreme physical challenge. Let's get started!
dialogue.zh: 你真有趣。可说真的，训练之后，你就能应对任何极限体能挑战。开始吧！

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Anna, even though you’re trying really hard, you’re really bad at Call of the Wild Parkour. (he howls)
dialogue.zh: 安娜，虽然你很努力，可你的“野性的呼唤跑酷”真的很差。（他嚎叫）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm bad at Call of the Wild Parkour because I don’t want to do Call of the Wild Parkour! (she howls) I am a speed walker. It’s what I do. It’s part of who I am.
dialogue.zh: 我跑酷差，是因为我不想做“野性的呼唤跑酷”！（她嚎叫）我是竞走者。这就是我做的事。这是我的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Why didn’t you say something?
dialogue.zh: 你为什么不说？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I did. Several times! You thought I was joking.
dialogue.zh: 我说了。说了好几次！你以为我在开玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Now I understand. Anna, I can help you. If you follow my advice, I'll put the speed back in your speed walk.
dialogue.zh: 现在我明白了。安娜，我能帮你。如果你听我的建议，我会把速度还给你的竞走。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Go, Anna, go!
dialogue.zh: 加油，安娜，加油！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: For more about adverb clauses, visit our website!
dialogue.zh: 想了解更多状语从句，请访问我们的网站！

What does Alaskan Albert call his workout?
What does Anna say she is?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 16
lessons.subtitle: Find Your Joy!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Kaveh! Let’s go to lunch!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，卡维！一起去吃午饭吧！

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Ooh, I know a great place. When I first started working here, I would go every day!
dialogue.zh: 哦，我知道一个很棒的地方。我刚来这儿工作时，每天都会去！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great. Oh, no.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。哦，不。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: What’s wrong?
dialogue.zh: 怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I lost my key! I just had it this morning.
dialogue.zh: 我钥匙丢了！早上还在的。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: You should check the Lost & Found office.
dialogue.zh: 你该去失物招领处看看。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great idea. Where is it?
dialogue.zh: 好主意。在哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Oh, it used to be across from the cafeteria. But now it’s down in the basement next to the elevators. It’s really hard to find.
dialogue.zh: 哦，以前在食堂对面。现在在地下室，电梯旁边。真的很难找。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The Lost & Found is hard to find. That’s funny.
dialogue.zh: 失物招领处很难找。好笑。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: It is.
dialogue.zh: 是啊。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I hope Anna can find the Lost & Found office! Used to and would describe something that happened repeatedly in the past. Kaveh uses would when he says, “When I first started working here, I would go every day!” There are two differences between used to and would. Number 1: We use would only when we say the time period first. Number 2: For verbs like be, think, feel, see and understand, we can only use used to. Kaveh says, “It used to be across from the cafeteria.” Keep listening for more!
dialogue.zh: 希望安娜能找到失物招领处！used to 和 would 都表示过去反复发生的事。卡维说：“When I first started working here, I would go every day!” used to 和 would 有两点不同。第一：只有先说出时间段时才用 would。第二：be、think、feel、see、understand 这类动词只能用 used to。卡维说：“It used to be across from the cafeteria.” 继续听！

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: Come in! I am Serenity.
dialogue.zh: 请进！我是宁静。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Serenity. I’m Anna!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，宁静。我是安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: Please, sit down. How can I help you?
dialogue.zh: 请坐。我能帮你什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I lost something very important.
dialogue.zh: 我丢了一件很重要的东西。

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: Shh. I already know. You need help.
dialogue.zh: 嘘。我已经知道了。你需要帮助。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. I need help finding the key …
dialogue.zh: 是的。我需要帮忙找钥匙……

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: Shh. You need to find the key – the key that will give you happiness.
dialogue.zh: 嘘。你需要找到那把钥匙——能给你幸福的钥匙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Finding this key will make me very happy.
dialogue.zh: 是的。找到这把钥匙会让我很高兴。

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: First, Anna, let me tell you a little bit about myself.
dialogue.zh: 首先，安娜，让我先说说我自己。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好。

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: I used to be a very important person with a very important job. I made a lot of money – I mean a lot.
dialogue.zh: 我曾经是个很重要的人，有很重要的工作。我赚很多钱——我是说很多。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow. Good for you!
dialogue.zh: 哇。真为你高兴！

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: No! No, it was bad for me. I lost the most important thing – the key! You’ve lost it too, haven’t you, Anna? Haven’t you?
dialogue.zh: 不！不，那对我不好。我失去了最重要的东西——那把钥匙！你也失去了，对不对，安娜？对不对？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I guess. So, how does this work? Do I have to fill out a form or something?
dialogue.zh: 大概吧。那这怎么弄？我要填表还是怎样？

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: No. No forms. Just answer this one question: As a child, what did you use to do to feel happy?
dialogue.zh: 不用。不用填表。只回答一个问题：小时候，你常常做什么才会觉得快乐？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: When I was little, I used to sing all the time with my family. Those were good times.
dialogue.zh: 我小时候常常和家人一起唱歌。那是美好的时光。

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: Singing is so joyful! I used to sing. But now that I’ve started my business, I’ve just been too busy. Too busy! Anna, why don’t you sing again?
dialogue.zh: 唱歌真快乐！我以前也唱歌。可自从我开始做生意，我就太忙了。太忙了！安娜，你为什么不再唱呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I sing everywhere! I sing in the office. I sing on the metro. I sing in the elevators. I sing on the escalators. I sing in the bathroom. Serenity! Serenity! I really need to find my key. Yeah!
dialogue.zh: 我到处都唱！我在办公室唱。我在地铁上唱。我在电梯里唱。我在扶梯上唱。我在洗手间唱。宁静！宁静！我真的需要找到我的钥匙。对！

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: Yes, we need to find the key … the key to happiness.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我们需要找到那把钥匙……幸福的钥匙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, no. I just need to find the key to my apartment.
dialogue.zh: 不，不。我只需要找到公寓钥匙。

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: I used to know. But now I don’t! Do you, Anna?
dialogue.zh: 我以前知道。可现在不知道了！你知道吗，安娜？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don’t know. I think I left it in the ladies’ room. You know, this isn’t the Lost & Found, is it?
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。我想我落在女洗手间了。你知道，这儿不是失物招领处，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: It could be the Lost & Found. I’m lost! And I used to find joy for people! I used to find joy!
dialogue.zh: 这儿也可以是失物招领处。我迷路了！我以前帮人找到快乐！我以前找到快乐！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, this is a bad time for you. I’ll find the Lost & Found myself. Bye, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 你现在不太方便。我会自己去找失物招领处。再见，谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: I used to find joy. I used to find joy! I used to find joy!
dialogue.zh: 我以前找到快乐。我以前找到快乐！我以前找到快乐！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ah, I found my key!
dialogue.zh: 啊，我找到钥匙了！

dialogue.speaker: Serenity
dialogue.en: I used to find joy!
dialogue.zh: 我以前找到快乐！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Oh no. Serenity lost her joy. But at least Anna found her key! Check out our website for more!
dialogue.zh: 哦不。宁静失去了她的快乐。不过至少安娜找到了钥匙！去我们的网站看更多吧！

quiz.prompt: What did Anna lose?
Who does Anna meet when she walks into the wrong office?
As a child, what did Anna use to do to feel happy?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 17
lessons.subtitle: Flour Baby, Part 1

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna, Pete, I have a new assignment for you – a show on single parents! What is it like for a mother or a father to raise a child by herself or himself?
dialogue.zh: 安娜、皮特，我给你们一个新任务——做一期关于单亲父母的节目！一位母亲或父亲独自抚养孩子是什么样的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We can interview single parents. They can share their experiences themselves.
dialogue.zh: 我们可以采访单亲父母。他们可以亲自分享自己的经历。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yes, but you need to experience parenthood yourselves.
dialogue.zh: 可以，可你们得自己体验一下为人父母。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ourselves?
dialogue.zh: 我们自己？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah, how do we do that? We’re not parents.
dialogue.zh: 对啊，怎么体验？我们又不是父母。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: I asked myself the same question. I said, “Caty, how are they gonna do that?” Then an idea came to me. I will give you the babies!
dialogue.zh: 我也问过自己同样的问题。我说：“凯蒂，他们要怎么做到？”然后我有了主意。我把宝宝给你们！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: You may be asking yourself the same thing that I’m asking myself: what is Ms. Weaver talking about!? I am sure we will find out shortly. This lesson teaches reflexive pronouns. Reflexive pronouns refer back to the subject of a sentence or clause. We use them when the subject and the object are the same person or thing. For example, Ms. Weaver says, “I asked myself the same question.” “I” is the subject and “myself” refers back to it. Here, she would not use the pronoun “me.” You need to use the reflexive pronoun “myself.” Reflexive pronouns are easy to find: they end in “self” or “selves.” I have a feeling we are going to see a lot of reflexive pronouns. Listen for them!
dialogue.zh: 你可能也在问自己我在问的问题：韦弗女士在说什么！？我们很快就会知道。这一课教反身代词。反身代词回指句子或从句的主语。当主语和宾语是同一个人或事物时使用。比如韦弗女士说：“I asked myself the same question.” I 是主语，myself 回指它。这里不能用 me，要用反身代词 myself。反身代词很好找：以 self 或 selves 结尾。我感觉我们会听到很多反身代词。注意听！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Here are your babies!
dialogue.zh: 这是你们的宝宝！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Those are bags of flour.
dialogue.zh: 那是几袋面粉。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: No, Pete, for the next six days, this is your baby. Here are your instructions. Do not leave your babies alone. A baby cannot take care of itself. And you two must do everything by yourselves. We will meet next Friday. Oh, and the person who does the best research will get an extra day of vacation. Help yourself to a baby.
dialogue.zh: 不，皮特，接下来六天，这就是你的宝宝。这是你们的说明。不要把宝宝单独留下。宝宝不能照顾自己。你们两个必须自己做所有事。下周五见面。哦，研究做得最好的人会多得一天假期。自己选一个宝宝吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, look, my baby is organic and whole grain. Your baby is ordinary.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，看，我的宝宝是有机全麦的。你的宝宝很普通。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Monster! This is a great idea, Ms. Weaver!
dialogue.zh: 怪物！这主意太棒了，韦弗女士！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: This is a terrible idea.
dialogue.zh: 这主意糟透了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Speak for yourself, Pete! We need to throw ourselves into the research! I’m starting right now!
dialogue.zh: 那是你自己的想法，皮特！我们得全身心投入研究！我现在就开始！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hey Anna, you forgot your baby!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜，你忘了你的宝宝！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Come to mama!
dialogue.zh: 到妈妈这儿来！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good girl! Good girl!
dialogue.zh: 好姑娘！好姑娘！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Singular reflexive pronouns end in “self.” Plural ones end in “selves.” Anna says, “We need to throw ourselves into the research!” The subject “we” is plural. So, we must use the plural reflexive pronoun “ourselves.”
dialogue.zh: 单数反身代词以 self 结尾。复数以 selves 结尾。安娜说：“We need to throw ourselves into the research!” 主语 we 是复数，所以必须用复数反身代词 ourselves。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is hard! I hope Pete is not doing well. I really need that vacation day!
dialogue.zh: 好难！希望皮特做得不好。我真的需要那天假期！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: We will all see how Pete is doing in the next episode. We’ll also learn when not to use reflexive pronouns.
dialogue.zh: 下一集我们会看到皮特做得怎么样。我们也会学什么时候不用反身代词。

quiz.prompt: What new assignment does Ms. Weaver give Anna and Pete?
What are the "babies" Ms. Weaver gives them?
What does the person with the best research get?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 18
lessons.subtitle: Flour Baby, Part 2

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: In Part 1 of this two-part lesson, Ms. Weaver gave Anna and Pete an assignment. Ms. Weaver instructed them to do everything by themselves. “Themselves” is a reflexive pronoun. In today’s lesson, Ms. Weaver will look at Pete’s and Anna’s research. First, let’s see Pete’s experiment.
dialogue.zh: 在这个两集课程的第一部分，韦弗女士给安娜和皮特布置了任务。她让他们自己做所有事。Themselves 是反身代词。今天这课，韦弗女士会看皮特和安娜的研究。先看皮特的实验。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Okay, Pete, let me see your research first.
dialogue.zh: 好，皮特，先让我看看你的研究。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: That’s a heavy binder. And you and your Baby look great.
dialogue.zh: 这本活页夹真重。你和你的宝宝看起来都很好。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Thanks, Ms. Weaver. We feel great!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，韦弗女士。我们感觉很好！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna. Anna, you’re next. Anna? Anna wake up!
dialogue.zh: 安娜。安娜，到你了。安娜？安娜，醒醒！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m here, Baby! I’m here! I’m here! Here’s your bottle.
dialogue.zh: 宝宝，我在！我在！我在！这是你的奶瓶。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna, you and your baby look awful. What happened?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你和你的宝宝看起来糟透了。发生了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I took her everywhere. Everywhere. And I fed her every three hours. So, I haven’t slept since … what day is it?
dialogue.zh: 我带她去了所有地方。所有地方。而且每三个小时喂她一次。所以我从……今天星期几？就没睡过。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: It’s Friday. What happened there?
dialogue.zh: 今天星期五。那儿怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, that. Oh, that. I was making myself a salad and had a little accident with a knife. I put my flour baby in front of me. And then I accidentally stabbed it. But I gave it First Aid!
dialogue.zh: 哦，那个。那个。我给自己做沙拉，刀子出了点小意外。我把面粉宝宝放在面前。然后不小心刺到它了。不过我给它做了急救！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Is that a burn?
dialogue.zh: 那是烫伤吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes it is. While I was making myself dinner, I put Baby next to me. I accidentally knocked her into the sink. So I put her in the microwave to dry. That’s when she caught fire.
dialogue.zh: 是的。是烫伤。我给自己做晚饭时，把宝宝放在旁边。不小心把她碰进水槽了。所以我把她放进微波炉烘干。然后她着火了。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Okay. So, we use a reflexive pronoun when it refers to the subject of a sentence or clause. But we DON’T use a reflexive pronoun with prepositions of place. Anna uses examples of both in one sentence: While I was making myself dinner, I put Baby next to me. We use a reflexive pronoun in the first part of the sentence. “Myself” refers to the subject “I.” But in the second part of the sentence, we don’t use a reflexive pronoun in the prepositional phrase. We use the pronoun “me.” Why? “next to” is a preposition of place.
dialogue.zh: 好。当它回指句子或从句的主语时，我们用反身代词。但地点介词后面不用反身代词。安娜一句话里两种都有：While I was making myself dinner, I put Baby next to me。前半句用反身代词，myself 回指主语 I。后半句介词短语里不用反身代词，而用 me。为什么？next to 是地点介词。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna, Anna, you should be very proud of yourself.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，安娜，你应该为自己感到骄傲。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Proud? She stabbed and burned her baby!! And she only did one page of research…and it’s covered in milk. Ew.
dialogue.zh: 骄傲？她刺伤还烧伤了她的宝宝！！而且她只写了一页研究……还沾满了奶。恶心。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yes, Pete. But she followed instructions.
dialogue.zh: 是的，皮特。可她按说明做了。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hey, I did ...
dialogue.zh: 嘿，我做了……

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Please, Pete. Anna, I think your baby has lost some weight. Is there something else you want to share?
dialogue.zh: 拜托，皮特。安娜，我觉得你的宝宝瘦了。你还有什么想分享的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. I’d like to share … these! I made them myself this morning.
dialogue.zh: 有。我想分享……这些！今天早上我自己做的。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You baked your baby? You should be ashamed of yourself!
dialogue.zh: 你把宝宝烤了？你应该为自己感到羞耻！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I baked them at the end of the experiment, Pete. At that point, this was just a bag of flour.
dialogue.zh: 我是在实验结束时烤的，皮特。那时候，这只是一袋面粉。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It was always just a bag of flour!!
dialogue.zh: 它一直都只是一袋面粉！！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Pete, will you listen to yourself?! You sound crazy.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，你听听自己在说什么？！你听起来像疯了。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I sound crazy! This whole experiment was crazy!! She was the one who carried around and fed it and ...
dialogue.zh: 我听起来像疯了！这整个实验才疯了！！是她带着它到处走、喂它，还……

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Mmm. That is good.
dialogue.zh: 嗯。真好吃。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: So, what have we learned? We’ve learned when to use reflexive pronouns and when not to. Go to our website for more information! You can practice using reflexive pronouns in our comments section.
dialogue.zh: 那么我们学到了什么？我们学到了什么时候用反身代词，什么时候不用。去我们的网站了解更多！你可以在评论区练习反身代词。

quiz.prompt: Why does Ms. Weaver say Anna should be proud of herself?
choices: Anna wrote a heavier research binder

quiz.prompt: What accidents happen to Anna's flour baby?
choices: She stabbed it and it caught fire
Bees attacked it at the park
Pete threw it into the circus

quiz.prompt: What does Anna share at the end of the experiment?
