lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 19
lessons.subtitle: Movie Night

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, can you tell me how to get to your movie theater?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，能告诉我去你们电影院怎么走吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, that’s easy. OK, thank you. Bye.
dialogue.zh: 哦，很简单。好，谢谢。再见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Pete! Thanks for the movie invitation.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，皮特！谢谢你邀请我看电影。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah, sure Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，当然，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love movies. I love the plot! I love the set design! I love the costumes! I love -
dialogue.zh: 我爱电影。我爱剧情！我爱布景！我爱服装！我爱——

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, I take movies very seriously. You’re not one of those people who talks during a movie, are you?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我对电影很认真。你不会是那种看电影时说话的人吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 不会。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Good.
dialogue.zh: 很好。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna loves movies. And..she loves talking about movies. And Pete doesn’t sound happy about that. But he’s trying to be polite. He can do that with Indirect Questions. We can ask a question directly: Where is your movie theater? or indirectly as Anna does: “Can you tell me how to get to your movie theater?” They have the same meaning. But indirect questions are more polite and a little more formal. Many indirect questions begin with: Can/Could you tell me… Would/Do you mind… Would it be possible… or Do you know… Hmm, do you know if Anna will stop talking? I sure don’t. Keep watching. And, this time look for indirect questions that begin with: Would you mind…
dialogue.zh: 安娜爱电影。而且……她爱谈论电影。皮特听起来不太高兴。可他想保持礼貌。他可以用间接疑问句。可以直接问：Where is your movie theater？也可以像安娜那样间接问：“Can you tell me how to get to your movie theater?” 意思一样。但间接疑问句更礼貌，也更正式。很多间接疑问句以这些开头：Can/Could you tell me… Would/Do you mind… Would it be possible… 或 Do you know… 嗯，你知道安娜会不会停下来吗？我可不知道。继续看。这次找以 Would you mind… 开头的间接疑问句。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love the smell of popcorn. I love seats that rock.
dialogue.zh: 我爱爆米花的味道。我爱会摇的座位。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I love when people are quiet.
dialogue.zh: 我爱人们安静的时候。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ooh look, the previews are starting. I love to see what movies are coming out. Oh, this one looks good!
dialogue.zh: 哦看，预告片开始了。我爱看有什么新电影要上映。哦，这部看起来不错！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, the previews are part of the movie experience. So, would you mind not talking?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，预告片也是看电影的一部分。所以，能不能请你不要说话？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, sure, sure.
dialogue.zh: 哦，当然，当然。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, I was wondering: are you almost finished with that?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我想问问：你快喝完了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. There’s still a lot of milkshake at the bottom.
dialogue.zh: 没有。底部还有很多奶昔。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, do you mind not drinking so loudly?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，能不能请你喝的时候小声一点？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’ll try. But it’s really thick.
dialogue.zh: 我试试。可它真的很稠。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, what are you doing?!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你在干什么？！

dialogue.speaker: Person in audience
dialogue.en: Shh!
dialogue.zh: 嘘！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I’m not the one making all the noise.
dialogue.zh: 制造噪音的又不是我。

dialogue.speaker: Person in audience
dialogue.en: Shhh!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m done now.
dialogue.zh: 我喝完了。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, would you mind opening that a little bit more quietly?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，能不能请你开包装时小声一点？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’ll try.
dialogue.zh: 我试试。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, just give it to me!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，把它给我！

dialogue.speaker: Person in audience
dialogue.en: Shhh!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It’s not mine. I’m opening it for her. Here.
dialogue.zh: 这不是我的。我在帮她开。给。

dialogue.speaker: Person in audience
dialogue.en: Shhhhhh!!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Here!
dialogue.zh: 给！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Pete.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Now, would you mind being more quiet?
dialogue.zh: 现在，能不能请你安静一点？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Excuse me, would you mind turning down your phone light?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，能不能请你把手机灯光调暗一点？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, sorry! I forgot to turn my phone off.
dialogue.zh: 哦，抱歉！我忘了关手机。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh no! I dropped it. Where is it?
dialogue.zh: 哦不！我掉了。在哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, can you please turn off your phone?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，能不能请你把手机关了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me, would you mind lending me your phone light for a minute?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，能不能把你的手机灯光借我用一分钟？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No! I’ll get it!
dialogue.zh: 不行！我来拿！

dialogue.speaker: Person in audience
dialogue.en: Shhhhh!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Look, people, I’m not the noisy one here! So, you all need to shush the right person. And I should know about shushing! I shush people all the time!!
dialogue.zh: 听着，各位，这儿吵的不是我！所以你们该嘘对的人。而且我最懂嘘人！我老是嘘别人！！

dialogue.speaker: Security guard
dialogue.en: Excuse me, sir. You can’t yell in a movie theater. Would you mind coming with me?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，先生。电影院里不能大喊。能不能请你跟我走一趟？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You’re kicking me out? Me? But I’m always the quiet one in the movie!
dialogue.zh: 你要把我赶出去？我？可我看电影一向最安静！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete should know better. You have to be quiet in a movie theater. Shh, the movie’s starting!
dialogue.zh: 皮特该更懂事。电影院里必须安静。嘘，电影开始了！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Well, that’s a surprise! I thought Anna would be the noisy one. Well, she was … with her food. But Pete did all of the talking. At least he tried to be polite by using indirect questions.
dialogue.zh: 哇，真意外！我还以为安娜会是吵的那个。嗯，她吃东西是有点吵。可说话的全是皮特。至少他试着用间接疑问句保持礼貌。

quiz.prompt: What does Pete keep asking Anna to do at the movies?
Who gets kicked out of the theater?
How does Pete try to be polite?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 20
lessons.subtitle: The Test Drive

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s a great idea. Rick, I think we should use this as the opening shot.
dialogue.zh: 这主意很好。里克，我觉得我们应该用这个做开场镜头。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, did Ms. Weaver give us instructions for covering the car show?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，韦弗女士有没有给我们报道车展的指示？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She did. She said that we need to show lots of cars. She said we need to interview people. And she also said that we should have fun.
dialogue.zh: 有。她说我们需要展示很多车。她说我们需要采访人。她还说我们应该玩得开心。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Those were her exact words?
dialogue.zh: 那是她的原话？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah. She said, “Have fun, Anna!” And she is the boss.
dialogue.zh: 对。她说：“玩得开心，安娜！”而且她是老板。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, Rick, are you - are you ready? OK. Hello, I’m Anna Matteo. Welcome to the Washington Car Show!
dialogue.zh: 好，里克，你——准备好了吗？好。大家好，我是安娜·马特奥。欢迎来到华盛顿车展！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: People all over town are saying that if you like cars, this is the place to be! So, let’s see what people are talking about. How was that? Okay? Is that Good?
dialogue.zh: 全城的人都在说，如果你喜欢车，这儿就是该来的地方！那我们去听听大家在说什么。刚才怎么样？可以吗？好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna, Penelope and Rick are making a news story about the Washington Car Show. Ms. Weaver gave them instructions. We often need to tell others what someone else said. There are two ways to do this. One is to use the person’s exact words and use quotation marks. We call this “direct speech.” For example, Ms. Weaver had said, “You need to show lots of cars.” The other way is to talk about what someone said. We call this “reported speech.” Anna tells Penelope: She said that we need to show lots of cars. In this sentence, “she,” is the subject, “said” is the reporting verb, “that” is the conjunction and “we need to show lots of cars” is the reporting clause. Keep watching, and listen for sentences where Anna talks about what someone else said!
dialogue.zh: 安娜、佩内洛普和里克在做华盛顿车展的新闻报道。韦弗女士给了他们指示。我们常常需要告诉别人别人说过的话。有两种做法。一种是用原话加引号，叫直接引语。比如韦弗女士说过：“You need to show lots of cars.” 另一种是转述别人说的话，叫间接引语。安娜对佩内洛普说：She said that we need to show lots of cars。这句话里，she 是主语，said 是转述动词，that 是连词，we need to show lots of cars 是转述从句。继续看，注意听安娜转述别人的话！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This car show has many styles of vehicles. There are utility vehicles, classic cars, trucks, sports cars, and everyday vehicles.
dialogue.zh: 这个车展有很多种车。有多功能车、老爷车、卡车、跑车，还有日常用车。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Okay, I think we got good interviews.
dialogue.zh: 好，我觉得我们采访得不错。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me too! People had very different opinions. But they all said they loved cars.
dialogue.zh: 我也这么觉得！人们看法很不一样。可他们都说喜欢车。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, look – a robot!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，看——一个机器人！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A robot!
dialogue.zh: 一个机器人！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: A robot!
dialogue.zh: 一个机器人！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Rick, we have to use the robot in the show!
dialogue.zh: 里克，节目里一定要用这个机器人！

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.en: What is your first name?
dialogue.zh: 你叫什么名字？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Anna! Anna!
dialogue.zh: 安娜！安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.en: Anna, you know, what an effort. What an effort to robot dance. How about a round of applause for Anna! I’ve never seen anyone try so hard.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你知道吗，真努力。机器人舞跳得真努力。给安娜鼓鼓掌吧！我从没见过有人这么拼命试。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, did you hear that? Hank the Robot said that he has never seen anyone dance like me.
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，你听到了吗？机器人汉克说他从没见过有人像我这样跳舞。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Uh, I think many people here are saying that, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 呃，我觉得这儿很多人都在这么说，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That was fun. You know what someone told me? You can test drive a Jaguar at this car show.
dialogue.zh: 真好玩。你知道有人跟我说什么吗？这个车展可以试驾捷豹。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Now, that sounds fun.
dialogue.zh: 这听起来好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let’s go.
dialogue.zh: 走吧。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This course is smooth. So you can drive faster.
dialogue.zh: 这条赛道很平。所以可以开得更快。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: He said...that I can’t drive, unfortunately.
dialogue.zh: 他说……很遗憾，我不能开。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh my gosh…reverse.
dialogue.zh: 我的天……倒车。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That was great. This is awesome.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。这太爽了。

dialogue.speaker: Kurt
dialogue.en: Are you ready to go on the rollercoaster?
dialogue.zh: 准备好上过山车了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m ready.
dialogue.zh: 我准备好了。

dialogue.speaker: Kurt
dialogue.en: Here we go!
dialogue.zh: 出发！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s awesome.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That was...That was awesome! I just want to go one more time. I promise. That’s it. Just one more time.
dialogue.zh: 刚才……刚才太爽了！我只想再来一次。我保证。就这样。就再一次。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This course is bumpy and uneven. I was told that I could drive this course. So I am.
dialogue.zh: 这条赛道又颠又不平。有人告诉我我可以开这条赛道。所以我开了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, Rick, are you rolling? Awesome. Okay, this course is uneven. But I think the ride will be smooth.
dialogue.zh: 好，里克，在拍吗？太好了。好，这条赛道不平。可我觉得乘坐会很平稳。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ooh. This hill is really steep.
dialogue.zh: 哦。这坡真陡。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh my gosh. I can’t tell you how much fun this is.
dialogue.zh: 我的天。我没法告诉你这有多好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, that was so much fun! I think I need to go again.
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，太好玩了！我觉得我还得再来一次。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Uh, Anna, I think we have enough test drive video.
dialogue.zh: 呃，安娜，我觉得试驾视频够了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver said to get a lot. So, I think I should go again. Rick, I’m going to go again. Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士说要多拍。所以我觉得我应该再来一次。里克，我还要再来。下次见！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: But I want to get lunch, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 可我想去吃午饭，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Penelope said she wants to go to lunch. But I don’t think that’s going to happen soon. Visit our website for more!
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普说她想去吃午饭。可我觉得这事一时半会儿不会发生。去我们的网站看更多吧！

quiz.prompt: What event are Anna and Penelope covering?
What does Hank the Robot say about Anna's dance?
choices: He has never seen anyone try so hard
She should drive the Jaguar herself
She talks too much in the theater

quiz.prompt: Why does Anna want another test drive?
choices: Ms. Weaver said to get a lot

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 21
lessons.subtitle: Trash to Treasure, Part 1

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: (on phone, to Pete) Got it. Pete, I promise. I won’t tell anyone. (to herself) Bye. He is so strange.
dialogue.zh: （打电话给皮特）知道了。皮特，我保证。我谁也不会说。（对自己）再见。他真奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Hey, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Are you talking to yourself again?
dialogue.zh: 你又在自言自语了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, not this time. I was talking to Pete.
dialogue.zh: 这次没有。我在跟皮特说话。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: How’s he doing?
dialogue.zh: 他怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good. He has a birthday coming up! But he told me not to tell anyone.
dialogue.zh: 挺好。他生日快到了！可他叫我别告诉任何人。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, from the way he was speaking, I don’t think he likes cake or presents or fun.
dialogue.zh: 听他说话的样子，我觉得他不喜欢蛋糕、礼物，也不喜欢热闹。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: That sounds like Pete.
dialogue.zh: 听起来就是皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I don’t care. I’m getting him a present. Do you know where I can buy something unique?
dialogue.zh: 反正我不在乎。我要给他买礼物。你知道哪儿能买到特别的东西吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I do -- Tanglewood Works. You will definitely find something unique there.
dialogue.zh: 知道——Tanglewood Works。那儿肯定能找到特别的东西。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great. I’ll go this weekend. Now, speaking of Pete’s birthday, what else should I do? I know. I’ll rent him a clown!
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我这周末去。说到皮特的生日，我还该做什么？我知道了。我给他租个小丑！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Yeah, he’ll never speak to you again.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，那他再也不会跟你说话了。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you hear Ashley and Anna using the words talk and speak? Talk and speak both mean “to say words.” And, many times, you can use either word without losing any meaning. But there are some differences in when we use these words. The word talk is usually used for conversations between two or more people and informal situations, such as between friends or family. For example, Ashley asks Anna: “Are you talking to yourself again?” Speak is usually used for one-way communication, such as presentations; formal situations, such as a boss speaking with her workers; to talk about language ability; and in polite requests. Keep watching, and listen for the words talk and speak.
dialogue.zh: 你听到阿什莉和安娜用 talk 和 speak 了吗？这两个词都表示“说话”。很多时候用哪个都行，意思差不多。但使用场合有些差别。talk 通常用于两人或多人之间的对话，以及朋友或家人之间这类非正式场合。比如阿什莉问安娜：“Are you talking to yourself again?” speak 通常用于单向交流，比如演讲；正式场合，比如老板对员工讲话；谈论语言能力；以及礼貌请求。继续看，注意听 talk 和 speak。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Hey there. Welcome to Tanglewood Works! I’m Sue. How can I help you today?
dialogue.zh: 嗨。欢迎来到 Tanglewood Works！我是苏。今天能帮你什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi Sue, I’m Anna. A friend told me about your store. She said, “Anna, this place is really unique!”
dialogue.zh: 嗨苏，我是安娜。一个朋友跟我说起你们店。她说：“安娜，这地方真的很特别！”

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: We are! Here at Tanglewood Works, we focus on things that are handmade, reclaimed and recycled.
dialogue.zh: 没错！在 Tanglewood Works，我们做的是手工、再利用和回收的东西。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow! That is really good for the environment.
dialogue.zh: 哇！这对环境真的很好。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: It’s good for you too. Local artists made all of these one-of-a-kind pieces. And I paint most of the furniture.
dialogue.zh: 对你也好。这些独一无二的作品都是本地艺术家做的。家具大多是我刷的漆。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can I look around?
dialogue.zh: 我可以转转吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Oh, please do.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: So, Anna, do you like to make things?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你喜欢动手做东西吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me? Oh, no. Every time I try to make something, something goes wrong.
dialogue.zh: 我？哦，不。我每次一动手，就会出问题。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, sorry. Sorry.
dialogue.zh: 哦，对不起。对不起。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: It’s okay. Anna, everybody can make something.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。安娜，每个人都能做出点什么。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sue, this piece is very interesting!
dialogue.zh: 苏，这件作品很有意思！

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: You know, when I found these pieces, they were broken and in a dumpster. But they spoke to me. And they said, “Save me, Sue! Save me!”
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，我找到这些东西时，它们是破的，在垃圾箱里。可它们对我说话了。它们说：“救救我，苏！救救我！”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sue, what do you mean they “spoke” to you?
dialogue.zh: 苏，你说它们对你“说话”是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: When I see something special that someone has thrown away, I can almost hear it talk.
dialogue.zh: 当我看到别人扔掉的特别的东西，我几乎能听见它说话。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s not saying anything!
dialogue.zh: 它什么也没说啊！

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Anna, it’s not easy to see the treasure in trash.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，要从垃圾里看出宝贝可不容易。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Or hear it talk.
dialogue.zh: 或者听见它说话。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: But you can learn. In fact, I teach private classes. And one is called Turning Trash to Treasure.
dialogue.zh: 可你可以学。其实我教私人课。有一门就叫“变废为宝”。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Next week, bring in some trash and we’ll turn it into treasure. Just remember – pick some trash that “speaks” to you.
dialogue.zh: 下周带点垃圾来，我们把它变成宝贝。记住——挑那种会对你“说话”的垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Got it! I’ll see you next week!
dialogue.zh: 明白了！下周见！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Will Anna find trash that “speaks” to her? What will it say? We’ll find out next week!
dialogue.zh: 安娜能找到对她“说话”的垃圾吗？它会说什么？我们下周再看！

choices: He has a birthday coming up
He asked her for a clown

choices: A painted chair from the dumpster

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 22
lessons.subtitle: Trash to Treasure, Part 2

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Welcome to class, Anna. I can’t wait to see your trash!
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来上课，安娜。我等不及要看你的垃圾了！

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Oh, okay. Alright, it’s a -- it’s a net with a … oh, it’s got a hole in it. Tell me about that.
dialogue.zh: 哦，好。好吧，这是——一张网，上面……哦，有个洞。跟我说说这个。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This net said to me, “Anna, I used to catch stuff. I don’t anymore. So, use me, Anna.” That’s what it said. It said, “Use me, Anna.”
dialogue.zh: 这张网对我说：“安娜，我以前能抓东西。现在不行了。所以，用我吧，安娜。”它就是这么说的。它说：“用我吧，安娜。”

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Okay. So...it’s a plastic helmet.
dialogue.zh: 好。那……这是一顶塑料头盔。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This plastic helmet said, “Anna. Hey, Anna, find me a head.”
dialogue.zh: 这顶塑料头盔说：“安娜。嘿，安娜，给我找个头。”

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Okay, um...and a broken toy.
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯……还有一个破玩具。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This broken toy … this broken toy said to me – it said, “Anna, help me find fun.” “Help me, Anna” is what it said.
dialogue.zh: 这个破玩具……这个破玩具对我说——它说：“安娜，帮我找回乐趣。”“帮帮我，安娜”，它就是这么说的。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Anna, this stuff is not saying anything to you or me or anyone. It’s what we like to call in the business … garbage.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，这些东西对你、对我、对谁都没说话。我们行里管这叫……垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: But you said to bring in trash.
dialogue.zh: 可你说要带垃圾来。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Sometimes trash is treasure. Sometimes it's just trash.
dialogue.zh: 有时垃圾是宝贝。有时它就只是垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Anna, don’t worry. Next week, I could teach you decoupage.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，别担心。下周我可以教你做 decoupage。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Decoupage. Decoupage. That’s fun to say.
dialogue.zh: Decoupage。Decoupage。这词说起来真好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: All you need to bring is a clean shoe box. A box that held shoes.
dialogue.zh: 你只需要带一个干净的鞋盒。装过鞋的盒子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I got it. I got it! See you next week!
dialogue.zh: 明白了。明白了！下周见！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Uh oh. It looks like Anna doesn’t know the difference between treasure and trash. She thinks those things are telling her something! The words tell and say have similar meanings. But we use them in different ways. Tell means “to inform or instruct someone with words” and is almost always followed by an indirect object. For example, Sue says, “Tell me about that.” The word me is the indirect object and tells us who is being told. Say means “to express something with words” and focuses more on the words used. For example, Anna says, “That’s what it said. It said, ‘Use me, Anna.’” Listen for when Anna and Sue use tell and say.
dialogue.zh: 哎呀。看起来安娜分不清宝贝和垃圾。她觉得那些东西在跟她说话！tell 和 say 意思相近，但用法不同。tell 表示“用话告知或指示某人”，后面几乎总跟间接宾语。比如苏说：“Tell me about that。” me 就是间接宾语，告诉我们在对谁说。say 表示“用话说出某事”，更侧重说了什么。比如安娜说：“That’s what it said. It said, ‘Use me, Anna.’” 注意听安娜和苏什么时候用 tell 和 say。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Anna, welcome to Decoupage class. Decoupage is just gluing pretty pictures onto stuff.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，欢迎来上拼贴课。Decoupage 就是把漂亮的图片粘到东西上。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Anna, I’ve got to talk to this person. I’ll be right back. Don’t start without me.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我得跟这个人说几句。马上回来。别不等我就开始。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Got it.
dialogue.zh: 知道了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. I can fix this.
dialogue.zh: 好。我能修好这个。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Anna, what happened? I told you to wait for me!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，怎么了？我告诉过你等我！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Actually, you told me not to start without you, which I didn’t. Your glue is really sticky.
dialogue.zh: 其实你说的是别不等你就开始，我没有不等你。你的胶水真的很黏。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Next week, let’s try lamp making. There’s – there’s no glue. Here's a flier.
dialogue.zh: 下周我们试试做灯。没有——没有胶水。这是传单。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks. See you next week.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。下周见。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Anna, you did really well this week. I think lamp making might be your thing!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你这周做得真好。我觉得做灯可能适合你！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Sue. I did everything you told me to do.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，苏。你让我做的我都做了。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Remember: I said to read the instructions really carefully. Where are those instructions?
dialogue.zh: 记住：我说了要非常仔细地读说明书。说明书呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let’s just plug it in!
dialogue.zh: 我们直接插上电吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, what class will you be teaching next week?
dialogue.zh: 那下周你要教什么课？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Too bad Anna didn’t follow instructions! Visit our website for more on tell and say!
dialogue.zh: 可惜安娜没按说明书做！去我们的网站看更多关于 tell 和 say 的内容吧！

quiz.prompt: What does Sue call the net, helmet, and broken toy Anna brought?
What happens while Sue is on the phone in decoupage class?
choices: Anna gets covered with glue and paper
Anna finishes a perfect shoe box
Anna rents a clown for Pete

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 23
lessons.subtitle: Rock Star

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello?
dialogue.zh: 喂？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna, this is Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我是韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver!
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Tomorrow, you’ll be interviewing musician Emma G.
dialogue.zh: 明天，你将采访音乐家 Emma G。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Emma G?! I will be talking to Emma G?!
dialogue.zh: Emma G？！我要跟 Emma G 谈话？！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna? Anna, are you there?
dialogue.zh: 安娜？安娜，你还在吗？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna and Ms. Weaver used the future continuous verb tense to talk about the interview. We use future continuous to talk about actions that will be in progress at or around a time in the future. For example, Ms. Weaver says, “Tomorrow, you’ll be interviewing musician Emma G.” There are two options for future continuous. The first is: will be + the -ing form of the verb. And the second is: be + going to be + the -ing form of the verb. Keep watching for more!
dialogue.zh: 安娜和韦弗女士用将来进行时来谈这次采访。将来进行时用来表示将来某个时间正在进行的动作。比如韦弗女士说：“Tomorrow, you’ll be interviewing musician Emma G.” 将来进行时有两种形式。第一种：will be + 动词的 -ing 形式。第二种：be + going to be + 动词的 -ing 形式。继续看！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello and welcome to The Music! Today, musician Emma G will be joining us here!
dialogue.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 The Music！今天，音乐家 Emma G 将来到这里！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She is a wonderful songwriter and an amazing singer. And I love her! Let’s give a warm welcome to Emma G!
dialogue.zh: 她是出色的词曲作者，也是了不起的歌手。而且我超爱她！让我们热烈欢迎 Emma G！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi. Thank you for coming on the show, Emma G.
dialogue.zh: 嗨。谢谢你来上节目，Emma G。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Of course. It’s great to be here.
dialogue.zh: 当然。很高兴来到这里。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, we can’t wait to hear you sing. I listen to your music a lot. So, I feel like I know you. Is that strange?
dialogue.zh: 我们等不及听你唱歌了。我经常听你的歌。所以感觉好像认识你。这奇怪吗？

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Anna, listening to music can be a very personal experience. So, no, that’s not strange.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，听音乐可以是很个人的体验。所以，不，这不奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good because I made something for you -- a video scrapbook of our friendship.
dialogue.zh: 那就好，因为我给你做了个东西——我们友谊的视频剪贴簿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I took photos of you and added myself. I worked on it all weekend.
dialogue.zh: 我用了你的照片，再把自己加进去。我做了整整一个周末。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Well, that -- that’s strange. Is that even -- is that even legal?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那——那有点奇怪。这甚至——这合法吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now, Emma, let’s talk about your schedule. Tell me ... I mean, tell us exactly where you will be and when. Exactly.
dialogue.zh: 好，Emma，我们来谈谈你的行程。告诉我……我是说，准确地告诉我们你什么时候会在哪里。准确的。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Sure. Well, in early June, I’ll be performing at several venues across Austin, Texas.
dialogue.zh: 好。六月初，我将在得克萨斯州奥斯汀的几个场地演出。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s my vacation week. I can meet you there! We can tour the city. We can have lunch.
dialogue.zh: 那是我的假期周。我可以去那儿见你！我们可以逛城市。我们可以吃午饭。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Um, yeah maybe. Then in mid-July, I’m going to be teaching at a music camp in Chicago.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，也许吧。然后七月中旬，我将在芝加哥的一个音乐营教课。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’ll be visiting my sister then. She only lives about six hours from Chicago! I could drive over. We could hang out.
dialogue.zh: 那时我会去看我姐姐。她住的地方离芝加哥大概六个小时！我可以开车过去。我们可以一起玩。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Yeah, uh maybe. You know, maybe now is a good time for some music.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，也许吧。你知道，也许现在适合来点音乐。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s a great idea. Now, let's hear a song from Emma G.!
dialogue.zh: 好主意。现在，来听 Emma G. 的一首歌！

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: I wrote this song a couple of years ago. It’s called “Wary.”
dialogue.zh: 这首歌是我几年前写的。叫《Wary》。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Do you believe in happy endings?
dialogue.zh: 你相信圆满结局吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Endings...
dialogue.zh: 结局……

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Do you really believe that we could be…
dialogue.zh: 你真的相信我们能……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Be...

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: I think something is wrong. I hear a voice in the background.
dialogue.zh: 我觉得有点不对。我听到背景里有个声音。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry. Sorry, Emma. That was me. I’m just so excited.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。抱歉，Emma。是我。我实在太兴奋了。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: No problem. I'm glad you like the song.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。我很高兴你喜欢这首歌。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You go ahead. You go ahead.
dialogue.zh: 你继续。你继续。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you believe in happy endings?
dialogue.zh: 好。你相信圆满结局吗？

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Anna, there’s no tambourine in this.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，这首歌没有铃鼓。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m so sorry. I’m so sorry, Emma. See, I’ve always wanted to sing with you.
dialogue.zh: 真对不起。真对不起，Emma。你看，我一直想跟你一起唱。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Well, come on over then and we can sing a song together first.
dialogue.zh: 那过来吧，我们先一起唱一首。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I couldn't.
dialogue.zh: 不，我不行。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Come on. It’ll be fun.
dialogue.zh: 来嘛。会很好玩的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay! Here. I brought my favorite song.
dialogue.zh: 好！给。我带了我最喜欢的歌。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Oh, uh okay. Actually, I like this song. Um, are you ready?
dialogue.zh: 哦，嗯好。其实我喜欢这首歌。准备好了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! Yes!
dialogue.zh: 好了！好了！

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G / Anna
dialogue.en: Every breath you take. Every move you make. Every bond you break. Every step you take. I'll be watching you … I’ll be watching you... I’ll be watching you...
dialogue.zh: 你的每一次呼吸。你的每一个动作。你打破的每一段关系。你的每一步。我都会看着你……我都会看着你……我都会看着你……

What does Anna make for Emma G?
choices: A video scrapbook of their friendship

quiz.prompt: What does Anna do during Emma G’s song “Wary”?
choices: She sings and plays tambourine in the background

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 24
lessons.subtitle: I Feel Super!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi! I see you like superhero culture. Me too.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我看你喜欢超级英雄文化。我也是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In fact, tonight I’m going to the big superhero convention. Are you going?
dialogue.zh: 其实今晚我要去超级英雄大会。你去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Um, I don’t know.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我不知道。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, you'd better decide soon. Last year, it sold out.
dialogue.zh: 那你最好快点决定。去年票卖光了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, since we’re talking about superheroes: would you rather become a superhero by accident, like Spiderman, or be born a superhero, like Wonder Woman?
dialogue.zh: 既然我们在谈超级英雄：你更愿意像蜘蛛侠那样意外成为超级英雄，还是像神奇女侠那样生来就是？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Take your time. It’s a big question. I thought about it for days –
dialogue.zh: 慢慢想。这是个大问题。我想了好几天——

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Okay. If I had to choose, I’d rather be born a superhero.
dialogue.zh: 好。如果必须选，我更愿意生来就是超级英雄。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’d rather become a superhero by an unexpected accident!
dialogue.zh: 我更愿意因为一场意外事故成为超级英雄！

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Aren’t all accidents unexpected?
dialogue.zh: 事故不都是意外的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, yeah.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，对。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: What was that!? Are you okay?
dialogue.zh: 那是什么？！你没事吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm better than okay. I feel super!
dialogue.zh: 我岂止没事。我感觉超棒！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Oh no! Anna was just hit by lightning. She had better get help. We use had better to give advice. It is very informal and stronger than should and ought to. For example, Anna says: “You'd better decide soon. Last year, it sold out.” When we use had better, we usually shorten the word had for personal pronouns. We use would rather to say what we or someone else prefers to do or have. For example, the boy says: “Okay. If I had to choose, I’d rather be born a superhero.” With would rather, we also shorten the word would when used with personal pronouns. Keep watching and listen for had better and would rather.
dialogue.zh: 哦不！安娜刚被闪电击中。她最好去求助。had better 用来给建议，很口语，比 should 和 ought to 更强。比如安娜说：“You'd better decide soon. Last year, it sold out.” 用 had better 时，人称代词后的 had 通常缩写。would rather 用来表示自己或别人更想做什么或要什么。比如那个男孩说：“Okay. If I had to choose, I’d rather be born a superhero.” 用 would rather 时，人称代词后的 would 也常缩写。继续看，注意听 had better 和 would rather。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: You’d better see a doctor.
dialogue.zh: 你最好去看医生。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’ve never felt better!
dialogue.zh: 我从来没这么好过！

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: You were just struck by lightning!! And what happened to your hair and your clothes?
dialogue.zh: 你刚被闪电击中了！！你的头发和衣服怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't know. Wait, I do know. This is my super suit! And this is my origin story.
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。等等，我知道了。这是我的超级战衣！这也是我的起源故事。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: What are you talking about?
dialogue.zh: 你在说什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: An origin story tells the beginning of a superhero. You should know that.
dialogue.zh: 起源故事讲的是超级英雄的开始。这你该知道。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: You're not making any sense, lady.
dialogue.zh: 女士，你说的完全没道理。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I would rather be called Lightning Bolt Lady! It’ll sound great in a theme song: Lightning Bolt Lady!
dialogue.zh: 我更愿意叫闪电女士！主题曲里会很好听：闪电女士！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now, I need to find my superpowers --
dialogue.zh: 现在，我得找到我的超能力——

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Um, I really think --
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我真的觉得——

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wait. Don’t tell me. I’ll read your mind. You are thinking you’d like to be my super helper.
dialogue.zh: 等等。别告诉我。我来读你的心。你在想你想当我的超级助手。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: I was not thinking that.
dialogue.zh: 我没那么想。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: ... that you’d like to live in a treehouse.
dialogue.zh: ……你想住在树屋里。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: … that you should eat more vegetables.
dialogue.zh: ……你该多吃蔬菜。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Please, stop talking. You really should get some help.
dialogue.zh: 请你别说了。你真的该去求助。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Mind reading is not my superpower. Maybe I can become invisible. I … am … invisible!
dialogue.zh: 读心不是我的超能力。也许我能隐身。我……隐……身了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You can’t see me. Who am I? I’m not here. You can’t see me.
dialogue.zh: 你看不见我。我是谁？我不在这儿。你看不见我。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: I can see you and so can everybody else.
dialogue.zh: 我看得见你，别人也看得见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No power of invisibility. Maybe I can create a force field. I feel it working. Nothing can hurt –
dialogue.zh: 没有隐身能力。也许我能制造力场。我感觉它在起作用。什么都伤不了——

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ow, that wasn’t very nice. I see I have a lot of work to do. Well, goodbye, non-super person!
dialogue.zh: 哎哟，那可不太友好。看来我还有很多要练。好了，再见，非超级人！

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Wait. I’d better go with you. You might get worse…if that’s even possible.
dialogue.zh: 等等。我最好跟你一起去。你可能会更糟……如果还能更糟的话。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That's very nice of you, ordinary human. But I’d rather go by myself. This is a quest.
dialogue.zh: 你真好，普通人类。可我更愿意自己去。这是一次任务。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Every time you speak, I get more confused.
dialogue.zh: 你每说一句，我就更糊涂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A quest is a part of all superhero stories. You really need to work on your superhero studies. Now, stand back. I’ve never flown before.
dialogue.zh: 任务是所有超级英雄故事的一部分。你真该补补超级英雄课。现在，退后。我以前从没飞过。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: And you’re not flying now.
dialogue.zh: 你现在也没在飞。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Flying is also not my superpower. That’s too bad. It's going to be expensive to Uber everywhere. You know, I'd rather walk. It’s a nice day. Goodbye, non-super person.
dialogue.zh: 飞也不是我的超能力。太可惜了。到处打车会很贵。你知道吗，我宁愿走路。今天天气不错。再见，非超级人。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: I am not talking to strangers again.
dialogue.zh: 我再也不跟陌生人说话了。

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: Will Lightning Bolt Lady find her superpowers … ever? Ouch! Did that brick wall hurt? Will the young man ever talk to a stranger again? Find out on the next episode of Let’s Learn English!
dialogue.zh: 闪电女士到底……找不找得到她的超能力？哎哟！那面砖墙疼不疼？那个年轻人还会再跟陌生人说话吗？请看下集 Let’s Learn English！

quiz.prompt: What happens to Anna while she is talking about superheroes?
What name does Anna want to be called?
Which superpower does Anna actually have in this lesson?
choices: None of the ones she tries

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 25
lessons.subtitle: Only Human

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: When last we saw Anna, she had made a new friend. And they had been talking about superheroes for a while when suddenly Anna became Lightning Bolt Lady!
dialogue.zh: 上次我们看到安娜时，她交了一个新朋友。他们已经谈了一会儿超级英雄，突然安娜变成了闪电女士！

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: She tried to find her superpowers. But it did not go well.
dialogue.zh: 她试着寻找自己的超能力。但并不顺利。

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: She can’t fly, become invisible or create a force field. And she really cannot walk through walls. Ouch, Lightning Bolt Lady.
dialogue.zh: 她不会飞，不能隐身，也不能制造力场。她也真的不能穿墙。哎哟，闪电女士。

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: She had been walking into that wall for about 15 minutes when she had a great idea.
dialogue.zh: 她朝那面墙走了大约十五分钟，这时她想到一个好主意。

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: I just had a great idea!
dialogue.zh: 我刚想到一个好主意！

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: I can’t wait to hear this one! But first, let’s talk about grammar. Professor Bot is on vacation this week. I’m the announcer. So, I’m going to tell you about the past perfect continuous. We use this verb tense to show that an action started in the past and continued to another time or action in the past. For example, I said, “She had been walking into that wall for about 15 minutes when she had a great idea.” Had been walking is the past perfect continuous of the verb walk. It’s had been plus the -ing form of the verb. You’ll hear me use this verb tense a few more times today. Now, what am I forgetting? Oh right! Lightning Bolt Lady’s great idea.
dialogue.zh: 我等不及听这个了！不过先讲语法。机器人教授这周休假。我是旁白。所以我来讲过去完成进行时。这个时态表示一个动作从过去开始，一直持续到过去的另一个时间或动作。比如我说：“She had been walking into that wall for about 15 minutes when she had a great idea.” had been walking 就是 walk 的过去完成进行时。形式是 had been 加上动词的 -ing 形式。今天你还会再听到我用几次。我忘了什么来着？对了！闪电女士的好主意。

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: If I want to know my superpowers, I’ll need to learn about lightning!
dialogue.zh: 如果我想知道自己的超能力，就得先了解闪电！

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: So, she read many books about lightning.
dialogue.zh: 于是她读了很多关于闪电的书。

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Wow. A lightning strike usually lasts less than a second.
dialogue.zh: 哇。一次雷击通常不到一秒钟。

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Lightning is really fast and I like speed walking. So, maybe one of my superpowers is super-speed walking! (to stranger) Bye!
dialogue.zh: 闪电非常快，而我喜欢竞走。所以，也许我的超能力之一就是超级竞走！（对陌生人）再见！

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Check! Super-speed walking is definitely one of my superpowers.
dialogue.zh: 搞定！超级竞走绝对是我的超能力之一。

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Lightning has millions of volts of electricity. Amazing!
dialogue.zh: 闪电有数百万伏特的电。太神奇了！

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Wow! I can charge a lot of batteries with this superpower!
dialogue.zh: 哇！用这个超能力我能给很多电池充电！

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: She had been looking for hours for someone to help when she found her chance.
dialogue.zh: 她找了几个小时想帮人，这时终于等到机会。

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: Hello? Hello? I’m sorry. I’m going to have to call you back. My phone is dying.
dialogue.zh: 喂？喂？抱歉。我得回你电话。我手机快没电了。

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Excuse me, I can charge your phone.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我能给你的手机充电。

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: Really? Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 真的？谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: I’m Lightning Bolt Lady!
dialogue.zh: 我是闪电女士！

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: She had been practicing her superpowers all day. Suddenly, she heard a terrible sound – a child’s disappointment.
dialogue.zh: 她练了一整天超能力。突然，她听到一个可怕的声音——孩子的失望。

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: These children tried to light a fire for over an hour. But then, they gave up.
dialogue.zh: 这些孩子试着生火超过一个小时。然后他们放弃了。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Hey kids, that wood will never burn. It'is too wet.
dialogue.zh: 孩子们，那些木头烧不着。太湿了。

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Small humans, what is wrong?
dialogue.zh: 小人类们，怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.en: Stranger danger!
dialogue.zh: 陌生人危险！

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: I’m Lightning Bolt Lady!
dialogue.zh: 我是闪电女士！

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Oh no. It’s you.
dialogue.zh: 哦不。是你。

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: We meet again. And guess what: I found my superpowers.
dialogue.zh: 我们又见面了。你猜怎么着：我找到我的超能力了。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.en: Well, we need a fire to toast the marshmallows to make S’mores.
dialogue.zh: 我们需要火来烤棉花糖，做 S’mores。

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: I can help.
dialogue.zh: 我能帮忙。

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: We don’t need a super-speed walker but thanks!
dialogue.zh: 我们不需要超级竞走的人，不过还是谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Super-speed walking is just one of my superpowers. I can also do this!
dialogue.zh: 超级竞走只是我的超能力之一。我还能这样！

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Sorry! Let me do it again.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！让我再来一次。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.en: Thanks, Lightning Bolt Lady!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你，闪电女士！

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.zh: 闪电女士

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: You’re welcome. But you don’t have enough firewood. Using my super-speed walking, I will get more.
dialogue.zh: 不客气。可你们木柴不够。我用超级竞走再去多拿一些。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Lightning Bolt Lady, come back! A lightning storm is coming!
dialogue.zh: 闪电女士，回来！雷暴要来了！

dialogue.speaker: Lightning Bolt Lady
dialogue.en: Not a chance! There’s not a cloud in the …
dialogue.zh: 不可能！天上连一朵云都……

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.en: Lightning Bolt Lady, are you okay?
dialogue.zh: 闪电女士，你没事吧？

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.en: Where's your super-suit?
dialogue.zh: 你的超级战衣呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh no! I've lost my superpowers!
dialogue.zh: 哦不！我失去超能力了！

dialogue.speaker: Young Man
dialogue.en: It's starting to rain. Do you want to go inside and eat some S’mores?
dialogue.zh: 开始下雨了。要不要进去吃点 S’mores？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You read my mind.
dialogue.zh: 你读懂我的心了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, I thought mind reading would be one of my superpowers. But it wasn’t.
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，我还以为读心会是我的超能力之一。可并不是。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.en: That’d be a cool superpower.
dialogue.zh: 那会是很酷的超能力。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.en: But I’d rather be able to talk to animals.
dialogue.zh: 可我更愿意能跟动物说话。

quiz.prompt: Which superpower does Lightning Bolt Lady decide she has?
What happens when she tries to charge the woman’s phone?
How does Lightning Bolt Lady lose her superpowers?
choices: She is hit by a lightning storm
She gives them to the children

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 26
lessons.subtitle: Look-alikes

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This article is so interesting. Pete, listen to this: “Somewhere in the world there is someone who looks just like you.”
dialogue.zh: 这篇文章太有意思了。皮特，你听这个：“世界上某个地方，有一个长得跟你一模一样的人。”

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No one is this handsome.
dialogue.zh: 没人有这么帅。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh Pete, there’s something between your teeth.
dialogue.zh: 哦皮特，你牙缝里有东西。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It is gone?
dialogue.zh: 没了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. No. It’s still there. There. You got it. But think of it: There could be two of us in the world!
dialogue.zh: 没有。没有。还在。好了，弄掉了。可你想想：世界上可能有两个我们！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Two Annas?
dialogue.zh: 两个安娜？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Actually, Anna, maybe your silly article is right. Yesterday at work, I met a woman who looks just like you.
dialogue.zh: 其实，安娜，也许你那篇傻文章是对的。昨天上班时，我遇见一个长得跟你一模一样的女人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Really? Wait, are you making fun of me?
dialogue.zh: 真的？等等，你是在取笑我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Not this time.
dialogue.zh: 这次不是。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: She’s tall and has curly hair. But even her face looks like yours. I think she’s a career consultant.
dialogue.zh: 她很高，有卷发。可连脸都像你。我觉得她是职业顾问。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I bet she has a lot of great advice. I can’t wait to meet her.
dialogue.zh: 我敢说她一定有很多好建议。我等不及想见她。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yes, you can. I met her and she is very difficult.
dialogue.zh: 你等得及。我见过她，她很难相处。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, she’s just new. We have to give her a chance. What’s her name?
dialogue.zh: 皮特，她只是新人。我们得给她一个机会。她叫什么？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Evelyna or something like that. You can’t miss her. She always wears a hat.
dialogue.zh: 伊维琳娜之类的。你不会认错。她总是戴着帽子。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: So, Anna, have you met the new consultant yet?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你见过新来的顾问了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. But I’ve already heard. We look alike, don’t we?
dialogue.zh: 还没有。可我已经听说了。我们长得很像，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Yeah, but you don’t act alike. You’re much nicer than she is.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，可你们做事不像。你比她好多了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Maybe she gets nervous at new jobs. Or maybe she’s shy. Let’s not judge, Penelope.
dialogue.zh: 也许她在新工作上会紧张。或者她只是害羞。咱们别急着下判断，佩内洛普。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: She’s not nervous or shy. She’s mean.
dialogue.zh: 她不紧张也不害羞。她很刻薄。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, we should get to know her better. Let’s invite her to lunch!
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，我们应该多了解她一点。请她一起吃午饭吧！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Sorry but I’m busy that day.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，那天我有事。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, that’s too bad. Hey, I haven’t picked a day yet!
dialogue.zh: 哦，太可惜了。嘿，我还没定是哪天呢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is going to be so much fun. Boy, I can’t wait to play this game.
dialogue.zh: 这会很好玩。天哪，我等不及要玩这个游戏了。

dialogue.speaker: Evilana
dialogue.en: How much longer are you going to be?
dialogue.zh: 你们还要多久？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We’ll be just a minute …
dialogue.zh: 我们只要一分钟……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You must be Evelana. I’m Anna. We are look-alikes!
dialogue.zh: 你一定是伊维拉娜。我是安娜。我们是长相相似的人！

dialogue.speaker: Evilana
dialogue.en: No, we’re not. And my name is pronounced “Evil-ana.”
dialogue.zh: 我们不是。而且我的名字读作“Evil-ana”。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Oh. This is going to be fun.
dialogue.zh: 哦。这会很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Evilana
dialogue.en: You had better hurry up. I need this room for a lecture. It’s called: “If You Want to Win, Others Must Lose.” What is all this stuff, anyway?
dialogue.zh: 你们最好快点。我要用这间房讲课。课名叫：“如果你想赢，别人就必须输。”这些东西到底是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s a game. We’re going to play at lunch.
dialogue.zh: 是个游戏。我们午饭时要玩。

dialogue.speaker: Evilana
dialogue.en: It’s a stupid child’s game!
dialogue.zh: 这是个愚蠢的儿童游戏！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s a fun game. But yes, it is for children.
dialogue.zh: 这是个有趣的游戏。不过没错，它是给孩子的。

dialogue.speaker: Evilana
dialogue.en: Well, you may be childish but I’m not. And you look stupid with that thing on your head.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，你也许很孩子气，可我不是。而且你头上戴着那东西看起来很傻。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, you look serious with that look on your face. Come on, Pete. Let’s play somewhere else.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，你那副表情看起来很严肃。走吧，皮特。我们去别处玩。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Actually, I’m going to stay for Evilana’s lecture.
dialogue.zh: 其实，我要留下来听伊维拉娜的讲座。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Fine. You can learn new ways to beat people.
dialogue.zh: 行。你可以学学怎么赢别人。

dialogue.speaker: Evilana
dialogue.en: He will. He will.
dialogue.zh: 他会的。他会的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. Am I a food?
dialogue.zh: 好。我是一种食物吗？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Nope.
dialogue.zh: 不是。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hey, do you guys have room for one more?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，你们还能再加一个人吗？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Sure, Pete! Come on over. What happened to your eye?
dialogue.zh: 当然，皮特！过来吧。你的眼睛怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Evilana “accidentally” hit me. And she didn’t even say sorry. She’s so mean!
dialogue.zh: 伊维拉娜“不小心”打到我了。她连对不起都没说。她太刻薄了！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I told you so.
dialogue.zh: 我早就说了吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here, Pete. Put on this headband. You’ll feel better. Penelope, you’re right. Evilana is an awful person!
dialogue.zh: 来，皮特。戴上这个头带。你会好受些。佩内洛普，你说得对。伊维拉娜是个很糟糕的人！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: And violent. And now we have to work with her!
dialogue.zh: 还很暴力。现在我们还得跟她一起工作！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Haven’t you heard? She’s gone! She was given another assignment.
dialogue.zh: 你们没听说吗？她走了！她被派去做另一个任务了。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: What assignment?
dialogue.zh: 什么任务？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m not sure. I think it has something to do with outdoors. Anyway, let’s play! Pete it’s your turn.
dialogue.zh: 我不确定。我觉得跟户外有关。不管怎样，咱们玩吧！皮特，轮到你了。

quiz.prompt: What does Pete say about the new woman at work?
How does Evilana want her name pronounced?
What happens to Evilana at the end?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 27
lessons.subtitle: Fish out of Water

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Ms. Weaver!
dialogue.zh: 你好，韦弗女士！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Oh, Anna. I’ve invited some people to dinner Saturday. We’re going to that new seafood restaurant -- Fish on a Dish.
dialogue.zh: 哦，安娜。我周六请了一些人吃饭。我们要去那家新的海鲜餐厅——盘中鱼。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Why don’t you join us? My treat.
dialogue.zh: 你为什么不一起来？我请客。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Ms. Weaver. But I already have plans. My friend has invited me to her houseboat.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，韦弗女士。可我已经有安排了。我朋友请我去她的船屋。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Houseboat, really? That’s unique.
dialogue.zh: 船屋，真的？那可真特别。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, it is. In fact, I’m thinking of living on a houseboat.
dialogue.zh: 是啊。其实，我还在考虑住在船屋上。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Aren’t you too tall and klutzy to live on a houseboat?
dialogue.zh: 你会不会太高、太笨手笨脚，不适合住船屋？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am not too tall!
dialogue.zh: 我才没有太高！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Is Anna really ready for a houseboat?
dialogue.zh: 安娜真的准备好住船屋了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver invited Anna to dinner. When we make friendly, informal invitations, we use phrases like “Why don’t…?”
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士请安娜吃饭。我们发出友好、非正式的邀请时，会用 “Why don’t…?” 这样的说法。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: For example, Ms. Weaver said, “Why don’t you join us? My treat!” That’s: Why don’t plus the subject plus the simple form of the verb.
dialogue.zh: 比如韦弗女士说：“Why don’t you join us? My treat!” 结构是：Why don’t 加上主语，再加上动词原形。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna responded to the invitation by saying, “Thanks, but I already have plans.” Keep watching for more examples of informal invitations!
dialogue.zh: 安娜回应邀请时说：“Thanks, but I already have plans.” 继续看，后面还有更多非正式邀请的例子！

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: Anna, I’m so glad you could come!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，真高兴你能来！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Fanny!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，范妮！

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: Hi, this is my son, Phoenix.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，这是我儿子菲尼克斯。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Phoenix.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，菲尼克斯。

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: How about you give Anna a tour and I will make some lunch?
dialogue.zh: 你带安娜参观一下，我去做午饭怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: Aye, aye, captain!
dialogue.zh: 是，船长！

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: Great!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Do you really call her “captain”?
dialogue.zh: 你真的叫她“船长”吗？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: I kind of have to.
dialogue.zh: 我好像不得不叫。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, Phoenix, I think I’d like to live on a houseboat. Do you like living here?
dialogue.zh: 菲尼克斯，我觉得我想住在船屋上。你喜欢住在这儿吗？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: I love it! It’s much different than living in a house.
dialogue.zh: 我太喜欢了！这跟住在房子里很不一样。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, I bet. I bet you had to get rid of a lot of stuff, didn’t you?
dialogue.zh: 哦，我猜也是。我猜你们得扔掉很多东西，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: No way! We moved from a 3-story house to a boat! So, we really had to downsize!
dialogue.zh: 才不是扔掉那么简单！我们从一栋三层的房子搬到船上！所以真的得大幅缩小规模！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’d have to get rid of a lot of stuff. I have a rock collection and I have some really big rocks.
dialogue.zh: 我得扔掉很多东西。我有石头收藏，还有一些特别大的石头。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can you stop this boat from rocking for a minute?
dialogue.zh: 你能不能让这船先别晃一分钟？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: No. We’re floating on water. I can’t do that.
dialogue.zh: 不行。我们浮在水上。我做不到。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, since you live on the water, aren’t you afraid of great white sharks?
dialogue.zh: 既然你们住在水上，难道不怕大白鲨吗？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: No, not really. They don’t live in these waters.
dialogue.zh: 不太怕。它们不住在这片水域。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: … that you know of. What about killer whales?
dialogue.zh: ……就你所知。那逆戟鲸呢？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Electric eels?
dialogue.zh: 电鳗呢？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Barracudas?
dialogue.zh: 梭鱼呢？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Piranhas?
dialogue.zh: 食人鱼呢？

dialogue.speaker: Phoenix
dialogue.en: Uh-uh.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: You know, Anna, if you’re afraid of sea life, maybe you shouldn’t live on a houseboat. Do you have any boating experience?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你知道吗，要是你怕海洋生物，也许就不该住船屋。你有没有驾船经验？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, oh yeah, Fanny. I have battled the great waters before -- once on a swan boat and once in a duck boat ... bus. It was a boat that turned into a bus.
dialogue.zh: 哦，哦有的，范妮。我以前跟浩瀚水域交过手——一次是天鹅船，一次是鸭子船……巴士。那是一艘会变成巴士的船。

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: Yeah, I don’t think that counts.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我觉得那不算。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Fanny, does this rocking ever bother you?
dialogue.zh: 范妮，这种摇晃会不会让你难受？

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: No, I love it. It goes up and down and side to side and up and down. Anna, I love it!
dialogue.zh: 不会，我超爱。它上上下下，左右晃，再上上下下。安娜，我爱死了！

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: Anna, are you feeling okay?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你还好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah, yeah. You know, I just need some fresh air.
dialogue.zh: 还好，还好。你知道吗，我只是需要点新鲜空气。

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: Let me open a window for you.
dialogue.zh: 我给你开扇窗。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I need some fresh land air. I mean, I need to breathe air on land. Oh, is that the time? I should really be going.
dialogue.zh: 不，我需要陆地上的新鲜空气。我是说，我得在陆地上呼吸。哦，都这时候了？我真该走了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks for lunch, Fanny, and a tour of your houseboat. It’s given me a great idea!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢午饭，范妮，也谢谢带我参观你的船屋。这给了我一个好主意！

dialogue.speaker: Fanny
dialogue.en: You’re going to live on a houseboat?
dialogue.zh: 你要住船屋了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sort of. Thanks again!
dialogue.zh: 算是吧。再次谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi! How would you like to hang out on my boat? Great! See you then!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！要不要来我的船上玩？太好了！到时候见！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: …and this is my shark net.
dialogue.zh: ……这是我的防鲨网。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Thank you for the invitation, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你的邀请，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Of course, would you like more orange juice?
dialogue.zh: 当然，还要橙汁吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Uh..

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: (to young man) Ahoy!
dialogue.zh: （对年轻人）啊嗬！

quiz.prompt: Why does Anna turn down Ms. Weaver’s dinner invitation?
choices: She is visiting a friend’s houseboat
She has to work late Saturday

quiz.prompt: What bothers Anna on Fanny’s houseboat?
choices: Phoenix will not give a tour

quiz.prompt: Where does Anna host Ms. Weaver at the end?
choices: On a boat sitting on land

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 28
lessons.subtitle: For the Birds

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Oh, Anna, there you are! I am so glad we joined the Great City Bird Count! Aren't you?
dialogue.zh: 哦，安娜，你在这儿！真高兴我们参加了大城市观鸟统计！你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. Today has been a bust … a flop … a bummer!
dialogue.zh: 不高兴。今天彻底砸了……失败……糟透了！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: I’m sensing a little disappointment.
dialogue.zh: 我感觉到你有一点失望。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A little?
dialogue.zh: 一点？

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: My official bird-watching form is almost full!
dialogue.zh: 我的官方观鸟表都快填满了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I've only seen pigeons ... lots and lots of pigeons! But I did write down some other valuable information.
dialogue.zh: 我只看到鸽子……好多好多鸽子！不过我倒记下了另一些很有价值的信息。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Did you find a bird's nest?!
dialogue.zh: 你找到鸟巢了？！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I found 10 ice cream trucks in this five-block area. Their music seems to follow me everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 我在这五个街区里找到了 10 辆冰淇淋车。它们的音乐好像到处跟着我。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: We're supposed to be counting birds, not ice cream trucks. This is important scientific work!
dialogue.zh: 我们该数的是鸟，不是冰淇淋车。这是重要的科学工作！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, when you want ice cream, my data will be pretty important.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，等你想吃冰淇淋的时候，我的数据就会很重要。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Anna, birds are everywhere! I’m sure you’ll find something. Use your imagination! But, make sure that you put it on the official form.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，鸟到处都是！我肯定你能找到点什么。发挥想象力！不过，一定要写在官方表格上。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna was supposed to find birds, but she didn’t.
dialogue.zh: 安娜本来该找鸟，可她没找到。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Kelly says, “We're supposed to be counting birds, not ice cream trucks.” To be supposed to means you are expected to do something.
dialogue.zh: 凯莉说：“We're supposed to be counting birds, not ice cream trucks.” To be supposed to 表示你被期望做某事。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: It’s different from have to and ought to. Have to means you must do something. And ought to means you should do it but you don’t have to.
dialogue.zh: 它跟 have to 和 ought to 不一样。Have to 表示你必须做。Ought to 表示你应该做，但不是必须。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Keep watching for have to and ought to!
dialogue.zh: 继续看 have to 和 ought to！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No birds. Oh wait, there’s another ice cream truck! Anna, focus on birds. Aw, but that truck has my favorite flavor ... banana!
dialogue.zh: 没有鸟。哦等等，又是一辆冰淇淋车！安娜，专心找鸟。唉，可那辆车有我最爱的口味……香蕉！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That man is in the way. I can’t see the price. I wonder what flavor he's getting.
dialogue.zh: 那个人挡着了。我看不见价格。不知道他在买什么口味。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Strawberry? He doesn't seem like a strawberry kind of guy.
dialogue.zh: 草莓？他看起来不像爱吃草莓的人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In fact, he doesn't seem like an ice cream truck kind of guy. That suit looks expensive.
dialogue.zh: 其实，他看起来也不像会去冰淇淋车的人。那套西装看起来很贵。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Maybe he's a spy! You know what that means: The ice cream truck driver is a spy, too!
dialogue.zh: 也许他是间谍！你知道这意味着什么：冰淇淋车司机也是间谍！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Genius! It’s a perfect disguise.
dialogue.zh: 天才！这伪装太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What?! The man in the suit left his briefcase at the ice cream truck!
dialogue.zh: 什么？！西装男把公文包落在冰淇淋车那儿了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I was right! He is a spy! And, he just dropped off top-secret information! I ought to do something. Something needs to be done! I need to do something.
dialogue.zh: 我就知道！他是间谍！而且他刚把绝密情报放下！我应该做点什么。得有人做点什么！我得做点什么。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I did it! I took the spy’s briefcase!
dialogue.zh: 我做到了！我拿走了间谍的公文包！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What’s that?! The ice cream truck -- it’s following me! It wants the case back! I have to hide.
dialogue.zh: 那是什么？！冰淇淋车——它在跟踪我！它想把包拿回去！我必须藏起来。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is my life now -- running, scared, alone.
dialogue.zh: 这就是我现在的生活——逃跑，害怕，一个人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That awful music -- it’s following me everywhere!
dialogue.zh: 那讨厌的音乐——到处跟着我！

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Hey! You found my briefcase.
dialogue.zh: 嘿！你找到我的公文包了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You caught me! I mean, I caught you!
dialogue.zh: 你抓住我了！我是说，我抓住你了！

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Well, I just want my briefcase. All my poems are in there.
dialogue.zh: 我只是想要回公文包。我所有的诗都在里面。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Poems? You’re a poet?
dialogue.zh: 诗？你是诗人？

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Well, I'm a lawyer. But I write poems, too.
dialogue.zh: 其实我是律师。不过我也写诗。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, you’re not a spy?
dialogue.zh: 所以，你不是间谍？

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: You look disappointed.
dialogue.zh: 你看起来很失望。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, that’s okay. It’s not your fault. Poems are nice, too. I guess.
dialogue.zh: 不，没关系。这不是你的错。诗也挺好的。我想。

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Well, would you like me to read my latest one?
dialogue.zh: 那，要不要我读最新的一首？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Why not?
dialogue.zh: 为什么不呢？

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: On sunny day walks, my hand reaches for ice cream from fragaria.
dialogue.zh: 在晴天散步时，我的手伸向来自草莓属植物的冰淇淋。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love your poem!
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢你的诗！

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: I love ice cream.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢冰淇淋。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me too.
dialogue.zh: 我也是。

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: What's your favorite flavor?
dialogue.zh: 你最喜欢什么口味？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Banana.
dialogue.zh: 香蕉。

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Well, my favorite flavor is ...
dialogue.zh: 我最喜欢的口味是……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Strawberry!
dialogue.zh: 草莓！

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: How did you know that?
dialogue.zh: 你怎么知道的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A little bird told me.
dialogue.zh: 一只小鸟告诉我的。

quiz.prompt: What are Anna and Kelly supposed to be counting?
What does Anna think is in the man’s briefcase?
What is actually in the briefcase?
choices: A map of ice cream trucks

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 29
lessons.subtitle: Where There's Smoke...

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Hey, Anna. What are you reading?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜。你在读什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m reading about fire safety. Ms. Weaver named me fire safety monitor.
dialogue.zh: 我在读消防安全。韦弗女士任命我当消防安全监督员。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: But the only time we have a fire emergency is when someone burns a piece of toast.
dialogue.zh: 可我们唯一的火警紧急情况，就是有人把吐司烤糊了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is true. But fire safety is very serious – very serious. If there is a fire emergency, I have to help everyone out of the building.
dialogue.zh: 那倒是真的。可消防安全非常重要——非常重要。如果发生火警，我得帮所有人离开大楼。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Well then, if I were you, I’d learn as much as possible.
dialogue.zh: 那如果我是你，我会尽量多学一点。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You’re right. And I know just who to call!
dialogue.zh: 你说得对。而且我知道该给谁打电话！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Hmm, I wonder where Anna’s going. Today we are reviewing conditionals and learning helpful language for emergencies.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，不知道安娜要去哪儿。今天我们复习条件句，并学习紧急情况里的实用说法。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: If Anna studies hard, she’ll be a great fire safety monitor! That’s a conditional. It uses “if” to show that something is true only when something else is true.
dialogue.zh: If Anna studies hard, she’ll be a great fire safety monitor! 这是条件句。它用 “if” 表示只有另一件事成立时，这件事才成立。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Let’s find out where Anna is going. And if you want to learn fire emergency language, keep watching!
dialogue.zh: 咱们看看安娜要去哪儿。如果你想学火警紧急用语，继续看！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Firefighter Jones.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，消防员琼斯。

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Jones
dialogue.en: Hey, how are you, Anna?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，你好吗，安娜？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m well, thanks. How are you? Hi, Firefighter Hatcher.
dialogue.zh: 我很好，谢谢。你呢？嗨，消防员哈彻。

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. How are you?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。你好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m well, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 我很好，谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: Welcome to our firehouse.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来到我们的消防站。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: Come on in.
dialogue.zh: 进来吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: This is where the firefighters eat. This is where we rest. This is where we exercise. This is where the firetrucks are parked and maintained.
dialogue.zh: 这里是消防员吃饭的地方。这里是休息的地方。这里是锻炼的地方。这里停放和保养消防车。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This place is beautiful.
dialogue.zh: 这地方真漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: You know, the firehouse is a firefighter’s second home.
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，消防站是消防员的第二个家。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Firefighter Jones, Firefighter Hatcher: Can you tell me some ways to prepare for a fire emergency?
dialogue.zh: 消防员琼斯，消防员哈彻：能告诉我一些应对火警的准备方法吗？

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: Sure, Anna. There’s one really important thing you can do: Install a fire alarm. Test it monthly and make sure the batteries are fully charged.
dialogue.zh: 当然，安娜。有一件非常重要的事你可以做：安装火灾报警器。每月测试一次，并确保电池电量充足。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let’s talk about those emergency exits.
dialogue.zh: 我们来谈谈紧急出口。

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Jones
dialogue.en: In your home, office and schools, know where your emergency exits are located.
dialogue.zh: 在家里、办公室和学校，要知道紧急出口在哪里。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What about fire extinguishers?
dialogue.zh: 灭火器呢？

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Jones
dialogue.en: Everyone should know how to use a fire extinguisher. Have one handy and practice using it.
dialogue.zh: 每个人都应该知道怎么用灭火器。手头备一个，并练习使用。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What if we need to get out?
dialogue.zh: 要是我们需要出去呢？

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Jones
dialogue.en: You should have an evacuation plan. And practice getting out safely with fire drills.
dialogue.zh: 你应该有疏散计划。还要用消防演习练习安全撤离。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: If I am in a building and it’s on fire, should I use the elevator?
dialogue.zh: 如果我在一栋着火的楼里，该坐电梯吗？

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: No. Always use the stairs.
dialogue.zh: 不要。永远走楼梯。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What other safety tips should I know?
dialogue.zh: 我还该知道哪些安全提示？

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Jones
dialogue.en: Stay low. Smoke rises. The air is clearer close to the ground.
dialogue.zh: 压低身体。烟往上升。靠近地面的空气更清新。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Stay low. Anything else?
dialogue.zh: 压低身体。还有吗？

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: If you touch a door and it’s hot, don’t open it. There might be a fire on the other side.
dialogue.zh: 如果你摸到门是烫的，就不要开。另一边可能有火。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do I do if my clothes catch on fire?
dialogue.zh: 要是衣服着火了该怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: Do not run. If you run, the fire will burn faster. You must stop, drop and roll.
dialogue.zh: 不要跑。你一跑，火会烧得更快。你必须停下、倒地、打滚。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks so much! I’ve learned a lot. And I can’t wait to share this information with others.
dialogue.zh: 太谢谢了！我学到了很多。我等不及要把这些告诉别人。

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Hatcher
dialogue.en: Thanks for coming, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你来，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Firefighter Jones
dialogue.en: It’s been a pleasure meeting you.
dialogue.zh: 很高兴见到你。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: So, Anna, how was the visit to the fire station?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，去消防站怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I learned a lot! And firefighters have a very difficult job.
dialogue.zh: 我学到了很多！消防员的工作非常辛苦。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Do you smell smoke?
dialogue.zh: 你闻到烟味了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. So, like I was saying, I learned how to …
dialogue.zh: 没有。所以，就像我刚才说的，我学会了怎么……

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, I smell smoke.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我闻到烟了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: If you smell smoke, call the fire department!
dialogue.zh: 如果你闻到烟，就给消防部门打电话！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: If you smell smoke, get out of the building. Come on people, we have a fire emergency! Leave your things and evacuate calmly and quickly. Very good. Very good.
dialogue.zh: 如果你闻到烟，就离开大楼。大家快来，我们有火警紧急情况！放下东西，冷静、迅速撤离。很好。很好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We have a fire emergency. No, take the stairs Let’s get out. Let’s get out safely.
dialogue.zh: 我们有火警紧急情况。不，走楼梯。我们出去。安全地出去。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We got out in less than 6 minutes! Good job, people! Wait. Where’s Pete?
dialogue.zh: 我们不到 6 分钟就出来了！干得好，各位！等等。皮特呢？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I know where he is. I’ll go get him.
dialogue.zh: 我知道他在哪儿。我去找他。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No! Never go back into a burning building! The fire department is coming. Stay calm, Pete. Help is on the way! Help is on the way!
dialogue.zh: 不行！永远不要再回到着火的楼里！消防部门就快到了。保持冷静，皮特。救援马上到！救援马上到！

choices: Run as fast as you can

quiz.prompt: What does Anna tell Penelope not to do when Pete is still inside?
choices: Go back into a burning building

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 30
lessons.subtitle: Dream a Little Dream

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, where are you going in such a hurry?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你这么急着去哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Ashley. The nurse’s office. Today I get the results from my blood test.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什利。去护士办公室。今天我要拿血液检查结果。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I’m sure you’re fine. Don’t worry.
dialogue.zh: 我肯定你没事。别担心。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, I used to dream of being a nurse. It is such an honorable career. Is there something you’ve dreamed of doing?
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，我以前梦想当护士。这是一份很光荣的职业。你有没有梦想做过什么？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Sure! I would love to be a dog trainer. Actually, I’ve taught my dog, Dublin, lots of tricks!
dialogue.zh: 当然有！我很想当训狗师。其实，我已经教我的狗都柏林很多把戏了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I’m off to the nurse. Bye, Ashley.
dialogue.zh: 好了，我去找护士了。再见，阿什利。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Bye, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 再见，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Bye, Dublin.
dialogue.zh: 再见，都柏林。

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.en: I’m looking at her test results and they’re not good. In fact, I’m afraid she’s not going to make it.
dialogue.zh: 我正在看她的检查结果，情况不好。其实，我担心她撑不过去。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What?! I'm not going to make it? I'm dying??
dialogue.zh: 什么？！我撑不过去？我要死了？？

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.en: Anna, come in. How are you?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，进来。你好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I guess..not so good. I’m dying!?
dialogue.zh: 我猜……不太好。我要死了！？

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.en: What are you talking about?
dialogue.zh: 你在说什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I just heard you on the phone. Just tell me: How much longer do I have?
dialogue.zh: 我刚听到你打电话。直接告诉我：我还有多久？

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.en: I wasn't talking about you. A student of mine didn’t do well on her science test. So, she won’t be able to make it ... to graduation.
dialogue.zh: 我不是在说你。我的一个学生科学考试没考好。所以她撑不到……毕业。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Whew. Thank goodness! For a minute, my whole life passed before my eyes. There are so many things I haven't done yet.
dialogue.zh: 呼。谢天谢地！有那么一分钟，我的整个人生在眼前闪过。还有好多事我还没做。

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.en: Well, life is short. It’s important to do something you love every day.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，人生短暂。每天做一点自己热爱的事很重要。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I couldn’t agree more.
dialogue.zh: 我再同意不过了。

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.en: Now, let’s talk about your blood test. Your cholesterol is really low.
dialogue.zh: 现在，我们来谈你的血液检查。你的胆固醇真的很低。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Okay, Anna, say something and I’ll check your sound level.
dialogue.zh: 好，安娜，说点什么，我来检查你的音量。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Testing 1, 2, 3. Testing. Jonathan, I’ve been wondering something: What’s at the top of your bucket list?
dialogue.zh: 测试 1、2、3。测试。乔纳森，我一直在想一件事：你遗愿清单上排第一的是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: That’s easy. I’d love to win the World Karaoke Contest.
dialogue.zh: 这个简单。我很想赢得世界卡拉 OK 大赛。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is so strange. I just saw on Twitter that they are having auditions in D.C. this weekend!
dialogue.zh: 这太巧了。我刚在 Twitter 上看到，他们这周末在华盛顿特区有试镜！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Are you serious? Can you read the story by yourself?
dialogue.zh: 你说真的？你能自己读那篇报道吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure, absolutely.
dialogue.zh: 当然，没问题。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You go.
dialogue.zh: 你去吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, I was wondering if you still dream of being a dancer.
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，我想问你是不是还梦想当舞者。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Only every day!
dialogue.zh: 每天都想！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, guess what: A famous dancer is having a flash mob around the corner! Hundreds of people are dancing together!
dialogue.zh: 你猜怎么着：一位著名舞者正在街角办快闪！几百人一起跳舞！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: No way!
dialogue.zh: 不会吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Way! If you leave right now, you can join them! Bye!
dialogue.zh: 就是这样！你现在走，还能加入他们！再见！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, what’s one of your dreams?
dialogue.zh: 皮特，你的梦想之一是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Well, last night I dreamt I was in a spaceship. I was flying through outer space with these two beautiful...
dialogue.zh: 嗯，昨晚我梦见自己在宇宙飞船上。我和两个漂亮的……一起飞过外太空。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete -- not that kind of dream. I mean your hopes for the future.
dialogue.zh: 皮特——不是那种梦。我是说你对未来的希望。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Oh. I plan on selling my book to Hollywood and becoming rich and famous.
dialogue.zh: 哦。我打算把我的书卖给好莱坞，变得有钱又出名。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s going to be difficult.
dialogue.zh: 那会很难。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It’s my agent! Hello? Uh-huh. Sure! I can be in Los Angeles tomorrow!
dialogue.zh: 是我的经纪人！喂？嗯嗯。当然！我明天就能到洛杉矶！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, good job, Anna! My work here is done … almost.
dialogue.zh: 好，干得好，安娜！我这边的工作完成了……差不多。

dialogue.speaker: Music
dialogue.en: You can search but you won't find the answer without a dream. You can reach for the stars but you won't get there without a dream...without a dream.
dialogue.zh: 你可以去寻找，可没有梦想就找不到答案。你可以伸手去摘星星，可没有梦想就到不了那里……没有梦想。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna, what’s going on? Where is everybody?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，怎么回事？人都去哪儿了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don’t know. Maybe something is, uh, going around the office.
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。也许办公室里有什么，呃，在传播。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: You mean germs? Anna, you’d better use some of this hand cleaner. You don’t want to get sick, too.
dialogue.zh: 你是说病菌？安娜，你最好用点这个洗手液。你也不想生病。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. Okay, thanks. Not germs – dreams, Ms. Weaver. Dreams.
dialogue.zh: 对。好，谢谢。不是病菌——是梦想，韦弗女士。梦想。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: What did you say, Anna?
dialogue.zh: 你说什么，安娜？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Nothing. Nothing.
dialogue.zh: 没什么。没什么。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: We hope you have enjoyed Level 2 of Let’s Learn English. Everyone is following their dreams, big and small.
dialogue.zh: 希望你们喜欢 Let’s Learn English 第二级。每个人都在追随自己的梦想，无论大小。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: What are your dreams? Our dream is for you to keep learning English! Thanks for watching.
dialogue.zh: 你的梦想是什么？我们的梦想是让你继续学英语！谢谢收看。

quiz.prompt: Why does Anna think she is dying?
choices: She overhears the nurse talking about test results

quiz.prompt: What is at the top of Jonathan’s bucket list?
What is Professor Bot’s dream for learners?
choices: That they move to Los Angeles
